tei:div.tei:p: mgolog khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis —— — 'asdol sdud dag sgrig byas/ ba shaṃl+lī — — (— 1r+yārjehūṃḍā— — —— ji oṃ lhoza rje —— dis+dzawīkab ni — — 4 zo — rwarwa — — r+sha —༵——ḍi (—— — — 4 dz+wa — —

ra / /ma/bas shing grub pa'i dbang pyug chen po rdo grub chen 'jigaza/ re/da bstan pa/'i rnyi rma/ dang/6pha zazang ngo/nge gsung 'bum/ legs/ bshang nor bu'i bang mjod bsnyihūṃgs/re / rdo3 shā jikus darngo trīm rwapa /

pod 4sngon 'gro'i gtam/gna' rtsom ni mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas kyi grub cha gal chen zhig yin cing / krung hwa mi rigs kyi 'od stong 'bar ba'i rig gnas shul bzhag khrod kyi rin chen nor bu zhig yin/ de 'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig tho 'god/ par skrun bcas byed rgyu ni rang re'i tang dang rgyal khab kyis mi rigs phul byung rig sanas rgyun 'dzin byed pa'i bya ba rlabs chen zhig yin pas/ rang rgyal mi rigs sa khongs rang skyong bca' khrims sogs bca' khrims dang srid jus su gsal bor gtan la phab yod cing / rim pa khag gi mi dmangs srid gzhung nas 'di phyogs kyi bya ba 'bor chen bsgrubs shing / grub 'bras g.yur du za ba blangs/ nye ba'i lo shas ring / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang nas grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom nang du 'dus pa'i rang rgyal mi rigs gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud dang /dag sgrig tho 'god sogs byed pa'i thad ched du yig cha phud de gtan phab gsar ba mdzad cing / blang bya gsar ba bton/ byi khyab hru'u ci nas kyang6‘gna' rtsom dag sgrig par skrun sgos mes rgyal gyi phul byung rig gnas shul bzhag rgyun 'dzin byas te/ krung ko'i 1

pa'od nga rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ nga nga khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'deb/sa zhu dgos zhes pa'i bka' slob legs par bang /bong gsal dgongs don lag star dngos 'bab byed ched/ nga tshos rang skyong khul gyi don dngos dang zang 'brel byas te/ ched ༄gnyer las khungs btsugs shing / ched mkhas mi sna skong 'arben dang ci nus sgos mthun rkyen bskrun pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng de'i byed nus 'don skul byas te/ bya ba 'di cung snga ba'i sgo nas las 'go brtsams/nga pa'i thob ma'i rgyus lon ltar na/ mgo log sa cha'i gna' rtsom la mtshon na thon khungs cung 'bel bo yin par ma zad/brgyud pa ring zhing / rnam grangs mang la/ khyab rgya che ba dang / nang gses rigs kyis dbye na'ang brda sprod dang / rtsom rig lo rgyus/gso rig mtshan nyid rig pa/ rtsis gzhung / nang don rig pa sogs bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyab khongs phal mo che zinacing / dpe rgyun dkon zhing rtsa chen du brtsi rung ba'i gna' gzhung yang mi nyung bar 'dugade phyir thob ma'i 'tshol sdud tsam gyi rmang gzhi'i steng /1993lo nas bzung ste/ mgo log sa cha'i mkhas dbang rim byon gyi gsung rtsom kaces bsgrigs dpe tshogs kyi tshul du((khra dge slong tshul 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 4khrims dar rgyas kyi gsung rtsom gces bsgrigs〉sogs snga gzhug tu deb lnga drug tsam par skrun byas te/ rgya che'i klog pa po'i spyan sngar rim par bstar bas/ kun gyi gdeng 'jog legs po byung zhing /bya ba de la 'brel yod sde khag gis mthong gzigs gnang ste/ ched gnyer las khungs dang mi sna sogs la zhing chen rim pa'i gna' rtsom 'tshol sdud myur skyob kyi bya dga' dang gzengs bstod kyi dbugs dbyung jengs du mar gnang /nye lam rgyal khab mi rigs don byed u yon lhan khang gis〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom spyi byang sand bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i shar rlung gi 'gros dang bstun zhing / rang skyong khul gyi srid dbang btsags nas lo 'khor lnga bcu 'khor bar sngon ༄bsu zhu ba'i sta gon rtsom pa dang 'brel/ khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis sngar gyi rmang gzhi'i steng rim pa spaṭa shing gzhi rgya bskyed de/ slar yang〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dang / dag sgrig par skrun bcas byed pa'i jus gzhi gsar ba bzos pa ltar nga tshos bya ba 'di da lha dngos su lag star byed 'go brtsams pa yin/de yang nga tshos bya ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i mdzub ston bsam blo ni tang krung dbyang dang rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi 'brel yod mdzub 3

nga bang 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga nga nga sto na la brtsi srung sgos/ mi rigs phul byung rig gnas dar spel dang / mi rigs mthun sgril dang rig gnas brje res la shugs snon byed pa dmigs 'dun du byas te/ bden 'tshol lam/ tshan rig dang mthun pa'i spyod stangs la brten nas sa gnas mi rigs gna' rtsom sngog 'don myur skyob byas thog mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshogs ring lugs dpal yon 'dzugs skrun la zhabs 'des/sa zhu rgyu de yin/bya ba'i rtsa don ni chab srid 'du shes shugs dam zhing / srid jus dbye mtshams gsal bor byas te/ lo rgyus dang rtsod sgrub kyi lta ba spyad nas snyigs dor bcud len byed pa'i dus mtshangs sa rig ༄ ༄banas kyi ngos nas snga ma'i rnam pa ji bzhin cha tshang du mtshon ci nus byed cing / spyir btang du brtsams chos la dpyad brjod ci yang byed rgyu min/gzhan yang byed sgo'i shes byar slob sbyong dang / ched las shes byar gang sa 'dzin byas te/ nan tan zhib tshags kyi bya ba'i spyod stangs la brten nas gnad sgo stangs 'dzin byas thog rgyun shes sam ched las rang bzhin gyi 'gal 'khrul g.yol ci nus byed rgyu'ang smros ma dgos/de dang mnyam du spus legs 'du shes chabs par byas te/ ma

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 4྾ gyi rkye 'i ྾ཿtshodangul mthun —na cung 'byor ba gnas tshul 'og〈da —gas〉de jus 'god dang / mdun shog deb tshad/ shog spus/ ye ge'i dag tshad sogs gang rung nas de sngon las spus tshad bzang bar byas te/mig snga'i rgyal nang sa gnas bod yig dpe deb cung legs po'i gras su tshud par byed pa dmigs 'ben du byas yod/'dir cis kyang gleng dgos pa zhig ni de ring nga tshor bya ba 'di spel ba'i go skabs byung tshe/ nga tshor 'di 'dra'i rig gnas shul bzhag rgya che zhing rngams mthug pa zhig myur skyob bya ru yod cing / mang po zhig da dung med brlag tu ma song bar 'tshol du yod pa dang de pho rig gnas rin thang gi skor yin te/ de yang de sngon gyi lo rgyus su rang re gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi yi sha tshugs su skyes pa ni sus kyang bgrang du med mod/ legs par bsam na mi rigs dang mi'i rigs la 'phral yun du phan pa'i mdzad pa bzang po bskrun pa dang nyams pa med pa'i lebs skyes shul du bzhag yod mkhan ni shin tu nyung ngu zhig las med na/ khong tsho ni mi yi khyu mchog dang / phul byung skyes bur bgrang ba don dang ldan te/ ji skad du6 mkhas pa rnams ni med na blo gros rnams nyams mi rnams 'tsho ba don yod min ces gsungs pa shin tu mad de/ khong tsho yod cing / khong tshos rang byung khams dang spyi 6

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ra tshosas la thugs gzhigs yang yang mdzad pa las byung ba'i 'gro ba mi'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi mtshon byed shes rig gi legs skyes rmad du byung ba de dag yod pa dang / legs skyes de dag dus dang go mtshams kyi rgya las brgal te phyi rabs pa dag la pha nor gyi tshul du shul 'jog gnang bar brten/ nga tsho da lta dpal yon ldan pa'i spyi tshogs su 'tsho zhing / nga tshos bskrun pa'i shes rig la rmang gzhi — dang khungs lung yod cing / brgyud pa dang ldan par gyur/ mkhas pa de tsho dang rig gzhung de tsho bzhugs pas rang gi rigs rgyud 'di rnams da lta brgyud pa ring la zab cing rgya che ba'i thun min rig gnas shig gi bdag poraXgyur yod la/ shes rig rnam par bkra ba dpal ldan 'dzam bu gling ba'i mi gral gyi star rim 'phang mi dma' bar 'tsho thub pa byung yod/de phyir mkhas pa'i dbang po rim par byon pa dab dang de dag gis mdzad pa'i legs bshad kyi glegs bam dag ni mi rigs shig dang sa gnas shig la mtshon na gzi brjid dang la rgya zhig yin 'dug la/ 'chang bar bya ba'i khyad nor dang 'phyar bar bya ba'i dge mtshan zhig yin par ma zad/ 'tsho bar byed pa'i bla srog dang khrag rgyun zhig tu smras kyang rung snyam/ 'di ltar bsam na khong sngon byon gyi mkhas pa dag rang re la bka' drin bla lhag tu che bas 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 4rjes su yi rang zhing snying nas bka' drin zhu 'os la/ sngon 'gro'i rtsom thung 'di yang khong rnam par dad gdung mos gus kyi yid rlabs g.yo bzhin bris pa lags/dus tshungs su rang re gangs can pa dag la gna' bo'i dus nas bzung mkhas pa la gong bkur dang shes rig la gces thang che ba'i srol rgyun bzang po zhig yod la/ yul mgo log 'dir mtshon na'ang dgon sde dang dge 'dun pa dag gis bshad sgrub kyi ngos nas so so'i mkhas pa dang de'i brtsams chos la gcigs su 'dzin pa tsam du ma zad/ yul khams spyi nas kyang ‘mkhas pa yon tan ldan pa dang / skra dkar yang tsha mthong ba ste 1sogs kyis mtshon te mkhas pa dag phu dud bya ba'i yul sasum gyi gtso bo'i go gnas su bgrang ba'i srol 'dug cing / khong tsho ni legs bshad kyi 'byung gnas dang / legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba/ yi rang dang mig ltos kyi mtshon dpe zhig tu brtsi ba dang / khong tshos brtsams pa'i gsung chos dag ni basbab bya'i gnas shig dang / lugs gnyis blang dor gyi tshad gzhi zhig tu brtsi bar byed/ khyim rgyud dang rus rgyud dag la mtshon na rang gi khyim rgyud du 'khrungs pa'i mkhas pa dang de'i gsang chos de tsho so so rang rang gi khyim rgyud kyi khyad nor du byas te༄bu rabs tsha rgyud du bsrel bar byed pa'i dar srol yod pas/ dus — 7

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ pod 4bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi nang gses phyogs rer mtshon na de phyobs kyi stong cha gsab nus pa'i tshad du son pa'i rin thang yang yod par zhib 'jug mkhas dbang du ma smra/gang ltar da lha nga tshos〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'di nyid par du bskrun te mgo log gna' rtsom gyi spyi bab khyad chos dang ngo mtshar kun gyi spyan sngar bstar thub pa ni tang sga mi rib/sa srid jus don 'bab byung ba'i bye brag gi mtshon dpe zhig yin la/mgo log rig gnas khyab khongs kyi grub 'bras chen po zhig yin cing / krung go'i grangs nyung mi rigs gna' rtsom bya ba'i grub 'bras kyi ya gyal zhig kyang yin pa dang / deng dus la dge ba'i mdzad bzang zhig dang / ma 'ongs par bslangs pa'i rdo ring zhig ste/ lo rgyus kyi don snying ldan pa'i bya ba rlabs che ba zhig yin pa bston du med la/ sa gnas thun min rig gnas thon khungs sngog 'don sgos khyad thon rig gnas dar spel byed cing / rang skyong khul gyi rig gnas brje res dang phyi phyogs dril sgrog la shugs sdon byed par mtshon na don snying chen po tshab byed gzhan du med pa zhig yod par snyam zhing / dus mtshungs su4(dpe tshogs〉'di nyid kyis rgya che'i klog pa po dang 'brel yod zhib 'jug pa dag la'ang rig pa'i longs spyod ba/sar ba zhig stob nus pa'i yid ches nga tshor 9

ngo da 4ma ra ma rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/rdo grub chen kun bzang 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma phrin las kun khyab dpal bzang po ni/ bod kyi rus chen bzhi las a lcags 'bri yi rigs las mched pa gnubs lcags mo'i rgyud du/yab rtsod bral dus babs kyi sprul ba'i gter chen khrag 'thung bdud 'joms gling pa gis li gter ston zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / yum mtshan ldan ḍā ki'i rigs gyur bsod nams mtsho gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i shing mo gling lor(spyi lo1866)ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas 'bros sgang zhes grags pa'i ri zhol da lta'i mgo log pad ma rdzong gi rdzong grong gi nye 'dabs su sku bltams/ snga ma'i bag chags sad pas sku chung ngu'i dus nas yi ge dang brda sprod sogs gzigs pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen/ rdzogs sprul bzhi ba mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje'i lung bstan ltar/ grub pa'i khyu mchog chen po rdo grub kun bzang 1

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/gzhan phan 'jigs med phrin las 'od zer gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos bzung ste rdo grub chen gyi gdan sar 'khod na'ang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse rin po ches brtag pa mdzad tshe gung thang bstan pa'i sgron me'i yang srid du grub pas/ khri chen gung thang pa'i sku skyer yang grags so//rdza stod du phebasanas 'jam dbyangs ngur smrig 'chang ba'i rnam rol chen po rdza dpal dge sprul sku o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi bzhes pas/lhag pa'i lhas rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis brlabs te dkongs pa ye shes kyi klong rdol/ dgang lo brgyad du son pa chu pho sprel lor ༄dpal sprul rin po ches da lo rdo grub sprul skus spyod 'jug gi bka' khrid gnang dbo/sa zhes phyogs kyi slob du mang du bsdus tshe/nye gnas 'khor dang bcas pas sprul sku khong sku na chung drags pas re zhig 'khor de lta bu la bka' khrid mi 'ong zhes nan gyis zhus pa bka' bkyon gyis tshar bcad par brten/ bka' nan bzlog ma nus par rdza rgyal dgon du 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor la spyod 'jub chen mo'i bka' khrid gnang ba na/ 'khor slob kun gyi lus kyi spu long dbang med g.yo zhing / dad pa'i mchi ma sham sham 'bab pa'i tshod du chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ dpal sprul rin po 2

rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsdus/ pod 4 che'i zhal nas/ rdo grub byis pa lo brgyad pas chos 'khor 'di 'dra bskor nus pa'i tshul la dpag na/ da dung lung gi bstan pa'i banas tshad rdzogs ran mi 'dug ces thugs dgyes pa chen pos bsngags brjod kyi me tog yang yang 'thor/ snga phyir o rgyan 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po dang / rdzob/sa sprul mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje/ rgya rong nam sprul kun bzang jes/ mchog rdo rje/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po/ kong sprul blo gros mtha' yas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa nyag bla gter chen/ 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sogs dam pa mang du bsten nas/ 'dul ba dadu tshad phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i zab chos spyi dang / mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying this/ gong 'og sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo rnam bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung khrid gsum/ mdo smad rdi tsha dgon gyi mgo log sprul sku 'gya ba a lags sogs las kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i yis chas ba'i byas ri bo dge ldan pa ltar gyi gzhung bka' pod lnga sogs mdor na mdo sngags gsar rnying grub mtha' ris med kyi lta grub kun la khengs pa dang skyo ngal med par thugs 'dris gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhas pa'i grags pa ches cher rgyas/13

ngo da 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/tshe rdzimo lo ྾྾rab — sa lcags 'brus — 1880 ra mako log pad ma 'bum dpon shog brgyad kyis ched du phul ba'i bzhugs gnas rdo yul khri zhes bya bar dgon banas gtsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling zhes bya ba gsar du bzhengs pa/ phyis ming zur shugs kyis 'gyur te gsang chen dngos grub dpal 'bar gling du grags/de tsam nas dgon pa de'i g.yon ngos brdzi med bkra leb gong mar thang stong rgyal po'i lha khang du grags pa'i dben khrod cig tu sgrub pa rtse gcig mdzad pas/ tshul khrims kyi dri bsung zhim pos khor yub dus kun 'gengs la/ lhas pa'i lha la mi dang mi lab pa bzhin bgro gleng byed cing / ma gza' dam gsum mir brdzus nas glebs bam skyel 'bul byed pa/ nyin lam du ma'i sar rab gnas kyi 'bru char 'beb pa sogs mngon shes dang brdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med pa'i grub pa'i go 'phang mthon por gshegs kyang / rtag tu sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kho nar dgyes pas don gyi gsang ba sus kyang dposas par dka'/ gzhan yang gangs ri'i ljongs su bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog dang / bka' gter rnying rgyud/ bod kyi mkhas grub ris med kyi sasung 'bum glegs bam ba/sar bzhengs sogs bya ba las kyi phrin las kyang rgya cher spel/mthar rab byung bco lnga ba'i zad pa me stag gi lor(1929)14

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs medabastan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bshad 'di nyid kho na las gzhung logs sa brtsams pa zhig bod na ༄med par grags pas/ 〈sazungs rnam〉'di'i dpe zhig a mdo dge bshes 'jam dpal rol ba'i blo gros kyi phyag brgyud nas kun gzigs bcu gsum pa chen po'i spyan sngar phul bas dgyes gzigs dang bsngags brjod yang yang banang bar gsung la/ rdo grub khong rang nas kyang4(gsang snying〉dang〈gzungs rnam〉gnyis ka snying dmar rjen du bstan pa yin ces lan du mar gsung bar grags/ 〈bzungs rnam〉dang(4gter rnam〉sanyis dbyin ji sogs kyi yi ger bsgyur yod pa'ang nye lam thos so/ /bzhan yang khong gi gsung chos gang la'ang rtsom nyams dang rtsom stangs kyi cha nas thun mong la rjes bzlos su ma song ba'i khyad chos shig yod la/ snyan rtsom la'ang 'gyur bas dang ro nyams gzhan dang gzhan la yong dka' ba'i cha bklags pa tsam gyis lhag ger myong thub pa zhig yod pas/sasung mgur dang / gtam tshogs khrod kyi sgrung thung dag la rtsom rig gi nyams 'gyur dang rin thang ngo mtshar ba zhig yod par sngon dang da lta'i ngag rig smra ba kun zhal gcig tu gleng ngo / /zhes pa'ang lnga rig smra ba bde legs rab rgyas su 'bod pas khul gna' rtsom gzhung las khang gis bskul ngor zla tshes dase bar 'phral mar sbyar ba'o// // 16

dkar chagasngon 'gro'i gtam/ ༷ ༷༷ ༷༷ ༷ ( )rtsom pa po ngo sprod mdor bsnyus/ ༷ ༷ ༷ (11)bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig ༷ ༷༷༷ ༷༷ ( )bla ma'i rnal 'byor la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ ༷ ༷ ༷( 19)bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs/ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷(71)mtshams sgrub zhal gdams sogs/ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷༷ (88)rdo rje gzhon nu la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ ༷ ༷༷ (95)klong snying lo rgyus/ ༷ (103)rten gsum rab gnas/ (117)thugs chen yig drug yi skor tsho sna tshogs/ ༷ (121)yi dam zhi ba'i zin bris/ ༷ (236)rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ ༷ ༷ ( 273)phur ba'i zin bris/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷༷ ( 29/)srog gi zhal gdams/ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (309)bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs las gsung pa'i khyim gyi dran tho/ (327)bka' brgyad bro cho༅ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (346)1

ci bgyi'i bka' nyan/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (365)yum ka bde chen rgyal mo'i sgrub gzhung bi zin bris/ (396)yum ka bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa sngags kyi 'grel bshad/ ༷ ༷ (441)rdo rje phag mo'i zin tho don 'grub ma/ ༷ ༷ ༷ (sgyu151)yum ka'i dmibs skor/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (175)tshe yum rdzogs rim/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ( 91)bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ ༷ ༷ ༷( )
༄//bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog stsol nyams su len tshul khrid yig tu byas pa grub pa mchog gi dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

nga n+d+ra4/ 4 nga —nga nga nga nga med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga / /dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas srid pa 'dir/ /mi yi sar mdzad rdo rje'i lam ston pa/ /skal bzang mkhas pa yongs kyi mgon gcig pu/ /de la btud de sadams pa'i zur rgyan spe'/ /de la srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i 'byung banas ni bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen nyab gcig yin te/ des ma bstan na mtho ris su 'gro ba'i lam tsam yang legs par shes dka' na/nges lesas sgrub pa'i lam lta ci smos pa'i phyir ro/ /khyad par du yang theg pa chen po'i lam bzang tshang la ma nor ba rnyed nas tshul bzhin sgrub pa ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas bzung ste brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i gdams ngag bum pa sang byor mnga' ba'i bla ma dam ba la ltos shing / de'i nang nas gsang sngags kyi lam ni bla ma las ma thob par glegs bam klog pa tsam yang byar ma gnang ste/sasang sngags rang nyid len pa ni/ /sems can dmyal ba 'ba' zhis rgyu/ /zhes so/ /de'ang bla ma las dbang lung thob nas sgrub pa rkyang pas mi chog ste/ gsang sngags byin rlabs kyi lam pa bya ba yin pas bla ma mnyes pa rab 'bring tha ma'i bye brab gis dngos grub myur bul dang che chung sogs tha dad du 'gyur bas sgo mang ngo nas yun ring por skyo dub med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis bla ma mnyes par bya ba la rab las pa kho na ste/ rang re sangs rgyas la sangs 2

/ba zugadaka chedabaka par15dpa (1zugabasgyu chedazad ste/zadathubabaka zababad/ ba ma ba lta bu'i 'od skur bzhengs pa lha btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi drin las bod khams 'gro ba yongs la gtsug nor gyi skal bar thob pa gsang ba bla med spyi dang / bye brag rdzobs pa chen po snying thig gi chos char phab ste skal ldan mang po gdod ma'i grol sar dbugs ༷ dbyung ba'i bka' drin gzhal du ma mchis pa/ nges pa'i don du che mchog bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo grub pa'i slob dpon gyi zol la brten par sgrub sde'i lung gis grub pa/ 'chi med bi ma la mi tra ste dri med bshes gnyen dang / bye ma la mu tra ste phyag rgya rgya chen du grags pa'i slob dpon chen po de nyid sku dngos shar phyogs rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na bskal pa ji srid par bzhugs thing / lo brgya re'i mtshams su snying thig gi bstan pa gsal bar byed pa'i sprul pa re bod du 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa ltar/ gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal dang / 'gro ba'i mgon po ku ma rā dza dang /lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med sogs snga phyir 'ga' re byon pa las/ lnga bdo'i dus mthar bod chen po'i ljongs 'dir lha rigs gnyos kyi gdung las bsod nams brgya ba'i sku'i nyin byed/ dri ma med pa'i rnam thar gyi snang ba dang ldan pa don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba byung ste/mthong thos dran reg gi 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la kun tu bzang 6

nga ba / ba nga grub nga jigs med bstan nying gsunga'abum/nga nga nga nga po'i rgyal srid sbyin par mdzad pa des/ bzo gnas kyi rig pa la mkhas pa karma rnam rgyal zhes bya ba'i mos ldan gyi slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ rang gi sgrub pa rang gis mdzad/ /zer ba'i tshul ltar dgyes bzhin bang ba'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog nga nyams su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag bis/ thog ma kho nar tshe 'di'i bya bzhag thams cad zin pa rjes med chu'i ri mo lta bu dang / der ma zad 'khor ba'i bya ba mtha' dag yid rton mi rung ba'i sdug bsngal gyi las thabs 'ba' zhig tu shes nas/ bya rgyu dam chos dang / re sa bla ma las med par kho thag bcad de/bde ba'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam dang ldan pas 'dug ste/bdab gzhan mkha' khyab 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /sogs ltar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyud dang 'dres nges su bya/ de nas blu n+ya tā'i sngags don dran pas tha mal gyi snang zhen stong chen de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings su sbyangs te/ de'i ngang las rang snang rnam par dag pa'i 'og min gyi zhing khams rgyan dang bkod pa tshad med pas mngon par 'phags pa'i dbas sa/ rang lhar sgom pa'i tshig zin ༄ ༄med kyang tha mal pas dngos snang mi dmigs par byas nas yang tha mal pa'i nga rgyal skyed pa mi legs pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs gang yang rung ba'i lhar langs pa'i mdun mkhar rtsibs brgya'i 6

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4 ba bdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can nyi ma brgya'i 'od 'bar bas steng nas bkab cing / bayas g.yon du lha rdzas kyi dar gyi lda ldi dang / ba dan dang / me tog dang / nor bu'i chun 'phyang la sogs pas mdzes par bres pa dang / mtha' bskor kun tu gser sbyangs kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang / bum pa gang ba/ spos kyi za ma tog sogs mchod pa'i yo byad sprin ltar spungs pas brgyan pa'i seng ge'i khri yangs shing mtho ba bsam par bya ste/ 'di 'dra phra mo rer yang rang la legs tshogs 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad shin tu che ba'i phyir ro/ /bla ma zhal bzhugs ring dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi gdan la dang / gshegs rjes yin na pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ 'on kyang sngon rang gis 'jal dus kyi rnam pa de ka slar rjes su dran nas gsal 'debs pa'i tshul gyis bsgom na mos gus kyi 'gyur ba skye sba ba'i blo rigs kyang yod la/ rang gis ji ltar mos pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas rnams mdun na bzhugs shing snang ba las ris chad can du med par lung rigs mang pos grub pas/ rdzogs chen snying thig gi dbang chog na/ sngon bzhugs dur khrod gnas nas 'dir gshegs shig /ces 'byung zhing / sa skya phyobs sogs kyi bla rnam mang por bla ma'i sku dbyibs bag tsam mdun du btud pa dang /7

/ba zugamadzecadab pa 11dpa bkazugabasgyu bkakhyed/daspyadadapebaka bkacad/ ba rabam med pa'i 'bras bur 'khrungs pas sku gtsang zhing dag la tsan+dan las kyang lhag pa'i dri bsung ldang ba/ thugs rgyud ting nge 'dzin gyi bde bas gang bas zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dwangs shing rnyog pa med pa/ sku brjid cing lhun chags la bag dro ba/ rtag tu zab mo'i de nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i shes rab kyi snang ba mi 'phrog pa mnga' bas sku'i gzi brjid zil gyis mi non pa/ mchos gi ye shes rnam par rgyas pas zhal ras pad+ma 'dab ma brgya pa ltar rgyas pa/dam pa'i chos kyi dga' bde mtshungs pa med pa la rol pas shin tu dgyes pa'i nyams can/ dus drug tu gdul bya'i 'jis rten la gzibs pa mi g.yel bas spyan yangs shing ma zum pa/ rtsol ba med pa'i thags rje chen po shugs 'byung du mnga' bas glang po che'i ༄gzigs stangs can/ sku tshe dpag tu med par mchod sbyin chen po mdzad pas phyag ring zhing rgyas la dpag bsam gyi lcus ma ltar mdzes pa/ phyag stabs dang phyag mtshan ni rang gang 'dod kyi dngos grub la ltos te gcig tu ma nges kyang / 'dir bang bsam gyi 'dod don thogs pa med par sprul bas g.yas mchod sbyin dang /ting 'dzin dgongs rgyud dag pas byin gyis rlob pa'i rten 'brel du g.yon mnyam bzhag /thun mong ba tshe dang shes rab kyi dngos grub sgo bas tshe bum dang pu ste/ bla med phyag rgya chen po'i dngos 9

nga nga 4/ nga — rdo grub nga nga bstan nyi'i gsung 'ang / ྾ grub sbyin pas rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ skal ldan slob ma'i tshogs noms sdom pa gsum gyi tshul khrims la bkod de thes rgyud rnam par dag pa'i bka' drin mdzad pas chos bos rnam gsum gsol ba sogs dbe slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i cha lusas can/thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i sde snod rab 'byams la dbang sgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po'i cod pan 'dzin pa'i rtags su paṇa zhwa rna ring mnabs pa/ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal srid las gzhan du mi g.yo bas zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung dang sku drang por bsrang ste bzhugs pa/ skru'i ba spu'i bu ga rer yang til gyi gang bu kha phye ba lta bu'i rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rdzogs pa/ gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi rnga bo che las skad cig rer yang dam pa'i chos kyi char zad med du 'bebs pa/ thugs 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi dbyings sa mkha' khyab kyi de bzhin gshegs ༄pa thams cad ro mnyam rdo rjer gyur pa/ zhal mthong ba tsam gyis tha mal pa'i rnam rtog gcod pa/ spyan gzigs pa tsam gyis byin rlab kyi zil chen 'bebs pa/ thugs dgongs gtad pa tsam gyis ye shes btsan thabs su 'char ba/ rjes su dran ma thagatu thubs rje'i shugs g.yo ba/ gcig chog skyabs gnas yongs kyi rgyal por mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs par bltas la yang yang gsal 10

51 zugadaka che ma pa 11ma 11zugab chedazung ste/ba dpeb/ dbabad/pa 11parapa/ ye shes kyi sgo tshad med pa sprub pa la sobs pa'i tshogs gnyis kyi spyod pa 'bras bu dang bcas pa thams cad la rin po che'i gter rnyed pa ltar dga' zhing snying nas rjes su yi rang ba dang /'jig rten na khyim dang zhing dang phyogs gzhan pa'i las kyi mtha' thams cad nyin mo'i snang ba la brten nas 'byung ba ltar/ mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi bde ba rgyu dang bcas pa mtha' dag ni bla ma'i gsung dam pa'i chos kyi snang ba gcig pa'i mthu la rag las pas gdul bya'i 'jig rten la thugs brtse bas chos kyi rnga bo che rgyun mi chad par brdung ste/ 'gro ba thams cad byang chub mchob gi go 'phang la bzhag tu gsol zhes bla ma la lha rdzas kyi gser sbyangs las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa phul te bsol ba gdab pa dang / de lta bu'i gsung bi phrin las de yang pe waṃ gi rgyud dang de'i sgra dbyangs bzhin du sku la brten pa yin pas phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du sku'i snang ba mi sdud par bstan pa rgya mtsho'i dpal du bzhubs par rdo rje'i gdan khri phul te gsol ba dang / de dag gis mtshon pa'i dus gsum gyi dge tshogs thams cad rang gzhan yid can mtha' dag bla ma sangs rgyas rin po ches 'azal ba med par theg pa mchog gi lam du rjes su 'dzin pa dang /des ji ltar gdams pa'i bka' bzhin sgrub pa dang / bsgrub pa 3

bla ma'i nol 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4 yongs grags dang / klong chen chos spyod las 'byung ba lta bu gang byed 'dra'o/ /gsol gdab dngos la/ dper na phur bas gcig tu btsusas nas rdo tho lta bus drag tu brdung na gting ring du zug 'gro ba ltar/ bla ma'i rdo rje gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la byin rlabs zhu ba'i dmigs 'dun rtse gcig tu btsugs nas mos gus sa/dung shugs drag pos 'phul brdeg byas na thugs rje smon lam gyi gting slong nus pa byung bas phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa zhes gsungs te dbang dang byin rlabs kyi ched du dmigs pa'i 'dun pa hur re ba'i ngang nas mos gus kyi shugs ci thon byed pa yin no/ /mos gus med par mig btsum thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs lo dang / byin gyis rlob lo'i tshig skam phreng bar bgrang zhing brgya stong sogs bsags kyang ras la 'byar rtsi ma thebs na tshon mi 'dzin pa ltar byin rlabs 'go ba'i yul med cing / mos gus kyis blo gtad ling bsgyur nus na lus ngag gi rnam rig de 'dra rtsal du ma bton yang / chos rnams sngon du yid 'gro zhing / /yid gtso yid ni malhogs pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dgos don 'grub pas/ dpal sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ bla ma bsten thabs mos gus yin te zhe sa min/ /bla ma sgrub thabs mos gus yin te gsol 'debs min/ /mos gus yod na ji ltar byas kyang 16

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4 mkhyen chos rje'i gzhung yid bzhin mdzod dang / sems nyid ngal gso rtsa 'grel sogs bltas la shes par bya'o/ /de dag gzhung rang gi tshig ris dang sbyar nas mdo tsam brjod na/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs sogs/ zhes pa nas/ mkhas grub dbang po/ zhes pa'i bar gyis/ yon tan rjes su dran tshul bstan la/ de'i sgo nas bla ma nyid dran pa dngos ni/ dpal ldan bla ma la/ zhes pas bstan/de ltar bla ma la dmigs nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ rkang pa tha mas bstan to/ /rkang pa dang po gnyis kyi don la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'chad tshul mang tsam byar yod kyang mi spro la/rags rim tsam du gnyis las/ phyogs dang po thun mong ltar bshad na/ 'jig rten pa'i tshong khe sbogs/ khyim gyi las thabs/dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs dang / de dag las khyad par 'phags pa'i rig gnas sgra sman snyan rtsis sogs slob pa la mtshan nyid kun ldan gyi bla ma 'tshol mi dgos te/ de dag phyi rol pa tshun chad kyi nang na ches mkhas par shes pa mtha' yas pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rang yang de 'dra la mkhas pa'i go 'phang lan grangs dpag med cig 'khor bar 'khor dus thob kyang tha mal pa'i sa nas 'phags ma nus/ gtan bde'i go 'phang sgrub lug/sa dang /lhag par rang gzhan mtha' dag bde ba'i mchog dang sprod pa'i 7

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4'jig rten dbang phyug lta dus kyang thags rje phrin las de bas lhag bza dang /nge byedapa mdzad rgyu ma ma—sa shing / dmyal bar gzar — rbab ltar shugs drag tu rgyug pa'i sems can 'gro phyogs gtan bzlog ste sangs rgyas kyi sa la dpag chen mda' ltar 'phen pa'i nus mthu ni mthu stobs kyi che bar byed pa gzhan dang mi mnyam ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams kyang dgongs pa 'di kho na'i ched du 'jug pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsung gi phrin las kyi nus mthur ma zad gsang sngags bla med kyi ye shes grub pa'i slob dpon 'di lta bu mthong ba dang / thos pa dang / yid la dran pa'i sems can rnams kyang rdo rje 'chang chen po dngos ltar phyag bya ba'i gnas su rgyud sde las gsungs pas sems can sgrol ba'i nus mthu'i tshad 'di tsam zhes bsam par dka'o/ /nus pa'i ye shes zhes pa ni mngon shes drug dang dbang bcu lta bu yin no/ /mdor na 'o skol rnams la rgyal ba sras bcas kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa dang mdzad pa mtshungs pas na de dag gcig tu bsdus pa zhes bya'o/ /phyogs gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa ltar bshad na/ dbang bskrur ba'i dus su/ de ring phyin chad bu po kyi/ /rnam par snang mdzad nga yin pas/ /zhes sogs lha thams cad la 'dod pa spos nas 19

pa babad/ ba rje shā ba ma ji gab ba ba bad ba pa da ba gro nga ma da ma / gsungs pa ltar shes par bya ste/ dper na gar mkhan gyis cha byad dang rnam 'gyur gzhan dang gzhan du bsgyur nas skye bo mang po mgo rmongs par byed pa'i gar gyi rol pa ston yang gar mkhan gcig las ma 'das pa bzhin du sngags kyi lha'i rab dbye byed tshe/rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gsum/ zhi dang khro chags phra men de bzhin gshegs pa dang byang sems khro bo yab yum sogs rigs dang dkyil 'khor mtshan dang rnam 'gyur tshad med par snang yang /gdul bya'i dbang gis gang 'dul gyi gzugs su shar bar zad kyi/'char gzhi ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi dgongs klong rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes gcig pur gnas te/ rgyud las/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu'i nyams ni du ma'i bar mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis rigs dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes ma lus pa rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ye shes kho na la 'dus pa yin no/ /gzhan yang / phyogs bcu dus gsum du so sor byon pa'i sangs rgyas grangs mtha' blos mi thag pa bzhugs shing / de snyed kyi ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa ༄yod kyang yul chos kyi dbyings la tha dad med pas thams cad kyang dpal ldan bla ma'i ye shes kyi chos nyid mkha' ltar dka pa'i dbyings su chu klong thams cad rgya mtshor bcib/ tu 'dres pa ltar ro 20

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4gcig tu song ba la dgongs nas gter phyogs bla sgrub las/ rgyal ba thams cad ye shes klong du gcig /ces sogs gsungs te/dkon mchog brtsegs par/ bzang po rgyal ba gcig la mchod byed na/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la ni mchod 'gyur te/ /'di lhar de dag nga yi chos dbyings dang / /tha dad bya ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes sasungs pa dang phyogs gcig go/ /de ltar rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi ye shes thams cad dpal ldan bla ma'i 'od gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i dgongs klong gcig tu bzhugs nas slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob pa 'di'i gnad kyis bla ma gcig pu mchod na mkha' khyab kyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par 'gyar bar sasungs te/ gsang snying snyed da /cho /kye 11las/ dbang phyugs ngas spyod lngas ma da na/ /da—la 'a— ra thams cad mchod pa yin/ /nye ba'i dkyil 'khor smos ci dgos/ /zhes sogs mang ngo / /'di dag ni rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa yin lugs dngos so/ /de dag gang yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dpal ldan bla ma spyi khyab tu 'gro ba'i phyobs nas bshad pa yin la/ bye brag tu rje bla ma 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba la sbyar nas 'chad tshul ni/'og tu zur tsam gsal ba las shes kyi/ rgyas par ma bris te yi 2

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ba ge'i ngal ba la skrag cing sgyid lug par gyur to/ /ji skad bshad pa de lta bu'i zhing gi mchog de skabs 'dir su la byed ce na/ dpal ldan bla ma zhes ba/sungs te/ mos gus can gyi re ba yid bzhin du skong ba'i dngos grub kyi 'byor pa zad mi shes pa mnga' bas na dpal dang ldan pa/ gu ru zhes pa'i sgra las drang na yon tan gyis lci bas sam/ zhing gi bo/nga mar bkur ba'i yul gyi gtso bo yin pas na bla ma ste/ gong du mtshan bkra gsal ba ltar/ ngor chen byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin gyis gsol ba'i mtshan 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / rmog ston 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje dang / 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gus gsol ba'i mtshan 'jigs med mkhyen brtse'i zlos gar/ byang chub thugs bskyed kyi mtshan blo gros rgya mtsho dri ma med pa'i 'od/ paṇa chen bi ma la'i 'khrungs rabs dang spyar ba 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rje/ mnga' bdag tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi 'khrungs rabs kyi phyogs dang bsnyun pa 'jam dpal chos kyi bshes gnyen/ kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer dang rnam dbyer med pa'i mtshan rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ dus gsum mkhyen pa o rgyan chen pos gter ston grub thob rgya mchos 'khor los sgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba'i mtshan/2 2

bla ma'i rnal 'byoranyams len khrid yig pod/ 4pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pa sogs sku gcig la mtshan mang por grags pa de'o/ /de'i rnam thar phyogs tsam mdor bsnyus nas bstan pa ni/ mkhas grub dbang po/ zhes pa ste/ spyir rgya gar rdo rje gdan du song bar khas 'che yang lam rgyus bshad rgyu med pa'i mi zhig yod na/ de la lam mkhan bcol nas rdo rje gdan du 'gro thag mi chod/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas dang grub thob sogs su khas len byed kyang lam gang nas grub pa'i go 'phang la bgrod pa'i lam de'i thog mtha' bar gsum gyi rgyus mtha' dag la mkhas pa zhig mi 'dug na de la yid ches blo gtad bya bar mi btub/ rgya gar gyi lo rgyus mang po bshad rgyu yod kyang kho rang der 'gro ma myong na de la'ang rnam pa thams cad du lam la mi 'khrul ba'i blo gdeng khel dka'/ de bzhin du gzhung lugs mang po shes pa'i mkhyen rgya yod kyang sgom sgrub kyi srang la btegs nas nyams myong gi drod tshad gtan la phebs pa med na rtogs pa don brgyud kyi bde lam nas myar por bkri ba'i mtha med pas mkhas grub kyi yon tan gnyis ra da 'dzom pa zhig rtsa ba'i bla mar byed dgos/ de la rje btsun bla ma 'di nyid mkhas pa'i rnam thar gyi dbang du byas na/ dang po sku bltams pa'i dus nyid nas slob dpon chen po legs ldan 'byed dang / nags kyi rin chen sogs 'phags yul pa dang / mnga' 23

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstenanyi'i gsung 'bum/bdag khri srong dang / rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal sogs bod yul gyi mkhas grub du mar 'khrungs pa'i sngon gnas gsal bar dran zhing / chos thams cad rdol shes su mkhyen pas bslab grar ma zhugs gong du'ang chos kyi lo rgyus dang /grub mtha'i rnam bzhag /zhal gdams nyams dbyangs sogs tshis sgros satsang zhing don lesas pa kho na thogs med du rtsom pa la bskye bsgo /kye(1 dpe dbyed snyed sogs pa sa ba na tan rmad du byung bas 'a ga na mtshar bar byed pa byung yang / sngon gyi dam pa rnams kyi spyod tshul dang mthun par bya ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i skyes bu rnams la gdams ngag rnam thar gyi sgo nas ston pa'i slad du/ thos pa tshol ba la ches gus par mdzad de/ dgung lo gnyis gsum dus nyi grags phyogs kyi bla ma zhig gis sngon 'gro dal 'byor rnyed dka' 'chad kyin 'dug pa'i sar ma yum gyis khur nas phyin pas dgong mo tshur slebs rjes su'ang / shin tu dgyes pa'i nyams kyis ngo bo dal ba bsam pa/ khyad par 'byor pa bsam pa zhes sogs yang yang bskyar nas gsung bar grags shing / gzhan ku se ba'i a mye sogs/ su gzigs la/ khyod la chos bshad rgyu e yod ces dngos rdzas phran tshegs rigs yab yum gyis ma tshor bar gnang nas dri bar mdzad/ sku rtsed thams cad dam pa'i chos nyan bshad sogs 24

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4ba kyi nom pa 'ba' zhig tu 'byung ba / sde dge tshe dbang rdo rje rig 'dzin gyis/ chos dasa' dmar lte zhes bla dwags su gsol/ yab drung chen rin chen dbang rgyal dang / sde dbe/'i bla sman pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ zhe chen 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal sogs thun mong rig gnas la mkhas pa'i dam pa mang po'i drung du/ yi ge 'bri klog dang rtsis dkar nag /gso rig rgyud bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa sku gzugs mchod rten sogs kyi thig dang cha tshad/sgra ka swa gnyis dang tsan+d+ra pa/ snyan dngags/ sdeb sbyor/ mngon brjod sogs mkhas pa'i phul du phyin par sbyangs shing / na len+d+ra'i gzim 'og sprul sku byams pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags dang / brag sgom zhabs drung dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas/bkra shis lhun po'idaka' chen blo bzang dge legs/ li thang dge bshes byams pa phun tshogs sogs sa dge'i mkhas pa du ma las/phar phyin/ dbu ma/ mngon pa mdzod/ tshad ma rnam 'grel/ jo bo'i lam rim/ theg chen blo sbyong gi skor mang po sogs gsan cing / bka' pod gyi rtsa gzhung phal cher dang / sman gyi rgyud bzhi sogs blo 'dzin gnang / smin gling mkhan chen rig 'dzin bzang po sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dakhus su tshig ༷gsum rim nod kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos por 2 5

da ba / ba nga shā ba pa nga ba sa ma ba ba da zung nying ba da nga nga da ma / nga nga bsgrubs te 'dul ba mdo rtsa ba sogs la zhib tu sbyangs/ ngor mkhan chen kun dga' bstan 'dzin dang / 'jam dpal bzang po/zhwa lu mchog sprul rin po che rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong / kun mkhyen blo gros mtha' yas sogs las bya rgyud rigs gsum/ rnam snang mngon byang / yo ga dpal rtse dbyings gsum/ bla med bde dgyes gsang gsum/ dus 'khor/ gshin rje'i gshed sogs gsang sngags gsar rnying thun mong ba dang / gsar ma'i skor gyi dbang / rgyud bshad/ sgrub thabs/ zab khrid/ las tshogs kyi man ngag dang bcas pa mtha' yas pa/ 'gyur med mthu stobs rnam rgyal dang / sgrol ston 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan/'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu/ khyab bdag pad+ma dam chos 'od zer/rdo rje 'chang karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho sogs las mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs phur gsum/ snying thig gong 'og sogs snga 'gyur bka' babs kyi chu bo bzhi dang 'brel ba'i bka' sater gyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu/ mdor na gsang sngags rnying ma pa dang / sa ngor tshar gsum/ bka' gdams sazhung pa/gdams ngab pa/ man ngag pa ste brgyud srol chen po gsum/zhibaka' rgyud che bzhi chung brgyad/ shangs chos pa/ byed dang /gcod yul ba/ zhwa lu pa/ jo nang pa/ bo dong pa/ ri bo dge ldan 26

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4྾pa rnams kyi bka' srol la gzhung bshad/ dbang lung / khrid/snyan brgyud cha lag dang bcas pa gang yod thams cad grub mtha'i phyogs ris dang / cher rlom gyi khengs dregs/ skyo ngal dang chog shes sogs yong ye med par gsan cing / phal cher re re'am lan grangs mang por gsan/ de dag kyang 'ol tshod mun pa lag nom gyis btsal ba'i lugs ma yin par/ chos brgyud de dang de'i dam pa gong ma gsan rgya che shos rnams kyi gsan yig la 'i/ba tu gzigs nas so sor chos kyi rnam grangs ji lta bu yod pa dang /deng sang chos brgyud ma nub par du yod/ rgyun de phyogs gang du bla ma su la gtugs na rnyed par 'gyur sogs rtog dpyod mdzad pa'i gzhir bsnyel tho 'bral spang zhig mdzad nas mdo khams dang /dbus gtsang / mon bod kyi mtshams la thug par sku tshegs dang chos sgug brel phongs sogs la mi gzigs par lo mang po'i bar du bung ba sbrang rtsi 'dod pa'i tshul gyis gshegs te legs par btsal/de'ang thob yig gi kha grangs mang ba tsam don du gnyer ba ma yin par gang gsan de 'dris par bslab/ mtshan mo'i mar me'i snang ba tshun chad la dpe cha gzigs/ bla ma'i drung du yang yang gtugs nas zhun thar bcad/ dpe rgyun dkon po rnams 'bad pa chen pos dpe bshu mdzad/ zhal shes gsung sgros sogs phyag 27

ngo da/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga mchan dang brjed byang du btab/ sgrub pa'i me tog dang phyag rdzas kyi phud kyis bla ma mnyes par byas nas lan cig ma yin par gsol ba btab ste zhus pa sha stag yin/ lan re gsan pa'am gzigs pas kyang gdams ngag gi gnad phigs pa'i shes rab kyi rtsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas nyid kyi yongs 'dzin rnams kyang thugs phrogs te/ gtsang paṇa chen dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma dang / zhwa lu mchog sprul rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan skyong sogs kyis 'jam dbyangs bla ma zhes ched du bsngags pa'i cod pan dkar po dbu la gsol/ gtsang stod sa chen phug par smrar seng gi sgrub pa mdzad tshe nyams dang rmi lam lta bu ma yin par rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs me tog ut+pal sngon po kha phye ma thag pa gur gum sazhon nu lta bu'i 'od zer gyi drwa bas mdzes pa'i rnam par dngos su byon nas thugs kar thim ste byin gyis brlabs shing /slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med dang / ye shes zhabs sogs sa mthor bzhugs pa'i paṇa grub sngon byon mang po dang dngos su mjal nas chos kyi bdudaXrtsi bzhes te 'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog sanyis sogs dang / 'phags pa'i longs spyod mnyam pa nyid brnyes/mdor na chos tshul phyogs med pa sbyangs/ mkhas pa 'jus pa'i lam srol mang po gzigs/ grub thob kyi brgyud pa mang po'i byin 28

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4rlabs zhugs/ zab rgyas kyi gdams pa mang po'i mdzod du gyur/thugs dam gyi lha'i zhal gzigs shing zab mo'i blo gros kyi gter kha byin/ nyin mtshan 'khor yug tu dam pa'i chos nyan bshad 'bri klog gi bya bas dus 'da'/ de'i dbang gis bstan pa thams cad kyi dpal mgon dang / skal bzang chos don gnyer ba rnams kyi re gnas/ sa gsum na sgron me 'dzin pa gcig pur gyur pa yin no/ /thos don sgrub pa snying por mdzad de grub pa'i go 'phang brnyes tshul la rje nyid tha ma'i mdzad pa ston du nye ba'i tshe/ nye gnas 'jam dbyangs legs pa'i blo gros la bka' gdams chos 'byung chen mo dang / rje btsun mi la'i rnam thar klog tu bcug nas gsan cing / rang nyid kyis kyang gzigs nas bya btang dang /dben pa kho na la dgyes pa'i stangs chen po mdzad/ de mthar sa lam gyi rnam bzhag 'ga' re dang / dus 'khor dang rdzogs chen sogs kyi lam phan tshun dod thub sgrig lugs sogs bka' bstsal ba'i 'phros su/ nga yang tshogs lam 'bring po tsam la slebs pa yin pa 'dra zhes gsangs pas mtshon te/ le btsan snying thig bi/ da bca da lung bstan du/ gsang ba sus kyang brtags par dka' ba/ ltar snang tha mal pa rnams dang shin tu mnyam par spyod pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dus thams cad du sbas pa'i brtul zhugs kho na la 29

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig nga nga nga cad/ nga sang chen po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / theg rgyal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi glegs bam gtad nas bstan pa thams cad kyi bdag por dbang bskur jing nyid dang rnam dbyer med par byin gyis brlabs/ btsug lag khang de'i sgo drung na me phung chen po zhig 'bar ba ba/zigs nas/ der dbang med lta bur zhugs pas rags lus lhag med du sbyangs/ bi ma la mi tra dngos yin snyam pa'i 'od skur lam me song ba gzibs/'di la rje rang gi bka' las/ nga lo bco lnga'i dus su 'phags yul rdo rje gdan gyi ke'u tshang rim dgu'i sgo drung du sbyin sreg byas tshe lus ngag yid gsum thams cad tshig /shul na 'od gsal gyi rig pa rkyang pa zhig lus 'dug /de nas bzung ste rig pa nyag gcig de ma gtogs gzhan gang yang mi 'dub rtogs 'bul byed mkhan mang po byung ste/ nga dang mthun pa su ma byung zhes gsungs te 'di ni mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po ches/ lha lung sga brag la bya ltar lding / /ba gam can brag la byi ltar 'dzul/ /skyes pho mo 'gas grub thob grub thob zer/ /de grub thob kyi bo ba da mi len/ /chos nyams blangs kyi nyams snang thob tsam yin/ /don 'pho 'gyur bral ba ma rtogs na/ /lus sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul bya byis ston/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ gsang sngags bla med spyi 3

n+d+ran+d+ra 4/ tram̐྾4྾྾ rdo grub 'jisa~X zing hūṃ thuspyan+d+ra ñtsha~X/—————dang / khyad par rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i man ngag sga gnad shesapas bltas na mchog gi dngos grub kyi rtse mor phyin pa yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan zhib par bshad du yod kyang / thin tu gsang ba'i gnas yin pas bzhag go/ /lo de'i phyi mar rnga yab gling du slob dpon chen po pad+mas ngo mtshar bka' babs kyi sasang mdzod bdun la dbang sgyur bar rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags thing /gter ston grub thob yongs kyikhyu mchos tu mnga' bsol/ de lta ra na sngon nas lam basboms pas tshe 'dir rtsol med rang grub tu byung ba 'di lta bu la dam pa gong ma rnams rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor pa dang / rang byung gi grub thob ces gsu ngas te sku tshe 'dir dngos grub sgrub pa'i ngal ba la mi ltos kyang kong du ji skad smos pa'i dgos dbang gzigs nas/ sku na gzhon dus klong chen snying thig bi sngon 'gro'i khrid sbyang rgyas par btang / slad nas gter phyogs sngon 'gro'i khrid dang / bka' gdams lam rim dang blo sbyong bi skor gung bsgribs nas nyams bzhes kyi mthil du bzung / bya rgyud rig gsum spyi dang rnam 'joms gdugs dkar sogs bye zag dang / rnam snang mngon byang / rdor dbyings/ kun rig /bde dgyes banyis dang dus 'khor/ gu ru zhi drag skor mang ngo/ bka' brgyad dang phur ba lugs srol bcu dgu tsam/ mdo sgyu gnyis 3 2

nga nga bla ma'i dal 'byor nyams len khridang ga pod /nga ba sogs dkyil 'khor gyi lha mang po'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg dang bcas pa rang rang so so'i brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes 'khrul med ltar mdzad/de dag gi tshe yang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod brgyud pa'i bla ma dang bcas pas zhal bstan cing / rnal 'byor ma'i zhabs mtheb las byung ba'i bdud rtsis rdo rje gsam gyi lang tsho rgyas ༄pa dang / 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo yi ge bcu pa'i sgra dbyangs can mngon sum du byon te/ thusas rgyud 'od gsal gye dbyings su 'dres pas dgongs pa'i gter kha rdol ba dang / rig 'dzin dasa' rab rdo rjes sde gsum rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa satad pa dang / rang byung pad+ma rgyal pos lan cig ma yin par dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa sogs rtsa gsum lhag pa'i lha sa rjes su bzung ba'i rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang thugs sgam pas cher mi gsung / myur mdzad nag po chen po dang zhing skyong stobs 'at+pag dbang po sku lus dang grib ma'i tshul du bzhugs nas phrin las thams cad bzhed pa bzhin sgrub/ sngags srung e ka tsa tis mkha' 'gro'i chos mdzod kyi glegs bam mang po dngos su phul ba sogs rdo rje'i chos srung thams cad bran bzhin byed/ byes pa ltar ma khengs shing 'grogs na bde ba'i ngang tshul can yin yang rang snang dbang du 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyis lugs gnyis nas gzi brjid che 33

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bar snyams pa sus kyang gzi brjid mi bzod par zhum bzhin du 'dud/ rnyed bkur gyi phyir du bla ma 'tshong ba dang / mdun du chos zhu zhing phag tu skur zhu gtong ba dang / phrag dog gis gsol ngan 'dren pa sogs log sgrub mkhan ji snyed cig byung yang bag tsam thugs bayos pa'i mtshan ma yang med par phyi phyir phan 'dogs pa kho na la dgyes/ che gnyan rnams kyis 'bul chen btegs pa na nga la sdig ro 'bel ba red ces mi dgyes shing /sprang po sobs kyis rdzas ngan ngon cis phul yang / 'di phyug po tshos brgya 'bul gyi dod yin/ a re sha tsha zhes phyag tu bzhes nas bsngo smon gnang ba sogs dman pa dang phongs pa la lhag par brtse bar mdzad/ res shis kong sprul rdo rje 'chang rdzong posar du yun mi ring tsam bzhugs nas lo mjug dus gtor skabs rang sanas su phebs grabs mdzad pa sasan nas kong sprul rin po che re zhig bzhugs na chos 'chad nyan byed rgyu mang po yod de/ sku rim mang po dgos gsungs nas phebs rgyu yin skad/ khong lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa la srung rim gto chog rigs kyis ci bya/ nga rang tshos ni lus ngag yid gsum 'di sems can thams cad kyi glud du bsngos nas smon lam 'debs pa ma gtogs/ mi tshe 'di la rang don du glud mdzu gu tsam dang / gtor ma mjeb tshe gang yang bsngo ma myong 34

blama'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4zhes gsungs shing / rgyal khams nang 'khrugs chen po zhig 'byung la nye ba'i tshe sde 'khrugs kyi sna 'dren byed pa'i 'byung po ma rungs pa rnams la nyid kyi sku che'i lhag ma lo brgyad zas skal du byin nas zhi bar mdzad pa sogs bdag bas sazhan gces kyi spyod pa 'ba' zhig lhur len/ gang du bzhugs kyang tshul khrims kyi dri bzang mtshungs pa med pa khor yug tu ldang zhing / gtum mo'i bde drod lhag par 'bar bas mgo rgyal gyi zla ba'i grang sgang la yang gzims spyil nang du tshad pa gzhung rgyas kyi dus ltar gos stan chib rkyang la brten dgos pa dang / thog khar kha ba babs tshad de ma thag zhu nas mi 'chag pa bsnyon med du mthong yang sngon dus khang dmar mdor gter chen mchog gling dang lhan cig ras 'bud btang zhing / 'khyaṭa pa zhu ba'i nus pa bstan pas der 'khod thams cad ngo mtshar du gleng ba na/ mi gson po'i lus la drod los yod/de la ya mtshan gang yang med ces gsungs par grags/ nyag dmag gis rdzong gsar dgon mes bsreg dus/ rje nyid bzhugs pa'i sku 'khris kyi skar khung nang nas mi lce dmar zing zing byung bar snyems med kho nar bzhugs pas de nyid du me zhi ste/ de phan chad kyi khang pa gzhan rnams kyang ma tshig pa dang / sde dge'i spar khang chen po'i gyang la rig 'dzin rdo rje drag rtsal gyi sku rten dang /36

z-in+d+ra4/ nga 4 —4ba4rjo3 1 nga ༵sa med bstang ༵sung 'bu~X/4nga nga phyag mtshan rdo rje sbas nas dgongs gtad mdzad pas mes ma tshig/ pa dang / dpal spung yang khrod du nyang gter khros nab gi dbang gnang dus bdud rtsi'i thod pa reg tu mi nus pa tsam du drod 'bar ba dang / dpal dge'i rdo ring mar grags pa'i rdo 'khum la rab gnas kyi dargongs pa mdzad tshe nyin lam lnga drug bi/sa chod pa yin yang der lhag par gnas pa'i me tog char babs pa bzhin byung ba dang / rong me dkar mo stag tshang nas khros gter bzhes skabs ye shes kyi dbongs nyams 'ur te brtul zhugs cho rol gyi spyod pa mang po mdzad pa'i drung du/ sde dge sa dbang dpal ldan 'chi med rtag pa'i rdo rje bzhubs pa'i thong rtsa nas bsnams te brdeg grabs lta bu mdzad pa'i 'jigs zil gyi rkyen las bsam yas su gu ru rin po che dang rje 'bangs 'dus pa zhal 'dzoms nas gter sbed kyi phrin las mdzad pa'i sngon gnas yad yud cig dran zhes chos rgyal nyid kyis phyis su gsungs shing / de dus snyad 'dogs ma rnyed pa lta bus rten 'brel ma 'grigs pa ma gtogs brdung yag byed rgyu byung na rgyal srid la sked nyag mi 'ong ba yin zhes bka' gnang ba dang / mkhan po rin chen dar rgyas la phyab 'bebs gnang bas bar chad kyi 'phrang bsal te tshe tshad lung bstan pa 'dzol med du byung ba sogs dang / zhal ji srid 36

ngo da/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ba ྾ ྾r+yā—྾྾bzhag cing ngal bso/ gsol 'debs kyi sngags la/ o āḥhūṃ ni bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum skul ba'i sngags yin la/ oṃ byin rlabs 'byung ba/ āḥdangos grub ༅ ba/ hūṃ phrin las myur ba'i sngags su bshad tshul sogs gzhan mang yang / 'bru bsum 'di ka ris 'dzin bla ma spyi'i bsnyen sngags su gsungs pa'ang yod la/ mtshan sngags gzhan dang sbrags tshe/ thog mar sbyar ba dang /mtshan de 'bru gsum gyi sgrom nas bzla ba'i phyogs tha dad yod pa las 'dir phyi ma'o/ /gu ru ni bla ma ste sngar brjod zin/ mañdzu ghoṣa ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs te sbrel bas 'jam dbyangs bla ma'am bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes par 'gyur/ de'ang rje 'di mnga' bdag nyang dang / rad gling sogs kyi gter lung mang por 'jam dbyangs zhes pa'i mtshan sgras bstan te/ slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang gsang gsum dbyer med du gyur pa'i cha nas sam/ satso bor gter lung mang po dang rnam thar sogs las rgyas par gsungs pa ltar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa'i sku btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi skye mtha' yin pa'i phyogs nas bstan pa'o/ /da lta kho nar bi ma mi tra'i sprul pa'i skur bshad nga1 brjed dam/ khri srong dang bi ma la dus mnyam yon mchod yin pas gnyis kar ji ltar rung zhe na/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting mtha' 38

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig nga pod/4 4'dzub mos tshol ba bya ba de 'dra la zer/ sangs rgyas mang po'i chos sgu sprul pa'i sku gcig tu mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas gcig gi chos sku sprul pa'i sku mang po la brten pa'i rnam gzhag rgyas par yod de spros pas chog go/ /der ma zad rgyal sras sa dang po thob pas kyang skad cig re rer sku'i bkod pa brgya/ 'khor brgya phrag bcas te ston pa sogs bshad pas bsam mi khyab bsam pa'i ngal ba mi bya ste/ mgo rmongs par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /rnam grangs gzhan du 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhes pa ni 'phags pa'i gang zag gcig cig kho nar mi bzung ste/ rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes kyi sku de la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' zhes brjod pa yin pas/sangs rgyas pa dang / rgya 'gyur thams cad 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi ngo bor mngon par byang chub pa sha stag yin te/ de ltar na zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku brnyes pa nyid kyis 'jam dpal rdo rje'i ngo bor bzhag chog pas/ mtha' gcig tu sngon gyi 'khrungs rabs 'tshol ba'i 'bad pa la ltos dbos pa'ang min no//gang ltar yang bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi ngo bo nyid du bzhugs pas 'jam dbyangs bla ma zhes mtshan gsol ba yin gyi/ zam ze'i nga seng ge min yang / ming seng ge zhes btags pa lta bu ni btan min no/ /de lhar gdung dbyangs kyis 39

pod/ 4 no grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'gum/—ba ba ma ma 4ma —4ra ba bam ra ba ba — — ba ba ————ma ba ba ba mtshan nas bos te zhu rgyu ci yod snyam na/ sarba sidzhai hūṃ zhes pa dngos grub thams cad stsol cig pa ste/ dngos grub la mchos thun mong gnyis/ thun mong la las phra mo'i dngos grub dang / grub pa chen po brgyad sogs mang du yod/ tshig btsan pa/ 'khor mang ba/longs spyod che ba/ g.yul las rgyal ba sogs kyang dngos grub kyi grangs su yod mod de/ rang cag 'dra ba la de rnams thob kyang phung 'tsheng sang gi bzhir 'gro cha med pas/ thag mkhan rkang 'a sa brgyad pa'i gtam rgyud ltar ma song bar gtan tu 'tsheng nges kyi dngos grub gcig zhu dgos/ de la sna kha mang ba mi gtso/ ba/cig chog snying po gcig la mthil gtad dgos pas/ bla ma'i byin rlabs rang rgyud la zhugs/ rang gi sgo gsum bla ma dang 'dres nas/bla ma'i 'od gsal thugs kyi thig ler mngon par byang chub par mdzad pa zhig dpal ldan bla ma khyed rang mkhyen no zhes sngar ltar phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /rjes la dbang blang ba ni/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas bla ma nyid shin tu dgyes shing thugs rje'i shugs lhag par g.yos te dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba la phyogs par gyur pa'i spyi bor sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skru rdo rje'i rang bzhin oṃ yig dkar po/ mgrin par sasung rdo rje'i rang bzhin āḥdamar po/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin hūṃ sngon 0

pod/ 4 rdogrub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga rgyas kyi rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug ye shes rdo rje ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ba rgyud la bzhag pa'i sgo nas dbang bzhi ba thob par bsam/ 'di ni sngar bla ma las dbang bskur thob nas sdom pa'i rgyun ma btang bar yod pa de nyid nus pa gong 'phel du byed pas lam gyi dbang zhes bya la/ mang du blang na nyams chag skong ba dang / byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs kyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ /ting 'dzin dbang len 'di dab/ ci tsam du dmigs pa gsal zhing brtan pa de tsam du nus pa che bas/ dal pos gsal btab cing mos pa yid byed the tshom dang bral bar bya ba gal che'o/ /dbang gi ye shes dngos sam rjes mthun gyi nus pa ci riṭa skyes pa rnams lhag par rtsal rdzogs shing brtan par bya ba'i ched dang / gtso bor dbang bzhi ba'i rjes 'brel du thugs yid sre ba ni/ bla ma nyid 'od kyi thig le dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ snum la 'dril ba/ dwangs shing gsal la 'od zer kha dog lnga 'bar ba/ phra ba'i dbang du byas na yungs 'bru'am sran ma lta bu/ yangs pa'i dbang du btang na chos kyi dbyings kyis khyab tshad shong ba tshad 'di tsam zhes bsam par dka' ba'i gzugs su gyur nas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying dbus mi shigs pa'i thig ler thim pas mthar thug don gyi bla ma brjod bral gnyug ma sems 4 2

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyamasalen khrid yig nga nga /4 4kyi rdo rje/ don dam 'od gsal rdzogasapa chen po'i rang zhal/tshig dang yid dpyod kyi shun pas ma bsgribs par rjen ne mthong byung snyam du mos pa brtan po bzhag ste/ lam 'bras/ phyag chen/rdzogs chen sogs sngar rang nyid gang la 'dris cha che ba'i grub thob kyi man ngag bzhin gnas lugs zab mo'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag /de las ldang ba na/ bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam khyer gsum gyi man ngag dang / le'u bdun ma'i bla ma sbu gsum ma'i zab khrid sogs las 'byung ba bzhin rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo gshis brjod med/ mdangs 'gag med/ rtsal mos gus su dung nge ba'i ngang ma shor bar byas la/ snang grag rig gsam de ka'i ༄rang snang / dpal ldan bla ma'i sku gsung thub/sa kyi rnam rol 'ba' zhig tu blta ba bslab cing / dga' brod nga sems sogs dang ma 'dres pa'i mos gus rnam par dag pa'i rgyas gdab/ stan thog gcis/ tu bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pas mtshon dus gsum gyi dge ba mtha' dag rang gzhan sems can thams cad chos rje bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che yang yang mthong ba dang / sangs rgyas su ngo shes pa dang / de'i gdams ngag gi snod du 'gyur ba dang /zab dang rgya che'i lam gyi band thams cad tshang bar ston pa dang /ji skad bstan pa bzhin du 'bad pa thams cad kyis nyams su 3

nga nga —/ nga 4 —44 rdo grubang ༵ med bsta na nga ༵sung 'bum/4 4nga 4blangs te/ ring por mi thogs par kun bzang chos rje bla ma'i thugs klong du rnam par grol ba dang / tshe 'dir btsan sa ma zin na 'chi khar rang dbang 'phros pa'i gnad gcod kyi sdug bsngal dang / chags sdang gi yul rkyen ngan pa sogs mi 'byung bar rang sems bla ma la sre ba'i ting 'dzin lhag par las su rung ste 'chi ba 'od gsal la brtan pa thob pa dang / de ma thob par srid nga bar dor 'khyams na bla ma rjes su dran zhing sku'i snang ba dang mjal nas mkha' spyod sogs rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing khyad par can du khrid de lam gyi 'phro rdzogs par byed cing ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med du 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyur bsngo bas mtshams sbyar/ thun mtshams thams cad du'ang / bla ma'i bka' drin dang yon tan ston pa'i mdo bstan brtsos blta zhing don la bsam/ zas za ba na phud kyis bla ma mchod cing khrid gzhung gzhan ltar bla ma nyid mgrin pa'am snying khar spyan drangs la bza' btud tshogs mchod du shes pas longs spyod/ bang du 'dug kyang dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs drung na gnas pa'i 'du shes kyis bag med kyi spyod pa spangs la sgo sasum tshal khrims la ci tshad bya/ nyal ba na snying ga'i dbu ra nga ma'i nang du bla ma'i sku shin tu phra ba mar me ltar 'od gsal ba bzhugs pa la sems gtad de gnyid kyi rnal 'byor bsgom/ dus 4

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4— ྾ ྾4྾nam yang bla ma la dad pa med cing sdang ba dang dam sel yod pa'i mi dang mi 'grogs/ bla ma'i mtshan brjod pa na yang / bla ma lnga bcu par/ de yi mtshan smos brjod na ni/ /ming mthar zhal snga ldan par bya/ /gzhan dag gus par bya ba'i phyir/ /khyad par can gyi tshig dag brjod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ gus pa ma bskyed pa dang / rje bla ma'am/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang zhes pa lta bu'i tshis ma/ sbyar bar mi brjod pa sogs/ mdor na thun dang thun mtshams kyi dge sbyor phra mo nas phan tshun grogs su 'gro ba la bslab par bya'o//'khor ba'i 'brog dgon las dang nyon mongs dang / /sdub bsngal gcan gzan khro bos sang ba 'dir/ /yid 'byung skyes na thar pa'i grong mchog tu/ /bgrod pa'i lam ston bla ma nyag gcig las/ /blo gtad re ltos gzhan du yod min pas/ /kanyen grosas srid sde gyod dang tshong khe sogs/ /tshe 'di'i bya ba ngan pa rgyang bsrings te/ /mos gus bla ma'i lam la mi tshe skyol/ /phyug kyang thams cad bzhab nas lag stong 'gro/ /dar yang stong sde'i nang nas bcig pur 'khyar/ /btsan yang las kyis khrid nas dbang med 'phyan/ /tshe 'di'i phun tshogs dngos kun de 'drar zad/ /skyid kyang mi 'tsheng skyid ske 'chi bas gcod/ /sdug kyang mi phung tshe mjug dgun nyi 'dra/ 'chi bdag rgyal po nam 'ong mi shes kyis/ /rang mgo ma 6

bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams len khrid yig pod/ 4྾ — 444྾rlabs la/ /yid ches brtan pos 'jigs skrag zil gyis mnan/ /shi nas bla ma gar bzhugs dag pa'i zhing / /theg mchog chos kyi 'byor pas brgyan par 'gro/ /de ltar tshe 'di bde la phyi mar skyid//dus rnams kun tu 'tsheng ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /rnyed pa mang ste rnyed nas za ba nyung / /bsod nams ldan lo tshim par ba'es su gsol/ /bdag kyang dam pa'i zhabs pad la bsten cing / /de yi zhal gdams bdud rtsis yid dbang sim/ /bla ma'i dbang gyur bka' bzhin sgrub pa yis/ /thugs zin g.yog po skyo ngal speng bar shog /bla ma'i rnal 'byor ye shes mchog s+dzawī nyams su len tshul khrid yig du byas pa 'di ni/ chos 'di la nyams len mthil por 'dzin pa'i yid lhung lha ri bla ma karma nges don chos kyi rgya mtshos/ gser dang / sman tse yug /spos bam sogs gnang rten dang bcas snga phyir nan tan chen pos gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/rje btsun bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thusas rje chen po dang ldan pa de'i zhabs kyi rdul spyi bos blangs shing / bsung gi bdud rtsi snying gi za ma tos du 'khyil ba'i rdo rong gi sprang po mkhos ngan yang skal ba bzang bar rlom pa/ 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas blo thog nas gang dran lhug par bris pa 'dis kyang 'gro kun dpal ldan bla mas rjes su 'dzin par gyur cig /sarba dā maṅgalo// / /7
za la nye ‘da du ban+d+ras bathutha

nga bang nga/ ba nga rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga nga / /na mo gu ru bh+ya/ 'khor ba'i chu mtshor snying rje'i 'dab stong rgyas/ /de dbus ye shes lang tshor rab rdzogs pa/ /pad+ma 'byung gnas rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal/ /snying dbus zangs mdog dpal rir 'bral med bzhukas/ /ji skad du dgongs 'dus lung bstan bka' rgya mar rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling ba lung ston pa na/ 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'phen pa 'byungaḥ zhes gsungs te// gtso bor bla ma'i phyi sgrub yid bzhin nor ba la ༄brten nas 'brel tshad ris 'dzin gyi zhing du 'gro ba'i lung don mngon du gyur par sa/ter 'byung dang / rnam thar chen mo las gsungs pas/ 'dir bla rnam 'di la dpal ri'i zhing du bgrod pa'i man ngag gi sand ji ltar mthong ba rnams zin bris su bya ste/spyir gdul bya rab dang spyar na bla sgrub 'di dngos gzhi'i nyams rtogs kyi sgo 'byed du 'gyur tshul kho na bshad dgos pa yin kyang / 'dir gdul bya tha ma skye ba phyi ma la grol du re ba'i bsam ngo dang bsnyun nas brjod do/ /de la bcu gnyis las/dang po ni/ snang bas gar khyab pad+ma 'od kyi zhing dngos su sgo ma par sasungs pa de yin te/ de'ang rgya mapa'i nang na sau ma pū ri dang ma la ya ste dag pa mkha' spyod dang mtshungs pa'i zhing gi mchog gnyis sogs ya mtshan dang 'jibs zil gnyis ka che ba'i 60

bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4nga srin po'i yul gling chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus na gnam sngon sa la 'khyil ba lta bu'i mtsho chen po yod/ de'i lte bar zangs mdog dpal ri che zhing mtho la lhun chags pa/ ngos rnams la lar spin po'i grong khyer dang / kha cig tu gzhal med khang nyams dga' ba/ gzhan du dur khrod kyi bkod pa/ dpa' bo ḍāk+ki tshogs kyi dga' ston la rtse ba sogs ngo mtshar du mas mdzes shing brjid pa'i steng gi mthil yangs shing rgya che ba la/ dpag bsam gyi nag/sa tshal dang / bdud rtsi'i chu mig /zla ba nor bu'i brag ne'u sing me tog rgyas pa/ mkha' 'gro brda'i glu gar la mkhas pa'i bya dang bung ba khyus lding ba/ spu sdug/ ri dwags rtsed 'jos dregs pa la sogs pas brgyan pa/ gos rgyan khri stan bza' ngatung sogs yo byad ci 'dod 'bad med du 'byung ba/ bar snang thams cad 'ja' tshon gyi dra ba bres pa'i lam nas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro nyi zer gyi rdul bzhin 'khrigs pa/ gsang sngags kyi dzab dbyangs dang / rdo rje'i gru gar rol mo'i sgra du mas skad cig la snang ba bde chen du sgyur ba/ de'i dbus na pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal med khang nor bu sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin khra phung nge ba/ gzi brjid mig gis balhar mi bzod pa lta bu/ shar zhi ba chos kyi tshogs khang dang /lho rgyas pa longs spyod kyi tshogs khang sobs bkod pa'i khyad par 6

nga bcad/ ba rdo grub 'jigs med bsta nanyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga nga thoṭa med dang zhi ba lha/ chos kyi grags pa sogs nas/ dpal ldan a ti sha sogs bstan pa spyi dang khyad par sngags phyogs la phyag rjes che ba'i paṇa grub phal cher tshig zin la thon cing /de'ang bla sgrub rtsa ba'i bzhung la mkha' 'gro'i brda sgyur ji ltar gnas pa nyid yin par sbyar byang du 'byung ngo / /bzhi pa ni/ slob dpon rin po che sadul bya 'dren pa'i thugs rje la bayel ba med kyang / rang cag la phrin las myur du 'jus pa lam 'di ston pa'i bla ma'i mtshams sbyor la ltos te rdzing chu zhing la 'dren pa yur ba'i mtshams sbyor la ltos pa bzhin no/ /de'ang dang por brgyud ldan gyi bla mas rigs 'dus gu ru'i ting nge 'dzin gyis o rgyan rin po che'i sku dang zhing khams mtha' dag rang nyid kyi ngo bor bsgrubs nas 'o skol la dbang bsgur ba ni pad+ma 'od kyi rgyal srid gtad pa yin la/ de'ang bla mas de ltar mos pa rkyang pa tsam min par o rgyan pad+ma dngos nyid de'i tshe slob dpon gyi lus la zhugs nas byin gyis zlob par rgyud sde rgya mapa'i lung gis grub pas rang cag zhing 'dir 'jus pa la dbang ba'i rtsa ba'i gnad ni de yin no/ /de ltar rtsa ba'i bla mas dbang bskur ba'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun de nyid slar yang rang gis kha gsos te tshad la 'bebs pa'i ched du bla ma dang o rgyan pad+ma tha mi dad du bltas 64

bla dam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4nas bzlas sgom la brtson par byed pa yin pas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dngaḥ dbyer med mtsho skyes rdo rje sprul pa'i skuḥ zhes gsungs te 'o skol skyabs yu la thams cad kyi nang nas 'brel ba che shos rtsa ba'i bla ma yin pas de'i drung du skye ba sgrub sla la/ 'dir rtsa ba'i bla ma'i spyan sngar skye sla ba de ka zangs mdog dpal rir skye sla ba'i don du yang sgrub lugs kyi dbang gis song yod pas sand kyi dam pa gcis go//lnga pa ni/ 'dir slob dpon chen po'i zhal mjal ba tsam zhig sgrub pa'ang min gyi/ gu ru nyid sku dngos kyis 'khor skyong zhing rtag tu bzhugs pa'i phyobs su/ skye gnas kyi che ba'am skye ba'i risas kyi che bas dwangs gsal phra yang sogs gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i rig 'dzin gyi lus khyad par can thob nas gu ru'i zham ring du gnas shing / chos kyi mdzod bzung ste/ mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba 'dren pa'i phrin las par sgrub pa yin pas gsol 'debs rkyang ba la rtsal du bton pa lta bus mi chog gi rdo rje jeg pa'i bsags sbyang spel gsum gyi sgo mang po nas rten 'brel bsgrig dgos pas gnad bsdus yan lag bdun pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /so sor sbyar na rgyal ba'i mchod rten la phyag byas pas sa rdul grangs snyed kyi 'khor sgyur 'thob par gsungs shing / 'dir 66

bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4dga' ba'i sgo gsum skyed byed kyi rtsa rlung thig le'i cha mang po yod par rgyud klong gsal dang sgyu 'phrul gsang thig sogs las gsungs te/ de rnams kyi dpal gcog pa ni rig drug bsreg sbyong zhes gnas lung gi zab gnad de/ bde chen dag pa'i gnas su 'gro ba'i lam shul po che bzhin du dbye ba la grogs byed kyi thabs mkhas phul du byung ba yin la/ de yang 'dir/ oṃ gyi 'od kyis lus kyi las dang rtsa'i sgrib pa dag /āḥ'i 'od kyis ngag gi las dang rlung gi sgrib pa dag sogs kyi khongs su spu ris zin na ji lta ba bzhin tshang ba dang / rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa bon thebs/zhes sosas de 'dra rib 'dzin bzhi ka'i gsungs las kyang ris/ 'dzin gyi gral du 'jug pa'i nus pa skyed tshul gsal bar thon pa sogs dar zhud mi 'then par zhib tu brtabs na shes par 'gyur ro/ /dbang len skabs 'dir 'khor gyi bla ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyang gtso bo dang dgongs pa gcig tu bzhukas nas dbang skur ba'i mdzad pa la thugs gtad par bsam na byin rlabs kyi tshan che bar rtogs so/ /brgyad pa ni/ gter gzhung 'dir pad+ma 'od du bgrod pa la dmigs phug pa'i gsol 'debs/ nam zhig tshe yi/ sogs gsol 'debs dkyus ma las 'bur don du yod pa rdo rje'i gsung 69

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—ba ba—ba — bam 4ba ba ba 4 4ba ba —b.rab — ba —྾྾byin rlabs che yang yid legs par gtad nas rgyud dang 'dres nges ma byas na sasol ba mi jeb pas/ gsol ba snying gi dkyil nas 'debasaḥ kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin noḥ zhes gsungs pa yin kyang don ci yin la blo kha tsam yang mi phyogs par bayas lta g.yon nyan phu 'khyar mdo bsam gyi ngang la/ kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin noḥ zhes tshogs zhing la rdzun lab pa ni spyi brtol ha cang ches te/ rang gzhan su la brtags kyang de 'dra mang ngo / /thing sgrub kyi dus su sasol 'debs 'di bdun nam nyer sacig sosab/ bskyar yang legs par sems so/ /dgu pa ni/ zhing mchog bgrod pa'i dmigs rim gyi dngos gzhi yin te// de'ang gu ru nyid bdas la lhag par dgongs te zhal 'dzum pa mdzad cing spyan dgyes chags kyi rnam par g.yo ba'i ngang la thugs ka nas bde chen snying rje'i 'od dmar byin rlabs kyi tsha drod can nyi ma shar ba bzhin du 'byung ba ni rang pad+ma 'od du 'dren pa'i dpyang thag dang bsu ba'i sa mkhan yin te/ de snying kar reg pa'i rkyen gyis rang gi sgo sasum gyi snyigs ma sbyangs te mos gus kyi rang mdangs bde bar shar ba'i dwangs ma'i thig le dmar po skar mda' lta bu'i shugs can du 'dril ba la sems rtse gcig tu satad/ de nyid rta mchog bang kha gar gtad du 'gro ba 60

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4 ྾ ྾྾྾44'debasaḥ zhes lan bcu gsum bar du gsungs pa ltar 'in tu sal che'o/ /'di kho na gtso bor byed tshe/ slar yang rang dang thing bi rnam pa rgya mtsho la gza' skar cig char du shar ba ltar sngar ༷ bzhin bkra lam gyis sad par bltas nas nam zhig ma'i gsol 'debs ci rigs kyi mthar bshad ma thag pa'i tshul kyis thugs yid bsre/ de 'dra ba dkyus rer gsum mam bdun sogs bskyar/'di ni rnam shes bong du 'jug pa'i dmigs gnad yin kyang /lus sems phral nas 'pho ba'i phyogs ma yin pas 'pho rab tshe thung ba'i nyen yang med par gsa' lo/ /bcu pa ni/ rjes la dpal ri'i smon lam 'don pa yang gnad dam pa'o/ /zhes khrid yig gter gzhung gnyis kar gsungs pa ste/ smon lam gyi gzhung 'di la zhing bkod dang smon lam tsam du ma zad/ bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bskyed rdzogs rdzobs chen dang bcas pa'i lam rim gyi brjod bya 'gangs chen po yod pas tshig rjes don dran gyi sgo nas bag chags thebs nges bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ gter gzhung yig chung las rtas par gang du 'dug pa'i gnas zangs mdog dpal ri dngos yin snyam pa las tha mal du mi blta/ zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ thun nang du 6 2

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ bcud rang lus dang bcas pa me long la ha btab pa'i rlangs pa dbus suXyal ba bzhin bsdus nas 'od gsal thig le chen po'i dbyings su sems bsres te gnyid log pas/ legs par 'byongs pa na 'phen pa'i rkyen cung zad tsam gyis zhing khams kyi rten brten pa/ bang 'dod rmi lam du blta bar yang nus so/ /gnyid dang 'chi ba chos mthun pas 'di la goms 'dris legs par brtan na 'chi dus dang bar dor yang sleb pa'i gnad che'o/ /rnam shes dab pa'i zhing du 'pho ba la tshang bug gi lam sbyang ba saces par bshad pa dang / 'dir nyal ldang bi dus su bla ma lam de nas gshegs bzhud mdzad pa'i dmigs rim sasungs pa sanyis bsgrig tshul zhig kyang yod dam brtag par bya'o/ /nyin mtshan gyi rnal 'byor gcig gis gcig la rgyas 'debs tshul dang / zhing sku pho brang gsum so so'i de nyid rang babs gnyug ma'i shes pa skad cig ma gcig la ldog cha tha dad kyi tshul du tshang lugs snying thig rang skad bzhin 'chad tshul gyi gnad phra mo yang yod mod/ /snga ma cung zad shes sla la/ phyi ma dngos bzhi'i zab don yin pas 'dir ma brjod do/ /de dag gi skabs su spyir rang cag bod kyi 'gro ba dang sgo sa zab gter gyi chos la spyod pa rnams gu ru rin po che dang las smon gyi 'brel pa che ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis zhing der skye sla ba'i tshul la 64

rab da che zug ba 11 ba ma zug/da ba dkadapeb / bdabad/pa 'babasam nas spro ba skyed cing / skyes na don che ba'i tshul yang bsam par bya ste/ phal cher sngar bshad pa'i khongs su tshang mod/ 'on kyang tshig sna bsring nas phyogs gcig tu bsdeb na/ gnas der lus srog longs spyod dang dge ba'i phyosas 'grib pa'i snyigs ma'i rgud pa thams cad dag pa rab 'byams ye shes sgyu ma'i rang mdangs stobs sa gyar pa'i rig 'dzin gyi zhing gi che ba dang rig ༄༄ 'dzin mkha' 'gro mthu chen rnams kyi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin dang brtul zhugs grub pa'i nus pas zil gyis mnan nas lam sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i rkyen byed pa dang / rig 'dzin grub pa'i banas kyi 'byor ba mthong na ngo mtshar bar byed pa mthong ba'i mod la snang ba bde chen du 'char ba/ ci tsam 'dris kyang dag snang cher 'gro ba/ gang ltar bltas kyang byin rlabs kyi gting mi mngon pa/ ci 'dod du 'byung ba/ gang mos su snang ba/ yid kyi rjes su byed pa/ gzhan gyis mi 'phrog pa/ dbang 'byor gyi mthu gzugs can du gyur pa lta bu rnams dang phrad pa na/ gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis rlobs pa zhes bya ba'i tshul la nges pa rang dbang med par skyes pa dang / de na lha klu dang mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag na bzhugs pa'i chos kyi gsang mdzod thams cad dbyar gyi me tog ltar shugs rdol la 'byung zhing sngags rang bzhin gyis 'grub 66

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾ ྾྾ ྾mo'i bar gyi rgyal ba'i lam bzang mtha' dag la slob pa'i rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba btsugs te ma byams mas du la slob pa'i tshul du/ po kyi sgrub pa 'di mthar 'ar+ṣa ba zhig dgos/ sangs rgyas dus mthar 'apo ba yin/ 'phro chad na 'apo dus mi 'ong / lo shes rab dang brtson 'grus sogs lam gyi rten 'bre' dman pas tshe 'dir mthar mi 'apo/ phyi mar yang zangs rbab ri sked nas 'gril ba bzhin thur du shor te 'phro chad pa'i nyen che bas klung rdo gyen bzhag thur la mi ldog pa'i ched du/ ngas lo la sgrub sla ba/'khyer bde ba/ lesas par sgrub nas bzung na rig 'dzin gyi gral du de ma thag 'gro ba dngos grub kyi ral gri lta bu'i gdams ngag cig ster zhes sgrub thabs 'di gnang ste/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar chos la brdzang ba 'di gcig pu'i ngang tshul bsam na'ang dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin la gzhal thabs ma mchis pas bka' drin ngo shes nas dran par bya la/ chos kyi yab des brdzangs sar yang 'gro dgos so/ /chos 'di nyams su len pa la sngon du rtsa dbang rgyal thab spyi blugs bskrur nas snod rung du byas pa zhig dgos par kun ma.o nyid kyis gsungs pa go dbos shing / dbang thob kyang dam tshig nyams na rig 'dzin gyi lus rten phar zhos /mi'i skye ba tsam yang rnyed dka' bas khrid yig las/ mos gus dang dam tshig 68

bla rnam la nye bar mkho ba'i yi ge/ pod/ 4྾ ྾rnam par dag pa gang zhig /ces gsungs pa ltar nyams na phyir bcos sogs dam tshib dag pa'i thabs la 'bad pa med mi rung yin la/ gdams ngag yod kyang / da lta khams dwangs/ blo gsal/rang dbang yod dus legs par sbyangs nas gdeng thob par ma byas na/ nam zhig thog babs su 'chi ba'am/ 'chi nad kyis gcur bas 'du shes 'khrugs shing bya spu rlung bskyod bzhin rang dbang dang bral ba'i tshe rtsol ba byed snying mi 'dod cing / byas kyang bsam du mi btub pas ci yang byar med de/ de'i phyir sngon du sbyang ba nges par gal che zhing / 'chi kha dang bar dor 'di bzhin bya dgos snyam du 'phen pa mang du gtong ba yang zab pa'i gnad do/ /de ltar byin rlabs bla ma'i sgrub pa 'di la rtsal thon na tshe phyi mar dngos grub ston dus kyi 'bras bu smin pa ltar 'byung ba lta ci smos/ tshe 'dir yang me tog gi tshul du bsam pa thams cad des 'grub/ bar chad thams cad des sel bas gcig chog yid bzhin nor bu'i 'du shes bskyed de yi dam gyi mthil du bzung bar bya'o/ /sa chu snyigs pas nyam thag phyugs kyi khyu/ /khu byug snyan sgrog glu yis dbugs 'byin na/ /pad 'byung zab gter bdams pa'i rgyud mang glus/ /lnga bdo'i gdung ba 'phrog la ngo mtshar ci1 /legs bshad dpyid kyi dus bzang gzhon nu lo/ /'gro sems 69
ma nga du sheb lu1

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— ྾༄/ /na mo gu ru/ gang zhig bla ma dang dpal o rgyan r+ṣa po tha mi dad du shes pas gsol 'debs kyi sgrub lugs nyams su blang bar 'dod pas/ gnas gtsang mar gu ru'i sku gzugs kyi spyan sngar mchod pa gang 'byor bshams/ ma grub na yid kyi cho ga bya/ sngon du blo legs par bcos te/ dge sems khyad par can gyi ngang nas/bdag gzhan 'jigs pa kun las thar bya'i phyir/ /dkon mchog rnam gsum snying nas skyabs su bzung / /rnal 'byor zab mos byang chub mchog bsgrubs te/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgrol bar sems bskyed do/ /lanagasum/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā sogs/ gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal stong pa nyid/ /kun khyab kun tu snang ba'i rol pa las/ /phyi snod pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal med khang / /nang bcud rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i 'khor lo che/ /de dbus rang nyid mtsho rgyal rnal 'byor ma/ /byu ru'i mdog can zhi 'dzum rjes chags nyams/ / gcer mo rus pa'i rgyan ldan gri thod 'dzin/ /bzhengs stabs mos gus spyan bsum nam mkhar gzigs/ /rang mdun bar snang ye shes 'od lnga'i k+kong / /rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun pad+ma 'byung / /dkar dmar gzhon tshul mtshan dpe'i dpal rab 'bar paṇa zhwa chos bos gsol zhing rdor thod bsnams/ /mchan khung g.yon na sbas yum kha ṭī 'chang / /zhabs zung rdo rje skyil krung pad zlar bzhugs/ /'dzum zhal dgyes pa'i nyams bcas bdab la gzigs//7 2

bla ma dang yo rgyan dbyer med du sgyub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal/ /zhes dmigs te/hūṃ/ o rgyan yul gyi sogs lan gsum mam bdun gyis ye shes pa dang bsre/ ma bcos spros bral sogs/ rdo rje 'chang la phyab 'tshal lo/ /'og min chos kyi sogs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed su dag sogs kyis yan lag bdun pa 'bul/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mkhyen pas zhi ba'i dbyings kyi de nyid gzigs/ /snying rjes srid pa'i 'gro ba rjes su 'dzin/ mkhyen brtses srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis ring spangs pa//dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ /dgongs pa sangs rgyas kun dang rnam dbyer med/ /rgyal ba kun gyi dam chos sgrom gcib pu/ /dus gsum 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams skyed pa'i yab/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bzhugs pa'i gnas mchog dpal ri pad+ma 'od/ /thugs rje'i gdul zhing ris med 'jig rten khams/ /mdzad pa'i cho 'phrul phyogs dus kun tu khyab/ /spyod yul tshad med khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag 'dra shugs drag nyon mongs chu bos khyer/ /las kyi dbang gis snyigs ma'i 'dam du byings/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen rlung mar bzhin du 'tshubs/ /thar bar 'dod kyang phyi phyir 'og tu ltung / /'jig rten bla ma'i nyin byed chos dbyings mnal/ /bstan 'dzin phal cher de yi phyi bzhin nub/ /skyabs med mgon 7 3

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs medabastan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—— —med lnga bdo'i gcong rong du/ /'o dod 'bod pa bdag la thugs rjes gzisas/ / ni sangs rgyas gdul bya'i lhag ma rnams/ /lhag par sgrol la sras bcas rgyal ba yis/ /dbang bskur nor bu'i cod pan dbu la gsol/ /nyam thag skyob nus seng ge'i sgra yang sgrog /de phyir bdag ni lo mgo gtad cing / /lo min re sa bzhan du mi tshol gyis/ /ye shes pad+ma'i spyan gyis legs gzigs nas/ /thugs rje'i phyag yangs rgyas pas rjes su zungs/ /lo zhal rjes dran lo kyi rnam thar sems/ /lo mtshan gsang lngags rgyal po zlo byed pa/ /bdag la mthu rtsal ci mchis 'dir zad pas/ /rje lo dgongs pa'i dus ni 'di lags so/ /'di nas byang chub bar gyi tshe rabs kun/ /mgon za bdag gi bla mar 'gyur ba dang / /bsam sbyor dag pas lo thugs mnyes byas nas/ /bka' drin bdud rtsis 'tsho bar byin gyis rlobs/ /srid pa'i bde 'byor dpal la mi chags par/ /gtan 'dun chos kyi bde bas yid drangs te/ /'jig rten 'dren pa'i bstan la rab 'byung zhing / /tshul khrims srog ltar bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs/ /khyad par theg mchog bstan pa'i gnad kyi mthil/ /rlabs chen snying rjes drangs pa'i sems bskyed dang / /spyod pa rgya mapho dpung dang ldan pa yi/ /nges don lam bzang rnyed par 7‘1

bla ma dang yo rgyanadabyer med du spub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4gsol/ /dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid/ /phul byung ye shes mchog gi sku ru gsal/ zhes brjod/ ji snyed su dag sogs/yan lag bdun pa bya zhing phyag 'tshal/ de mthar phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa ni/'jigs med theb/ mchog chos kyi seng ge'i sgras/ /tshul gnyis bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag rgyud 'phags pa'i lam du bsgyur byin rlobs/ /zhes mang du brjod cing bsam/ spro na rgyang 'bod rkang pa bcu drug pa bya ste/ mkhyen no mkhyen no drin can gyi bla ma/ /gzigs shig gzigs shig thugs rje yi mnga' bdag /dag pa gnyis ldan chos nyid kyi klong nas/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i nom rol gyis bzhengs shog /bde gshegs kun dngos dpal ldan gyi bla ma/ /thar lam ston mdzad byang chub kyi sa mkhan/ /thugs rjes skyongs shog khams gsum gyi 'dren pa/ /byin rlabs stsol shog drin chen gyi chos rje/bka' drin 'khor med rje btsun kyi bla ma/ /skyob pa mtshungs med srid zhi yi gdung sel/ /thugs rjes dgongs shig dran chog gi skyabs gcig /byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs kun gyi spyi gzusas/ / yang yang dran no drin chen gyi bla ma/ /snying nas dran no byin rlabs kyi gter chen/ /tshe rabs kun tu thugs rje yis bzung nas/ /dngos grub mchog gi char chen zhig phob shog /ces brjod/ 'di skabs 77
