pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾—྾ ba 'bru gsum gyi bzlas pa byas mthar/ bla ma'i sku las sna tshogs 'od kyi sprin//dpag med bdag gi snying dbus zhugs pa'i mod/ /ji snyed sgrib pa'i tshosas rnams yongs sbyangs te/ /zas med ye shes snang ba rgyas par gyur/ /de mthar bla ma mchog bi ye shes sku/ /'od zhu bdag dang ro gcig 'dres gyur nas/ /spros med mnyam pa chen po'i gzhi dbyings su/ /gnyis med ye shes zhi bar mnyam par bzhag /ces rtogs pa bskyed/ rgyal ba kun gyi sogs kyisabasngo smon bya'o /zhes pa'ang dbe ba'i bshes gnyen pad+ma bde chen gyi ngor sprang smyon 'jigs med pas bris pa dge/༄/ /dpal ldan gru 'dzin dbang po'i thugs ka nas/ /zla mdog 'od kyi 'khri shing ring po'i rtser/ /rje btsun bla ma dmisas med brtse ba'i gter/ /rgyal ba'i cod pan 'chang ba gshegs su gsol/ /rang mdun nam mkha' seng khri pad+ma dang / /cha rdzogs zla ba gsar pa'i dkyil 'khor steng / /bdag gi bsod nams myu gu spel ba'i phyir/ /'chi med sprin gyi ba gam brtsegs ltar bzhugs/ /rgyal ba kun dngos dpal ldan bla ma la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin du mas mchod/ /sdig ltung ma lus gnong 'alhod drag pos bshags/ /rang gzhan dge tshosas kun la rjes yi rang /zab cing rgya che'i chos tshul bsam yas pa/ /gdul bya'i skal pa ji 78

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ za da/ 4 yab34pa pa bzhin snang mdzad cing / /bstan 'gro'i nyer 'tshor bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs/ /bsod nams byang chub chen po'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /lan gsum/ /theg mchog chos tshul la mkhas 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /'gro la phan bde'i dpal ster spyan ras gzigs / /bsod nams zhing du sras bcas rgyal rnams dang / /dbyer med rje btsun bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /cinus/ dpal ldan bla ma khyed kyi bka' drin ni/ /spel legs nor bu'i them skas la 'dzegs nas/ /rgyal ba'i lung rtogs 'chi med dga' tshal du/ /bdas sogs 'gro rnams rtag tu rol par shog /bsdo ba ba'an yangabya'o/ /chos grags kyi gsung ma bcag tsam du/ spro ba med bzhinasnyogatam cal col bris/ maṅgalam༄ / /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig gisabla ma'i rnal 'byor la brtson par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang la/ oṃ swa bha wa shuzlo sarba dharma sogs/mi dmigs stong pa'i rang gdangs 'gags med pa/ /kun snang dag chen rol mor 'char ba'i gzugs/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen seng ge'i khrir/ /rje btsun bla ma dgyes pa'i 'dzum mdangs can/ /zhal bcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag phyag rgya mdzad//zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / /sku la ngur sprig bgo bas mdzes par klubs/ /dbu la paṇa zhu dmar po legs par mnabs/ /rtsa gsum rgyal ba kun dang dbyer med 79

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾྾bzhugs/ /zhes gsal btab/ rgyal kun spyi gzugs rje btsun bla ma la/ / gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod/ /sdig ltung kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang / /chos 'khor bskor bskul mya ngan mi 'dar gsol/ /dge tshogs bla med byang chub snying por bsngo/ /zhes tshogs bsags/ dpal ldan bla ma sangs rgyas kun dngos la/ /rtse gcib/ mi phyed gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag blo dam pa'i chos su 'dren nas kyang / /ye shes snang ba rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab/ oṃ āḥm hā gu ru sarba sirnyi hūṃ/ zhes bzla/ thun mthar/ bla ma'i gnas gsum yi ge 'bru sasum las/ /'od 'phros rang gi spyi mgrin snying gar thim/ /sgrib pa bzhi sbyangs dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob/ /sku bzhi'i go 'phang rgyud la bzhag par gyur/ /de mthar bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim/ /thugs yid gcig 'dres kun bzang chos sku'i zhal/ /mngon gyur khyad chos drug gis gdod ma'i dbyings/ /dag pa gnyis ldan chen por ro gcig gyur/ /ces mnyam par bzhag /thun mjug dge bsngo sogs bya'o/ /ces pa'ang dad ldan mgon po rdo rje'i ngor 'jibs med pas so/ /༄/ /gang zhig gis bla maskrub par 'dod pas skyabs sems dang su bha wa sngon du song rjes/ spros bral zab mo'i gnas lugs de bzhin nyid/ /'gags med sgyu 'phrul rol mor snang ba'i gar/ /rgyal kun spyi 80

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ por/ 4ba ma gzugs dpal ldan bla ma mchog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgya mdzad/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bdan khar brjid/ /sku la ngur smrig bgo bas rab mdzes shing / /mthong na mi mthun zhi ba'i ye shes sku/ /snang stong sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ngo bor bzhugs/ /zhes gsal btab/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rje btsun bla ma la/ /rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing / /mi zad mchod sprin rgya mtshos rtag tu mchod/ /sdig ltung gnong 'gyod dras pos mthol zhing 'chags/ /dus gsum dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang / /tshul gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'gro ba'i don du bskal brgyar bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /dbe tshogs byang chub snying po'i sa la bsngo/ /zhes tshogs bsags/ 'jigs med ye shes dam pa'i ral gri yis/ /log rtog drwa ba snyug po gcod mdzad pa/ /bla ma chos kyi dbang por gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag rgyud dache/ pa'i chos su 'dres byin rlobs/ /zhes gsol ba yang yang gdab/ oṃ āḥmaXhā guspru bh+ya dharmen+d+ra sid+dhi hūṃ/ ci nus bzlas/ thun mthar/ blama'i sku las 'od zer dpag med 'phros/ /bdas bi gnas sa/sum thim pa'i mod nyid la/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun thob ste/ /bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med gyur/ /ces brjod cing bla ma rang la bstem zhing mnyam par bzhag /dge ba 'di yis mkha' khyab yid 8/

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga can kun/ /rmad byung zab mo'i lam dang mi 'bral zhing / /rnam 'dren dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzung ste/ /theg chen lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyinaXshog /ces pa'ang btsunaXpa gsang sngags kyi ngor 'jigs med pas so//ra / /bla ma la na mo/ /yo rgyan rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa/ tshig rkang bdun pa'i bklagathabs mdor bsdus pa ni/ skyabs sems sngon du banya nga la/mdun gyi nam mkhar rin chen seng ge'i khrir/ /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma mtsho skyes thod 'phreng rtsal/ /sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /rdo rje thod bum 'dzin cing sprul krung bzhugs/ /sku la za 'og ber sprug brjid ldan gsol/ /mthong grol 'dab ldan rigs lnga'i zhwa thod can/ /zung 'jug bde stong phyag rgya'i 'khor lor bzhugs/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje 'chang dbang dang / /dbyer med dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi rje'i/ /yon tan yid la dran pa'i mos gus kyis/ /bsngags brjod rgyud mangs 'khrol ba'i mchod sprin spro/zhes pa'i mthar/ hūṃḥ orgyan yul gyi sogs/ ci mang bzla/ mthar/ bla ma'i gnas gsum yi ge'i 'od zer gyis/ /bdas rgyud sgo gsum 'khrul pa'i khams sbyangs te/ /mthar ni bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim//thugs yid ro gcig 'dres pa'i ngang la blta/ zhes mnyam par bzhab /8 2

bla ma dang o rgyan dbyer med du skrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4bsngo smon bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang sras lha dbang ngor sprang rgan 'jigs med pas so//ra / /e ma ho/ ka dag skye med rdo rje'i pho brang nas/ /lhun grub bde ba'i sku can pad+ma 'byung / /rtsa gsum chos skyong rgya mtsho'i spyi dpal che/ /gangs can bstan 'gro'i mgon po da bzhengs shig /mtha' dmag dam sri'i ru mtshon gzings pa'i tshe/ /rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog pad+ma 'byung / /thugs rje'i thugs dam ma g.yel dus la babs/ /bdud 'dul gar dgu'i mthu byin da bskyed cig /bstan zhabs kla klos sdud la rings pa'i tshe bde mchog grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma 'byung / /mngon spyod las la dgyes pa'i dus yin gyi/ /dpa' gtum rdo rje'i gzugs skur da bzhengs shig /bod khams mtha' 'khob skye bos 'jig pa'i tshe/ /'jigs med brtul zhugs mchog grub pad+ma 'byung / /phas rgol lhag mar mdzad pa'i dus la babs/ /drag shul ral gri'i no dbal da phyungs shig /dus 'khrugs mtshon cha'i ru 'dzing rngoms pa'i tshe/ /'jigs mdzad he ru ka dpal pad+ma 'byung / /khams gsum stobs kyis gnon pa'i dus la babs/ /bde chen rdo rje'i mthu nus da sper cig /dbyings nas dag chen mnyam pa'i ye shes che/ /gtum rngam a la ha la'i gad rgyangs dang / /lhan cig khro la khros pa'i skur ston zhing / /bdud srin dam sri'i snying khrag da 83

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i sasung 'bum/— — ྾4྾rol cig /mnyam nyid zhi ba chen po chos sku'i thugs/ /khrag 'thung khros pa'i gzugs skur mngon bzhengs la/ /mtha' dmag dus kyi 'khrug rtsod zhi ba dang / /bod khams bde la 'god pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /ces pa'ang mtha' dmag du ruka'i bya ma rta'i khrag tshos nam mkha'i ba'in ras su byug pa'i tshe/ sprang skyon 'jigs med pas bris pa kla klo'i 'dun gros 'jig pa'i tho lum du gyur cig /༄/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /o rgyan rin po che'i gsol 'debs tshig bdun ma kha ton byed dus kyi dmigs rim shin tu nyung la go sla bar brjod na/ grub na gu ru rin po che'i snang brnyan sogs rten gsum gyi drung du mchod pa ci 'byor bshams/ kha lho nub tu bltas te/ le'u bdun mar/ s+dzawīs pha mar 'bod 'dra'i gdung dbyangs laḥ pi waṃ gling bu'i gdangs ltar snyan pa yisaḥnyin mtshan dus drug rnams su gsol ba thobaḥ ces gsungs pa ltar sems rtse gcig tu gtad de gdung ba'i dbyangs su 'don par bya'o/ /de'ang tshig bdun nyid kyi 'bru non raṭa rim zhig byas na skabs don 'grub pas de la hūṃ zhes pas gsol 'debs kyi byang drangs te snyan gsan phab la/ o rgyan gyi yul gyi nub byang mtshams na dha na ko sha'i mtsho chen po yod pa'i gling du me tob pad+ma chen po'i ge sar te ze'u 'bru shin tu rgyas pa'i sdong po la brdzus te 81

bla ma dang yo rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4'khrungs shing 'khrungs dus nyid nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur zhing mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis mchod bstod phul ba la sogs pa'i ya mtshan pa ste ngo mtshar dang ldan pa/ sngar nas sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ngo bor mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa'am thob zin nas 'dzam bu'i gling mtha' dbus kyi gdul bya gdul ba'i ched du bstan pa'i sprul pa'i sku pad+ma'i rigs yin pa dang pad+ma las 'khrungs pa'i cha nas pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhing khams thams cad na yongs su grags pa de/ dang po rgya gar gyi yul du rgyal po in+t+ra sgo dhi sogs rgyal chen mang po dang rje btsun dam pa sangs rgyas sos/sa dzo ki lha (re rje'ilcam marnya ra ba sogs gas ldan bud med la sogs pa gdul bya dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad/ bar du bod kyi yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rtsa ba thog mar btsugs shing mi dang mi min gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol la bkod/snyigs dus kyi rgud pa zhi ba'i ched du bter kha bye ba phrag brgya bsam gyis mi khyab pa sbas/ tha ma 'gro lding gi yul du rdzu 'phrul dang gdams ngag gi sgo nas phra men rnams dam la btags shing mi'i 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad de mthar rnga yab srin po'i gling gi lte ba mthing zhun gyi rgya mtsho'i dbus zangs mdog dpal gyi ri 86

blam dang o rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4r+yā ྾ —྾྾na med pa'i yon tan gyi khur gyis lci bas gu ru ste bla mar bya ba'i khyad chos can/ pad+ma'i rigs gtso bo pad+ma las 'khrungs pa'i mtshan yang pad+ma zhes bos te bdag la mchog dang thun mong bi sirnyi ste dngos grub ma lus pa hūṃ zhes ྾ cig par bskul ba'i sngags kyang sprel la thun rer stong phrag la sogs par dag cing sasal ba'i ngag gis mi tshig dang ma 'dres par 'don/ o rgyan rin po che zangs mdog dpal ri na bzhusas pa'i da lta'i gnas tshod de nyid tshogs zhing du byas nas gsol ba 'debs pa yin pas rjes la bsdu rim sogs mi dgos/ thun mthar bsam pa myur 'grub dang dge bsngo bya/ de ltar nyams su blang ba'i phan yon yang gter gzhung nyid las/ 'di ltar gsol ba btab pa'i buḥ nga yis skyo pa smos ci dgosaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras su 'gyuraḥ zhes su gsungs te gu rus nam yang rdzun mi gsungs pa la nges shes skyed de the tshom med pa'i yid kyis nyams su len pa gces so/ /'es pa'ang rigs dbon bsod nams dpal ldan byi brjed thor bstan pa'i nyi mas smras rim bzhin ma ti bha trasabris pa dge/87

blam dang yo rgyan dbyer medadu spubalugs sogs/ pod/ 4ran pa tsam smra ba ma gtogs/ gtam nyob nag 'byams mi bya zhing / kha brgyags lab pa/ gcig gis gcig la 'bod rgyang byed pa/ byung rgyal gyi 'don dbyangs dang / don med par rnga dang ḍā dril dkrol ba sogs dus nam yang mi bya/ sngon 'gro/ skyabs sems/ rdor sems/ maṇ+ḍal/ ku su lu'i tshogs bsags/ bla rnam dang drug po zhag ci tsam byed kyi ring la/ thun dpon pas rnga zil 'bebs/ bzhag rol gcig brdung dus thams cad kyis thun bsdams shing / grol dus kyang der mtshungs/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi thams cad kyi skabs/ nyin zhag re la thun bzhi bzhir babos te thun bsdams pa dang grol ba/ dngos gzhi'i dus dbong thun mtshams tshogs dang gsol kha gtong ba/ yar mar gyi tshe bcu gnyis la tshogs bskang cung rgyas byed dus sogs dus thams cad sgrigs la phab nas 'grigs pa/ ḍā dril dang rnga sogs brdung dus dang brdung sa brdung tshigs rnams gcib pa/ gtor bzo yang klong snying gtor dpe dang / gtor ma'i re mig gsal ba kho na ltar las/ sazhan gyi shan ma zhusas pa sogs phyag len gtsang sha gang thon la sgrims/ khyad par du ngag 'don gyi rim pa/ klong snying rang gi sngon 'gro/ rtsa gsum chos srung rnams dang / tsi'u dmar sogs rdo grub gong ma'i ring nas rgyun 'don byed rgyu'i bstan srung 9

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/4྾྾ ྾ ྾྾ ྾ — gser skyems/ cha bsum sogs bsngos nas brje spo byed/ ldebs yig chung ngu 'di yang yang gzigs nas rang zhe rang la mi khrel ba'i spang blang zhib mo nan tan du mdzad pa dang / sgrub grwa pa snga phyi brje dus rtsis sprod len mi lhod pa sal che/ zhes smin zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gang ba la rdo sprul ming pas bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ // 9 1

bla ma dang yo rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4nga ༄/ /rdo rje gzhon nu la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor/dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la brten pa'i bla ma'i rna' 'byor mdor bsdus su 'god pal/ grub na dam tshig gi rten du phung bo'i sku rgazugs bris 'dur ci rigs kyi mdun du mchod pa ci 'byor bsham/ ma grub kyang chad skyon med/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas nges 'byung gi bsam pas rgyud bskul te/ skyabs sems ni/ bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha/ /gus pas skyabs mchi mkha' mnyam 'gro/ /bla med byang chub mchog thob phyir/ /zab lam snying po bsgom bar bgyi/ /lan gsum/ de nas tshogs zhing gsal gdab pa ni/ dpal rdo rje te ru ka'i ye thes kyi skru mngon sum du mi mthong ba'i sems can rnams la de nyid tha mal pa'i lus can gyi bla ma'i rnam par bstan nas rjes su 'dzin pa dang / 'dzin tshul yang de 'dra'i bla ma des dam ye gnyis su med pa'i te ru ka dngos kyi rnam pas dbang bskur ba legs pa'i phrin las dam pa yin phyir/ bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad pa'i nges shes kyis drangs pa'i yid ches brtan pos/ ā rang byung nam khar mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus/ /seng khri pad+ma nyi zla dregs pa'i steng / /rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal lda na te ru ka /rdo rje gzhon nu dbang sngon nor bu'i mdog /zha(sha gcig phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril/ /dur khrod chas rdzogs ye shes me 'bar klong / zhabs zung g.yon brkyang gyad gyi 'dor stabs 'gying / /'khor lo rgyas 'debs gri thod 'dzin pa 'khyud/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyis brtan g.yo zil 96

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ma ba ra gnon pa/ /dam ye dbyer med rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun/ /spro bsdu'i byed po sgrib med ye shes spyan/ /gsol 'debs bu la brtse bas dbongs bzhin bzhugs/ ces gas la btab la/ de'i spyan sngar bsakas sbyang spel gsum bya ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /sogs/ snga 'gyur bka' ma ltar ram yang na/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sashegs/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs/ /lus ngag yid bsum gus phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /nyams chasas sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags/ /gsang sngags bsgrub la rjes yi rang / /smin grol gsang sngags chos 'khor skor/ /mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /bdas la dbang bskur byin gyis rlabs du gsol/ ces dmigs 'dun rtse gcig pas lan gsum sogs ci nus bya/ de nas phur tshugs su gsol ba gdab pa las thog mar brgyud 'debs ni/ dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dgongs pa yis/ /sosas/'phrin las brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlabs du gsol/ /lan gsum/ sogs/ de ༷ nas brgyud pa kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma te ru ka nyid la rang gi lus ngag yid sasum srid pa thams cad rdo rje gzhon nur byin gyis rlabs pa dang / de nyid kyang 'bras bu mthar phyin pa'i ye shes kyi rdo rje gzhon nu dang gnyis su med par sgrub pa'i slad du/ rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin rnams/ /sbod pa rdo rje grub mdzod cig/ /96

bla ma dang yo rgyan dbyer med du sgrub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4྾ 4 ྾྾྾྾srid pa rdo rje phur bu'i lha/ /ye shes kro bo grub par mdzod/ /ces dang / rgyal rnam 'phrin las ye shes phyag rgya'i gzugs/ /rnam mang gdul bya'i rgyud kyi sgrib pa'i phyir/ /thal 'byin rdo rje'i stobs mnga' bla ma dang / /yi dam dbyer med lo la bsol ba 'debs/ /bdud dang grogs ngan chags sdang rnam rtog sogs/ /phyi nang bar chad yul kyis mi brdzi zhing / /byang chub lam bzang sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus stobs/ /shugs dras rdo rje lta dur byin gyis rlobs/ /zang thal rig pa'i phur bu stong chen dbyings/ /btab pas 'khrul snang brag ri thal phyung ste/ mkha' khyab 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i dgra sde las/ /skyobs nus mthu chen dbang por bdag byin rlobs/ /ces lan grangs ci rigs dang gtso sngags 'bru dgu sogs dang 'bru bcu bzhi ba ci 'grub gsol 'debs kyi bsnyen pa'i tso du bzla/ de lha ra gsol ba btab pa'i bla ma te ru ka nyid mchog tu dgyes pa'i nyams gyis sku'i gnas bzhi nas 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun dang bcas pa rjos te rang gi gnas bzhir zhugs shing thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar byas shingaX/ dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thob par mos la/ dpal ldan bla ma'i sku yi gnas bzhi nas/ /'od zer byung ba rang gi gnas bzhir thim/ /skru gsung thugs dang ye shes rdo rje yis/ /byin gyis rlabs nas dbang bzhi thob par gyur/ /zhes brjod thugs yid bsre zhing dgongs paXmanyam par bzhag pa ni/ bla ma dpal 97

ngo da/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i sasung 'khum/ba chen te ru ma /dgyes pas 'od zhu rang la thim/ /rang yang kun gzhi ma bcos pa'i/ /ngang la yid ni 'dzin pa bral/ /rnam dag spros bral chos kyi sku/ /chos kyi sku la gnyis su med/ /bsngo smon ni/dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs dang / spro na dong spruṭa smon lam kyang gdab bar bya'o/ zhes pa'ang sprul sku 'jigs med tshul khrims rgyal mtshan kyis ngor rdo rgan bstan nyis lha bskyed sasol 'debs kyi tshibs bcad ma gtokas rdo rje'i tshig byin rlabs can rnams bsgrigs te smras pa lhar blo gsalabazang pos yi ger bkod pa 'o/༄ / /'phags mchog phyag na pad mo'i rnal 'byorasnying rje mchog gi sa bon bzhugs so/ /na mo lo ki shā ra ya/ 'phasas mchob spyan ras gzigs baspub par 'dod pas thog ma ra skyabs sems ni/ na mo/ mchog sasum ngo bo thugs rje'i lhar/1byang chub bar du skyabs mchi zhing / /'gro don byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor zab mor 'jug par bgyid/ /lan bsum/ dngos gzhiXlha'i rnal 'byor ni/ jiḥ spros kun mtshan ma zhi ba'i dbyings// dab chen brtan g.yo'i snang cha ru/ /rnam rol gru 'dzin zhing gi dbus/ /pad ma zla ba'i gdan steng du/ /rgyal kun snying rje chen po'i gar/ /spyoḥyig zla ltar dkar ba'i mdog /yongs gyur 98

bla ma dang yo rgyan dbyer med du spub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ /dkar gsal mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba/ /zhal gcig zhi 'dzum bzhad pa'i nyams/ /phyag gnyis nor bu pad dkar 'dzin/ /dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /krisna'i pags pas nu g.yon bkab/ /zhabs zung bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis gnas/ /thugs kar pad zla'i lte ba ru/ /trīḥmathar yi ge drug pas bskor/ /'od 'phros sangs rgyas mdzad pa bsgrubs/ /tshur 'dus rang la thim pa'i mod/ /sgo gsum 'phags pa'i gsang gsum dang / /dbyer med mchog gi sa thob gyur/ /yig drug ci nus bzla de nas mdun bskyed ni/ oṃ swā bha wa sogs/mi dmigs chos dbyings mchog gi rtsal/ /lha na grub snying rje chen po'i sbu/ /mdun mkhar pad+ma zla ba'i steng / /dīḥdakar dwangs ma'i gzugs can las/ /'od 'phros rgyal mchod 'gro sgrib sbyangs// tshur 'dus yongs su gyar ba las/ /'phags tshogs sdug bsngal ༄rang grol lha/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang bo gnyis/ /snyim pa'i thal mo thugs kar sbyar/ /g.yas 'og shel dkar phreng ba 'dren/ /g.yon pas pad ma dkar po 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis sgeg /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ /'khril ldem gzhon nu'i ngang tshul can/ /gsal 'tsher 'od kyi sprin phung 'phro/ /byi gtsug rigs bdag snang mtha' yas / 99

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾4྾྾྾྾ ྾ ྾—sangs rgyas bsod nams phung bor bzhugs/ /mtha' skor 'phags ma sgrol ma sogs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'khrigs/ /kun gyi gnas gsum yig 'brus mtshan/ /de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ /ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /phyas na pad+ma'i rnam rol gyis/ /skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur/ /ces brjod cing bsam/ bhāḥ chos sku skye ba med pa las/ /lhun grub rang byung snying rje'i gzugs/ /ma 'gaṭa pad+ma rigs kyi lha/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'phags pa'i tshul/ /rigs kyi sprul ba 'bum dang bcas //sngon gyi thusas dam chen po yis/ /sems can don du dbongs mdzad la/ /byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su sasol/ /oṃ lo ki shā ri sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ mchod pa ni/ jiḥ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med pa'i/ /zhing khams ma lus ji snyed pa/ /lha rdzas mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis/ /til gong 'phyur ba bzhin du gtams/ /zag med dgyes pa bskyed pa'i rdzas/ /nam mkha' gang ba'i mchod yon dang / /me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal rdzas rol mo'i sprin phung sgas/ /bla ma mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /rgyal dang de sras bcas kun mchod/ /thugs kyi dgyes pa bskangs nas kyang / /ma lus 100

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa sogs yi ge brgya pa brjod/ 84 khyen kyi sogs/ bzad mus ye shes pa gshegs/dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam la/ bsngo smonaXshis brjod kyis mtha' rgyas par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rdo rje yi ge drus pa'i rnal 'byor la mos paXsnying bor byed pa'i dge slong gnas brtan dam pa a mo gha'i bzhed skong du sprang smyon 'jigs medaXpas gang dran thol byung du brjod pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ //102

bla ma dang yo rgyan dbyer med duspub lugs sogs/ pod/ 4྾ ྾ ྾྾྾྾ ༄/ /klong snying gi lo rgyus skor/༄/ /rje bla ma bka' drin 'khor med gter chen chos kyi rgyal po mdo sngags gling pa'i zhabs rten rin po che'i pad+ma la spyi bos gtugs te phyag 'tshal lo/ /klong snying gi lo rgyus skor la/ gsang gtam chen mor o rgyan rin po che dang / 'jam dpal gshes ga/nyen gyis dbang gnang bar bshad pa ni rtogs brjod chu zla'i/yul seng ba la yi a tsar+ya/ /sobs kyi skor yin/ gnad byang las/rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yiḥ basbul ma thengs gsum/zhes pa/ rig 'dzin gyi bskul ma ni/ kun mapho chos rjes brda 'grol mdzad pa dang / dpa' bo'i ni kong sbyon pra ti sngags 'chang gi bskul ma dang / mkha' 'gro'i ni mchims phur sman btsun mched lngas bla ma sku khams ma dang / chos rnga chen po'i sogs kyis gsol 'debs phul ba de yin 'dra/ lo rgyus 'di rje bla mar snyan sgron phul/ zhes pa'i bla ma ni dpal ri sprul sku yin zhes dge sprul gyis bshad kyang rje dri med gling par mngon/ nam snying nyang ban mchog dbyangs dngaḥ lha sras sprul pas/ zhes pa'ang pra ti sngags 'chang / 'jigs med kun grol/ thes gling 03

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4྾rtse 4r+yā྾྾—zhabs/ rdo grub rnams su snang / rnam thar na klong snying gis chos bka' 'byung ba'i ltas su blo lda na bh+ra ma ra'i gtam shar bar gsungs pa'ang 'di'i lo rgyus su sdud dgos/ snying thig ces pa ni rdzogs chen man ngag sde'i snying thig skor gyi gnad 'dril bas yin par gsal te/ de'i mtshan gzhi'ang ye shes klong gi rgyud sogs rgyud phyi ma/ rgyud gnyis/ lung dbongs nyams/ man gnad gsum dag /gnas lugs rdo rje'i tshig rkang sogs so/ /chos sde'i gtso bo de rnams yin zhing / rig 'dzin zhi drag sga skor sogs de'i 'khor du gtogs pas na gtso bo'i sgo nas mtshan btags pa'o/ /de ltar yang snying po don gsal las/ 'di ni sems phyosas kyi grub mtha'i snying po gadzu bor 'don pas zhes pa nas/ye shes klong gi rgyud la sogs pas man ngag gi thus ka tshang la ma nor bar ston la/ zhes so/ /rdzogs chen snying thig la/ pad+ma'i bka' srol dang / bi ma la'i ste phyogs 'dir gnyis su grags che ba las 'di sang zhe na/ rnam thar du/ 'di snying thig gong ma'i don po yin par gsungs pa ltar gnyis ka'i ste pad+ma'i bka' srol yin pa ni/ rig 'dzin pad+ma'i klong chen brdaḥ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mo yinaḥ zhes shog dril lnga ka pad+ma'i zab gter du bshad pas shes shing / gnad byang las/ zab don snying gi 104

—nga nga bla ma dang o rgyang byer medang nga nga nga nga / nga nga —/nga ྾thig le'i skoraḥ sogs kyis kyang gsal/ be ma'i bka' srol yin pa ni/ klong rgyud kyi bsgyur byang na shin tu gsal zhing / kun mang chos rjes brda bkrol bar yang yin par gsungs shing khyad par rgyud phyi ma las bshad pa'ang / lar mkha' 'gro snying tis/ gi bdag po gcig pu'ang rgyal ba klong chen pa yin mod de/ 'dir bī ma'i bka' babs kyi phyogs nas byin gyis brlabs pa gtso che ba 'dra ste/ paṇa chen bī ma la'i sgyu 'phrul zhes snying po don gsal du snang ba'ang dgos dbang che zhing / thig le'i rgya can du'ang bī ma la'i bla sgrub tu sbyar ba bzhin no/ /'on kyang chu zla'i gar mkhan du lhun grub kyi spubs gzigs tshul thun mong ma yin pa rnams o rgyan rin po che'i byin rlabs kyi lag rjes kho nar sbyar te/ dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i zhing khams de/ sogs gong 'og kun tu 'byung bas pad+ma'i bka' srol gtso che'am snyam/ de de'i rgyu mtshan du 'gro lugs ni/ skabs 'dir gdod ma'i gzhi klong du btsan sa zin tshul dang gzhi snang la dbang bsgyur tshul bshad pa rnams ni chos 'di'i don brgyud kyi bka' babs brnyes tshul bstan par snang ba'i phyir te/ gsang gtam chen mor dus de'i tshe gnyid 'od gsal gyi 'khor lor sogs dang rtogs brjod chu zla bsgrigs na shes/ de'ang dang por mnal lam du gu ru'i zhabs rjes las 05

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/dbang bzhi blangs pa'i rkyen gyis nang dbyings khyad chos drug ldan gyi grol sa mthong ba dang / de rjes 'jam dpal gshes gnyen gyis byin gyis rlobs pa'i rkyen las/ dus 'di nas dkongs pa'i gsang mdzod rdol/ /sogs gsungs shing / de'i tshe mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi bag chags gsal bar sad tshul dang / de rjes rnga yab gling du gu ru bde ba chen po dang thugs yid 'dres nas 'od gsal gzhon nu dum sku'i zhing gzigs par gsungs pa rnams ni/chos 'di'i don brgyud kyi dgongs pa ji ltar babs pa dang / de la brten nas rnam thar do ha'i rgyan du/ rtsa khams kyi yi ge ye thes kyi rlung gis bskul bas dam ba'i chos kyi rol mor 'khrol bar bshad pa lhar chos gter 'di byung tshul bshad pa ste/ gsang gtam dang chu zla sbya ra na gsal po yod/ 'dir zhal gzigs dang lung bstan byung rabs sogs rtsal du bton nas ma bshad par/'od gsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dgongs pa la dbang thob tshul dang / de'i rang rtsal las mkha' 'gro'i brda'i gsang mdzod rang shar du rnyed tshul rgya cher bstan pa 'di ni nang zab mo dgongs pa'i gter gyi lo rgyus khyad par ba yin zhes bshad na blo'i mig can rnams ngo mtshar bar byed do/ /des na 'dir ni zhal gzigs sogs kyang dgongs pa de'i sad rkyen du sbyar nas bshad 06

nga nga 4/ nga nga —nga spyo tram̐1 'jigs med bsta na nyi'i nga nga bum/ nga 4rgyas par bshad do/ /chos 'di 'byung ba'i ltas su mnga' ris paṇa chen gyi bag chags sad de skye ba 'phos pa lta bur song tshul bshad pa'ang / bla ma bka' brgyad sa sater gyi babs so che shos mnga' ris paṇa chen yin pas/ de'i zab gter gyi yang snying slar yang dgongs bter du dbang sgyur ba'i rten 'brel gyi khyad yin nam snyam/ gu ru zhi ba'i thugs srog dīḥyis la mdzad pa shas che mod/ 'dir hūṃ du byed pa'ang bka' brgyad kyi gco bo'i thugs srog dang bcis du mdzad pa'o/ /'dir bskyed chog la ting 'dzin rnam gsum rim 'jug med par bsnyen yig tu gsungs shing /der gzhung gi tshig don che long du bkral ba'i 'gangs la brtabs na/ gtso bo sa bon gyi yi se las bskyed mi bskyed tsam ma gtogs yum ka'i/ aḥ snang ba thams cad yum lnga'i klong ཿ sogs dang 'gros mthunapar gsal lo/ /'di'i lubs kyis/ gtso bo'i sngabs kyi bzlas pa dang / gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sems 'dzin sogs kyis bsnyen pa dang gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bzlas pa dang / gtso bo'i thusas kar ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje chos bskyed pa bsnan nas do li'i dmigs ngas bde chen gyi ye shes spor ba'i bsam gtan gyi lde kha 'dogs pa ni sgrub nga yin/ las sbyor ni tshe sgrub tsam las zur pa ma bstan snang / bsnyen sgrub kyi go 0

bla ma dang yorgyanadabyer med dub lugs sogs/ ra ra/ nga don ni 'di'i bsnyen pa'i thad du/ rig 'dzin rgya mtshos byin gyis rlobasaḥ sogs tsam las ma bsungs te/ sgrub pa'i thad du/'bum phrag bcu yis dngos grub thobaḥ ces pa dang / bsgrigs pas 'di ltar mngon te/ sgrub pas rig 'dzin bzhir sbyor nus kyi rtogs pa khyad par can gyi dngos grub dngos su 'thob la// de la sngon du sgrub pa po'i rgyud lha sngags ye shes kyis byin gyis brlabs nas de 'dra'i dngos grub kyi snod khyad par can du gyur pa dgos pas de ltar sgrub byed du bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor bzhag pa ste/'di ni sgom phyogs dris lan du/ dper na so nam byed pa la/ /sogs dang yang shin tu 'grigs so/ /smin slob kyi dbang du byas kyi las rung la ni de dang de'i rten 'brel tsam bsgrigs par zad do//blo'i mun sel du bshad pa rnams dang yang khog gcig par snang ngo //de ltar na dngos grub dngos su sgrub pa'i nus pa skyed byed du bstan pa'i sngags ni sgrub sngags yin la/ dngos grub kyi mthu ma thob par rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa tsam gyis dngos grub kyi las la dngos su sbyor mi btub pas/ las sbyor gyi khyad par tshe sgrub ni sgrub pa'i rjes 'brel du gtogs kyi/ bsnyen pa tsam gyi rjes 'brel min pas tshe sngags kyang bsnyen sngags sham ldan la ma mdzad par/ sgrub sngags sham ldan la mdzad pa yin no/ /des na rdo grub kyis 1

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾྾྾྾ ྾ ྾4 ྾bsnyen sgrub kyi sngags gnyis kyi rigs re bzlas nas bdod tshe sbasas kyi bzlas sgom la 'jug par tshe chog ljags bsgrigs las sasungs pa'ang shin tu legs so/ /yang na tshe sngags rika 'dzin spyi dzab sham ldan la mdzad pa ni 'di'i lugs kyis/ rigs lnga'i rig 'dzin la brten nas 'byung lnga'i sogs dang / ṅgā na saṃ skre la brten nas sogs ltar satso 'khor yongs rdzogs la brten nas/tshe sgrub pa'i gnad kyis yin zer dgos te/ bskyang bde ba la 'di bzang ngam snyam/ phyi ma 'di ltar na'ang / 'di'i tshe sgrub tshad ldan byed na gtso sngags kyi bzlas pa tsam 'ar+ṣa bas mi chos gi/spyi dzab kyi bzlas grangs yang them dgos te/ spyi dzab kyi mtha' sgyur yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bka' brgyad gzhan las bla ma bka' brgyad byin rlabs myur ba ni/ sgrub sde chen po brgyad kyi gadzu bo rnams ris 'dzin brgyad du bzhengs pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin las shes te/ gsang rdzogs su blta'o/ /'di'i kha skong sbyin sreg ni ye shes me lce ltar dang / 'di'i sgos kyi rdzogs rim ni snyan rgyud thog dril dang / thabs lam ma bsgom sangs rgyas te/ de'i phyi lus kyi stong rar lha bskyed pa'ang sku mdog dang bzhugs stabs bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs 'di'i ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje chos rang yin no//12

nga nga bla ma dang yo rgyan dbyer meda' du sgrubalugs nga ngasang pod/ ba yang bsnyen pa o rgyan rin po che nyid la byas na nye ba'am myur te/ bod kyi bla ma 'i skal ba zhes so/ /sgrub pa rig 'dzin spyi dzab la byas na tshan che ste rdo rje 'chang gi gral brnyes so cog gi rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang thams cad dngos grub nga ba la dgongs pa gcig par dril nas bsgrub pas te/ blo ngo la ltos so/ /bka' brgyad bde gsang gnyis su yang rig 'dzin slob dpon yongs rdzogs kyi snying po 'bru gsum dang ma hā gu ru'i sngags 'di nyid du bshad cing / rig 'dzin yongs 'dus dang / grol thig lam rgyas par yang sngags 'di 'byung ngo / /sku gsum lam khyer skabs/ gzhi la 'chi bar gnyis rim gyis kho nar 'byung yang / 'dir 'chi sbod dab pa'i 'od gsal gyi rang mdangs bar do dang skye srid rnam par dag pa'i snang char shar bar bslab pas sbyong bar bzhed 'dra ste/ 'chi srid du 'ong rgyu'i 'od gsal sgrib bral du dag pa'i chos skru dang / 'chi srid las bar srid du ldang rgyu'i rlung sems dag pa'i longs sku hūṃ yis gnyis dus mnyam cig car du skyed pa ni 'bras bu dang bstun pa ste/'bras dus su ni bar srid dag pa'i longs sku de 'chi srid dag pa'i 'od gsal las ma g.yos bzhin du 'od gsal de'i rang snang mdangs la bzhag par zad pas so/ /hūṃ dang gtso bo gnyis snga phyi 3

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigasamed bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rim can du sgom pa ni 'bras dus su gdul bya la snang ba ston tshul dang gzhi la bar skye'i go rim gnyis kar bsnyun chog /'chi srid dag pa'i 'od gsal dang / bar do dag pa'i longs skur mos pa'i mi rtog pa dang hūṃ yig mnyam bskyed byas pa'i mi rtog pa des bskyed rim pa'i 'chi ba chos sku'i lam khyer gyi go mi chod de/ska bas 'dir bcos ma'i tshul gyis 'od gsal gyis stong nyid sgom pa'i tshul la rtse gcig tu dmigs nas sgom pa zhib med na/ de 'dra'i 'al 'ol tsamaXgyis da gzod rdzogs rim dus 'od gsal stong pa dang bsres nas tha mal pa'i 'chi srid sbyong ba'i smin byed du mi 'gyur bas so zhe na/ gsar ma'i lugs bzhin byas na shin tu bden mod/ 'di pa'i lugs kyis/ sgrub thabs kyi sngon 'gro'i chos bdun rdzogs nas/ dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la/ skru gsum gyi'am/ rdo rje gsum gyi rnal 'byor gsum las/ dang por sku phyag rgya'i rna' 'byor dang / banyis par gsung bzlas pa'i dang /gsum par thugs nyer bsnyu'i rnal 'byor te/ rags rim nas phra rim la 'jug pa yin la/ de las skabs 'dir dang po skru phyag rgya'i ting 'dzin skabs yin pas 'chi srid lam khyer yang dmigs 'og tu bcug nas sgom pa tsam las satso bor 'don pa mtha' gcis tu mi dbos pas rdzogs rim pa'i 'chi srid lam khyer gyi dge — 1

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾྾lnga 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhe ṣe ka te sa ma ye shri ye hūṃḥ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lnga'i cod pan gyis dbu brgyan par gyur/oṃ tsak+ṣa tsak+ṣu sa mān+ta tsak+ṣu bi shā dha ni swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/bsgoms pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las rten so so'i rnam par gyur/brtan bzhugs ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag bi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/khyad par du yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i sa/nod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su sasol/ brtan par bzhubs nas kyang bdab dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa batsho du gsol/ dbyangs gsal rten snyingaci rigs/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'khor ba srid du bzhubs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par batsho du gsol/ /oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ mthar 'is brjod bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang rigs kyi gcung po 'dzam gling dbang rgyal kyi gsung ngor 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi mas skad 118
da dbyer med du ram̐pa
po yi tres bsdengan bzhupa

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4 da lta de'i bstan pa'i chos gtan nas mi go bar gsungs pa sogs mang pos shes so/ /bshes spring las/ ma yi thug mtha' rgya shug tshig gu tsam/ /sogs thad bka' sadams gsar ma kha cis de ltar deng nas bsam tshe rang re'i lus 'di sems can brgya stong grangs med kyi mi gtsang ba'i rdzas kyi rgyun 'dus pa las grub par shes nas lus sred dang rgyags pa sogs 'dul gsung skad/ de bzhin du bod 'bangs tsho'i lus kyi byung khungs yar ded byas nas bsam na/ 'phags pa dang jo mo'i nyi zla la thug 'gro bas rang re'i lus 'di spu sen mo skra sha rus rgyus pa khrag sogs re re nas ma ṇi pad+me'i rig sngags kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun las ma byung ba cung zad kyang med do/ /'on kyang lo tog 'dod pas sa bon du 'os pa'i nas sam gro sogs 'bru bzang la spus gtsang ba rnyed rung des mi chog /zhing bzang po la btab nas so nam rem dgos/ de bzhin du rang re'i sgo sasum la ma ṇi'i phabs gta' yod lugs de ltar ngo 'phrod thog nas sgom bzlas kyi las kas 'phags pa'i rdo rje gsum gyi dngos grub kyi chang la ngos shes pa byed rgyu gal che de ni thun mong ltar bshad pa'o/ /rang rgyud kyi sngags kyi phabs gta' mthar thug ni gnyug ma mi shigs pa'i sgo gsam gdod nas thags rje chen po'i ngo bor da da 123

pa'ocadang/ ngas rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum /nga nga nga yin par nam dang nam yang kun gyi kha la rang babs lta bur 'ong ba ni ma ṇi kho na ste/ des na rang gi lha skal dang / chos skal sar yod phar btsal ma dgos par tshur nga yin zhes gsal bar bstan pa red pas 'di la mi 'ju na ci la 'ju/ blo thag rbad bcad/ blo rtse gcig tril dril nas 'di la sgril bar bya'o/ /des na sgab tu/bod mis ma ṇi rang shes pa rgyu'i stobs dang rkyen gyi stobs yin dpyod smras pa de rtsing bas/ gnyis ka'i stobs yin lugs 'di bzhin dgos la/ 'phags pa'i sngon smon gyis ma ṇi rang shes dper na 'od mdor/ bde ba can pa rnams sangs rgyas grangs med kyi chos kyi longs spyod la rol bar gsungs nas/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'od dpag med kyis sngon sems can rnams la chos mnyan pa byin nga dang / sngon smon lam btab pa grub bo/ /zhes pa lta bu 'di rigs rnal 'byor pa'i che bas 'chad tshul dang cung zad tshul mi gcig gam dpyod/ 'phags pa la sngon 'brel yod pas da lta ma ṇi'i zhing 'dir skyes zhes pa'i sngon 'brel de lag tshad dbos zhe na/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du sems can mib zur gyis bltas pa'ang / rjes su bzung ba nyid du 'gyur/ sogs dang / gzhon nu ma bdun gyi sngon gyi rgyu sogs kyis dpags na cher mi dgos pa 'dra ste/ zhing gi che bas so/ /thags rje chen po'i 'dul skal min ༄126

nga nga nga/ nga nga nga rdo grung 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gang nga / —bcig kyang med/ zungs shor/ dang kha 'gasas/rtag tu mabo 'khor ba'i rnam pa yod pa/ mig sogs dbang po 'grib pa sosas nad tshabs che la dos drab pa byung bar zhag mang rab song / de nas snga dro zhig spyod 'jug gi me tog char ba spos cha dang 'dres 'bab pa ༄yis/ /sobs yang yang dran pas rkyen byas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs 'ba' zhig yid la dran 'ing / mos gus gdung shugs drag pos mchi ma rang dbang med par 'chor ba kho na zhag gnyis gsum la shugs 'byung du byung / de ka'i ngang la nyin sacig gnyid du 'phri tsam song bar/ 'phags pa sems nyid ngal gso 'dra ba zhib bkra lam gyis gsal por byung / gnyid sad pa na de 'phral rang du khams cung zad bder song 'dug /de nas zhag po gnyis gsum na nad rags pa de dwangs gsungs/ ri gangs dkar gyis g.yobs pa/ chu dwangs bsil du 'byung ba/ chu la she' zam 'chabs pa/ char kha bar 'bab pa/ sobs rgya gar na med pa'i bod yul gyi khyad chos yin la/ gzhan yang jo bos rgya gar na med par gsungs pa'i me tog shang dril sobs 'bru sman me tog gi rigs bzang mang skye ba/ brag ri'i phug dang shing gi drung sogs bsam gtan spyod pa'i gnas mang ba/ sa gtsang la dben zhing nyam dga' ba/ ma ṇi'i dar dang rdo mkhar gyis gnas dang 30

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 44 — ྾྾—4྾྾gnas rnams mtshan pa/ rma rgyal na kha sar pa ṇi'i gangs ri dang /bso thog gnas na ri gadzu spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas ri/ 'brong ri smug po sogs 'jig rten phal ba'i kha dang gsal yang thubs rje chen po'i pho brang du grags shing de ltar 'du shes pa mang ba/ rgya nag pad+me/ yid lhung ma ṇi/ khro skyab 'ur 'ur/ brag dkar sprel rdzong na 'phags pa'i sku dang yig drug rang byon/ mtshams kyi yi ge drug ma sogs 'phags pa'i rten gsum khyad par can gyis stod smad kun tu brgyan pa/ rgyal rabs gsal me sogs ltar na bod 'dir nyung rdog dang de'i lo ma za ba rnams kyang lha cib kong jo'i phyag rjes su gsal ba sogs 'phags pa'i sprub gnas kyi mtshan nyid mang pos khyad par du byas shing / sprung gnas pa sosas 'phasas pa'i sgrub pa po mtha' yas pas snod bcud thams cad gru 'dzin ri dang bde ba can gyi rten brten par yang yang dang brgyud mar brlabs/lho rgyud na mtshams kyi yi ge drug ma zer ba'i sanas ri yod/lha srin bka' 'og tu sbud pa'i dbang sdud skabs/ nga ni 'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzad nas/ /zhes pa ltar sa'i lha'i gtso bo sogs mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi dang / tshangs dbang sogs rgyu ba'i 'jig rten gyi dbang 'di ltar dpal mchog dang po dang za ma 3

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4 ma ma ba ba sgra de las gzhan mi 'byung / de bzhin du 'phags pa la thugs rje chen po yod rung / dngos grub kyi don du gsol ba ma btab na don de mi 'grub/ de'ang dngos grub gang gsol ba de kho na bzhin du thugs rje smon lam gyi byin rlabs kyi cha so so'i lag rjes 'byung bar gsal/bla ma zhal dngos su yun ring ma mjal bar bsgug dgos byung na/ yun ring por da nga'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen de nam mthong bar 'gyur snyam du de mthong ba la sgom pa'i yid byed dang don gnyer ji snyed dang ci tsam mang du byung ba de'i tshod tsam gyi chos kyi sgrib pa 'dag cing chos dang chos smra bsaXbyin rlabs 'jug pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po mtha' yas pa 'dzin pas/ ston pa yang dag 'jog la bzhugs pa'i dbos ched kyi nang na/ sangs rgyas mthong pa la sgo ma par bya ba'i phyir dang / zhes yod la/ rtag tu ngus chos 'phags lo bdun du ma mjal ba lta bu yod/ dpe de bzhin bsgrub pa po dad gus shin tu brtan cing blo mi 'gyur ba rnams kyis mthong ba na dga' ba ches cher lhag par skye ba'i ched kyang yin te/ snyan ngas me long mar re ba med pa'i dasa' ba dang re ba dang bcas pa'i dab/'a ba'i rgyan bshad pa lta bu/ dga' ba ji ltar lhag pa ltar de la yid 'grus shing sa/tod pa'i gus pa skyed/135

thugs chen yig drus gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4྾ ྾྾— ྾—the tshom za ba dang / 'phags pa nyid la rtse sacib/ yid ma gtad cing ma dmigs par bzlas kyang mi 'grub bsungs shing sems rtse gcig tu ma bgyis pa ni ma gtobs so/ /zhes gzhan du'ang gsungs pas sngags kyi lha las gzhan du gtan ma yengs par bzla dgos/ dmar po'i rgyud du/ gzhan du g.yengs pa'i sems kyis ni/ /bskal bar bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin/ /zhes dang / ḍo dha pas/ skad cig tsam yang sazhan gzusas kyis/ /dngos grub 'dod pas gnas mi bya/ /zhes sogs mang ngo / /las tshosas sgrub dus sogs la the tshom mi za ba'i rogs su/ mkha' 'gro'i rol rtsed las bshad pa'i sbyon pa dang bu chung bi snang shas la gnas pa'ang 'gro'am snyam/ma ṇi'i yig 'bru rnams mkha' 'gro sde lngar sbyor ba 'og tu bshad ltar/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'di ni 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro rigs bsdus pa ste/ bde mchob las ri rab so bdun rdul snyed kyi ḍa ki ni thams cad snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la 'du bar gsungs pa'i bzhi po'ang rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs ba'i po 'di ka yin no/ /smin gling gsang ye'i dbang chog tu/ gsang ye'i dbang thob pa kho nas zhing sngags lhan skyes kyi pho nya mo thams cad dang rten 'brel 'grisas tshu' gsungs yod/ mdor na yo sa 137

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾—྾ —dang gsang 'dus sogs thun mong du gsungs pa'i yum bzhi dang /rnam 'byor gsang mtha'i thun min snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi po ril gyi sngags yin/ de'ang sngags 'di'i cha shas kyi yi ge rnams mkha' 'gro sde bzhi dang / cha can sngabs nyid bsang ye red/de'ang gsang ye nyid mkha' 'gro ma stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis gcig tu dril bar nges shes skyed cing / snying gar bkod pa'i yig drug kyang / sngags kyi gzubs can rnal 'byor ma/ /zhes pa ltar/ sasang ye dngos rang yin pa'i nga rgyal bzhag nas bzlas pas bskul bas/ bzlas brjod las su rung ba na gsang ye nyid 'phasas pa dang lhan cig rgyud la zhugs nas sam snying ga'i mi shigs pa la zhugs nas/ de las 'phros te chags pa'i rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi cha thams cad byin gyis brlabs par mdzad nas 'bar ba gsum 'byung ste/ de man phag mo'i zin tho ltos//mus chen dkon mchob rgyal mtshan kyis ma ṇi dung phyur lhag bzlas/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa zhag mang por gzis/sa/ las dag pas spyan ras gzigs dngos su mthong ba'ang byung / rdo ring ba chen pos kyang skyer sgang ba'i yig drug nyams len mdzad/'phags pa lan gsum mjal/ ched du thugs gtad na mdun gyi bar snang la yig drub sga sgra mi bcus bzlas pa'i sgra tsam rgyun du 38

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 44྾ 4 r+yā4྾gsan/ gnas gsar ba ma.o brtse'i zhabs kyis byang gter 'gro ba kun sgrol gyis ma ṇi ril sgrub mdzad pas ril bu la gzhi bdag gter srung gis skor ba byed pa/ ril bu dril bu bdun 'phel ba/'ja' gur dang me tog gi char ba/ gling thams cad dri bzang sgas khyab pa/ ril bu'i dbang gi skabs gzhi bdag 'brog pa brjid bag can gyi rnam pas dngos su dbang zhu ba sogs byung /sems can 'bum phrag gsum 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i lung bstan gyis bsngags/ yar 'brog mtsho dang / gnam mtsho sogs thams cad du ril bu 'as+dzawī gang che mdzad/ da dung ma ṇi ril sgrub gang mang mdzad par thugs 'dun chen po 'khrungs/ rgya yul du ha shang ṭi'u ṣan bya ba'i dge slong bzang po zhis rgyal po'i bka' nan ltar khri rin thang can spyad pas pus mo'i lha ngar phol mig smin ma dang mig dang kha sobs dod pa/ khar zas bcug na za/ na zug bzod blags med pa zhig byung ste shin tu gdungs/ de'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa'i ha shang zhig gis/ gong ma yung gi dus ha shang ṭi'u ṣan 'di nang blon gid dhi dang / phol mig lo blon po bzho'u tshir gyur/ gid dhis dbyen byas te kong mas bzho'u tshi bsad/ de tshun skye ba bcur lan chags snyogs phyir lo 'di'i rjes su 'brangs kyang / gid dhi 'gyod nas rab tu 39

nga n+d+ra4/ nga rdo sprang nga nga med bstan nyi'i bsung 'ang nga / ྾4nga 4byung / de tshun skye ba kun tu tshul khrims dag pa sha stag tu brgyud pas glags ma rnyed ces de rnams e yin zhes rim par dris pas pho' mis gis kyang so sor ang zhes lan btab/ da res bcas 'bal gyi ltung ba byung bas 'di ltar glaṭa rnyed 'dus kyang khyod la'ang las 'di'i 'bras bu ngan pa 'ong bas ngas bsnyum pa yin gyis song zhig ces chus bkrus/ rnga yab kyis byab pas 'bag dor ba ltar lhung bar bshad/ 'gu sngags 'chang rtar bas ma ci bum sgrub mdzad par yang / dur khrod ma gsum gyis mdong gsol 'iphul ba sogs 'jam dbyangs macan rtse dang mtshungs pa grub rtags thon/ mkhan chen sding ma ba dang / rje dbang rab kyis kyang ma ṇi'i ril bu bsgrub pas snga ma dang phyogs 'dra byung / grub thob 'dar phyar gyis nyi phug pa las thugs rje chen po'i skor gsan/ti se dar nags rgyal gyi gnas su 'phags pa'i zhal gzigs//'das dus dbu thod la yi ge drus pa phyed skyil du bzhubs par shar/si tu chos 'byung rnam thar na/ gzhi bdag bi bdug rtsub sobs las thog ser nam byung du/ snang grag thams cad thugs rje chen po'i yo lang du bltas nas ma ṇi bton pa kho nas zhi bar bshad la/chu'i 'jigs pas nyen tshe chu la yig drug bsgo mas pas thar rabs las 'bras brgyud pa'i lo rgyus zhig na yod/ de'i rigs pas/40

nga nga thugs chen dag drug gi skor tsho sogs nga nga nga nga nga nga cadang/ ngasadagra byung tshe cir snang 'phags par lta zhing / mtshon char pudz+wa ri ka'i phyag mtshan du bltas la yib drug bton pas dgra'i sdang sems zhi/ mtshon kha stol/ dme 'dre med pa sogs dang / yams nad la/ ci snang 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor du lta ba thamasacad la 'dra/ nad ma ṇi'i bdud rtsir bsam pas zhi ba dang / dug zhi bar yang de bzhin/ dbang sdud la/ rta mgrin gyi/ snang ba lha la grag pa sngags/ /sogs dbang sdud du 'gyur lugs zur tho shis dril ltar las/ rta mgrin zhes pa 'phags pa zhi bar 'don pa spos pas chog ste/ mdor na snang srid snod bcud 'khor 'das thams cad bdag thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten pa nyab gcib gi rang bzhin du bsdu zhing rgyas 'debs pa'o//gdon 'dul/ rgyal po'i chad pa zhi ba/ 'byung ba'i dug gzhil ba/ ltas ngan dang byad byur chag sgo zhi ba/ bza' skar gyi gnod pa zhi ba/ nang 'thab/ sde 'khrusas/ nyams grib/ mi la bra mchu/ lha 'khrugs/ nad sna tshogs zhi bar bya ba sosas mtha' yas par 'phrul ba ni/ sazhub gi/ gang 'dul phrin las lhun grub bsamaḥ zhes par shin tu 'byor/ a ba ta rar/ dpa' bo'i rang bzhin gyi nga rgyal bya ba sogs drang / dngul chu rgyal sras rin 4

nga nga / nga nga nga nga nga nga nga nga nga sa med bsta na nyi'i gsung 'bum/ —lha skal jo bo thugs rje chen po yin/ /zhes dang / mtshan mo byung res pad+ma nga nyid sgomasaḥ rang gi don du badz+ra gu ru sgrongasaḥnyin mo 'phasas pa thugs rje chen po sgoms/ sems can don du ma ṇi yis drug sgrongs/ /zhes gsungs shing srin yul bzhud ka'ang spyi khyab la yig drug gi phan yon gsungs/ sater chos rgya che ba sgrub sde brgyad dang / yan lag las tshogs rab 'byams sogs kyi sand bsdus snying po bla rdzogs thugs gsum zhes 'byung zhing / de gsam ma tshang na gter chen min zhes gter chos kyi ༄skabs su'ang srog bi dbang po lta bur bsngasas pa dang / chos dbang rin po che dang rje thang stong pa rad gling sogs kyis yig drus rgya cher spel zhing ma ṇi'i ril sgrub gyi rgyun btsugs pa dang /jo bo rje lha cig gi gsang chos bka' bdams snying po'i man ngagabastan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa'i bla rdo lta bur bsngags pa thig le bcu drus kyang thubs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs rang yin pa dang / mnga' bdas nyang dang chos dbang rin po ches lha sar mar me'i mchod rgyun btsugs pa dang / rje btsun tsong kha bas mabon po 'jam dbyangs kyi bka' bzhin mdzad chen bzhi'i che shos smon lam chen mo'ang srong btsan gyi dngul dam rta mgo ma gter bzhes sosas dang 'brel bar lha sa'i zhabs tog tu mdzad pa sogs 6 2

thugs chen yig drus gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4— ྾྾—྾rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur/ skye rga na 'chi dang mdza' ba dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal med par 'gyur/ rnal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang lda na par 'gyur/ bsam gtan dpag tu ma mchis pa zil gyis gnon par bgyid/ chos kyi mdzod yongs su gang bar bgyid do/ /zhes gsungs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rdul phra rab snyed kyi sku gzugs lha'i gser rin po che las byed cing byas nas nyin bcig bzhin du ring bsrel 'jug pa de'i 'azas bu rnam par smin pa ni yi ge drub pa'i yig 'bru gcig gi 'bras bu'i rnam par smin pa tsam mo/ /zhes so/ /yul 'khor mor 'jig gi chos smra maṇi ba ba'i lo rgyus kyi thad na/ lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa dab/ po las chos nyan te/ lo la chos nyan pa'i tshe thams cad 'du bar bgyid do/ /lo ni rdo rje chen po dang mnyam pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'chad par mdzad do/ /sems can 'khor ba'i bcing bas bcing ba mang po thar bar mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs te rdo rje dang mnyam lugs ni 'og tu 'ching ba gcod par gsungs pa 'di yin pa 'dra ste/ rdo rje ni lcags sgrog gcog pa yin no/ /yang / dper na mes nags kyi 'dab ma myur du 'tshig par bgyid pa de bzhin du lo mthong ma 169

dzo da/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ba ba ma thag tu sdig pa thams cad 'phrog par mdzad do/ /de bzhin gathe/gas pa rnams kyang mkhyen to/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khris brgya stong phrag du ma dang / tshangs pa dang /'jug sred dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / rlung bi lha dang / chu'i lha dang / me'i lha dang / chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dag khyod la mchod pa'i las bya ba'i phyir mchi'o/ /zhes so/ /yang / nges par 'byung ba tshol ba kha cig dbang phyug chen po dang / 'jug sred sogs la rab tu 'byung ste/ de dag la yang thar ba med/ mgon yang ma yin/ brtul zhugs can yang ma yin no/ /lha mang po dang /tshangs pa dang / — 'jug sred dang / dbang phyug chen po dang /brgya byin lha'i dbang po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / rlung gi lha dang / chu'i lha dang / me'i lha dang / chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje dang bshin rje chos rgyalagyis phyas byas tshul za ma tog dang 'grel chen dri med 'od las so/ /dbang phyug dang rga ri lung bstan pa/ lha mo dpal byis gling bzhi'i sems can rnams kyi longs spyod kyi phyir bre bo lo tog gis gang ba phul ba/ tshogs bdag glang po gdong gi lo rgyus sogs/ rgyal po chen po bzhi dag rtag tu yi be drug pa'i ris sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo slong ngo / /zhes dang / 'di la cung zad bzlas pas kyang theg pa chen po'i rnam pa mang po mdo 160

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa nas gtan la phab par bstan pa'i bar bcu gnyis dang / zhi ba dang / thar pa yang thob par 'gyur ro/ //mang du bshad ci dgos te/ sa'i nang du gtogs pa la snying por 'dzin pa ci yin zhe na/ 'bras ni snying por 'dzin te khyer nas bdag gi khyem du snod rnams yongs su bkang ste 'jog bo/ /bzhag nas nyi ma'i tshul bzhin du nyi ma tsha ba la skems so/ /bskams nas gtun la brdungs shing phub ma rnams sel to/ /de'i snying po ni 'bras rme'u yin te/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor gzhan das phub ma dang 'dra'o/ /rnal 'byor thams cad kyi nang na yig drug gi rig sngags 'di ni 'bras rme'ur gyur pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi phyir tshegs 'byin te bzlas pa gcig byas pas phyin drug yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /la la zhig gis lag pas reg na de dag/ kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa 'thob bo/ /'di'i ming lan gcig bzung na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la na bza' dang bshes dang mal stan dang snyun gyi gsos sman dang yo byad thams cad kyis bkur ster byas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /'di 'dra'i rtags ldan de yig drug phyin drug dang sbyor ba'i khungs su 'gro'am dpyod/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las 'jig rten dbang po'i sku'i ting nge 'dzin las sgrol ma dang gos dkar mo 6

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4pa rdzing bu 'bum phrag mang pos mdzes pa/ de dag gi me tog kyang ut+pal dang pad+ma dang ku myu ta dang / puṇ+ḍa ri ka dang / marnya ra ba dang / marnya ra ba chen po sogs sna tshogs pa/ rin po che sha ri da ka zhes bya ba dang me tog pad+ma ltar snang ba zhes bya ba sogs bsam dgu 'byung ba'i nor bu rin po che'i khyad par yod pa/ drang srong mngon shes thob pa dang / lha dang dri za dang mi'am ci dang dri za'i bu mo dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ba'i zas can grangs med pa dang /rje btsun gyi rjes su slob pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog pa bye ba khrab khrig 'bum phrag mang po la la ni bsam gtan byed/ la la ni theg pa chen po'i chos kyi gtam byed cing gnas pa/ bya dang ri dwags rnams kyang mdo sde za ma tog rjes su dran par byed pa/ rje btsun gyi mtshan dran pa tsam gyis lha'i zas ro mchog dang ldan pa dang lha'i gos sogs lha rdzas kyi longs spyod 'byung ba ste/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi ming gis rjes su dran na ba spu'i khung bu de dag tu skye'o/ /slar 'khor bar mi 'khor ro/ /ba spu'i khung bu nas ba spu'i khung bur 'gro ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa thob kyi bar du de dag na banas par 'gyur bar gsungs so/ /spyan ras gzisas kyi spyod yul 'di'i spyod yul zhes pa ni mngon sumagyi spyod yul lta bu la mi zer gyi/ spyod yul gyi grong zhesapa lhar shas cher mang du gnas 163

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ por/ 4ra sbyar ba ltar yin pas so/ /des na snying rje chen po ji lta ji ltar phul byung dang khyad par can du skyes pa de lta de ltar de'i rten can gyi spyod pa mtha' dag phul byung dang khyad par can du skye ba chos nyid yin pas gong ltar rje btsun gyis snying rje la sprub pa nyams len nam sgom pa'i sbyor ba bsten pa 'dra ba rgyal sras gzhan la med byas dus/ de'i byang chub kyi spyod pa ci tsam rlabs che ba de tsam du rlabs che ba'i spyod pa rgyal sras gzhan la med ces par yang 'gyur ro/ /ma ṇi phyin drug gi ngo bo nyid yin zhes pa'i phyin drug ni phar phyin drug yin tshad la mi byed kyi/ thugs rje chen po'i thugs rgyud kyi de dag la byed pas phyin drug la ring du spyad pa'i rgyal sras rnams kyis kyang ma ṇi'i sngags don gyi gting slebs par dka' ba mi 'gal lo/ /'di bzhin byas na/ 'di ni rnal 'byor dpag tu med pa'i phyir sgrub dka' ba'o/ /zhes pa'ang bshad bde/tshul 'di gdul bya la bstan ched sgrib sel lta bus kyang ma ṇi la sgom tshul dang de'i ched du 'o brgyal mdzad snang / 'di ni nor bzang gi bla ma rnams kyis/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ zhes gsungs pa dang tshul mthun/de'i 'gres kyis ma ṇi'i de nyid la de bzhin gshegs pa mang po'i rnam thar las kyang lhag pa'i sgos chos bshad zin ltar yod pas/167

pod/ nga rdogrub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abung /nga nga nga 'phags pa kho rang gis ma banang bar du yig drug rang dbang du sbyin par sangs rgyas nyid kyis kyang mi spyod pas sangs rgyas pad+ma dam pa de bzhin gshegs par gyur bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang por yig drug 'tshol du gshegs par bstan te/ sgrib sel cad kyis kyang 'phags pa mnyes phyir ma ṇi'i chos smra ba ngan ngon ltar snang ba la yang nga rgyal dang brnyas sems rnam pa thams cad du bcom pa'i gus pa chen po bskyed de nyon zhes pa ste/ 'dis ni 'di'i chos dang bla ma la mi gus pa la ma ṇi ma sbyin cig /ces pa dang / gus pa med pas rig sngags kyi rgyal mo mi 'grub ces dang /'di ster ba'i bla ma'i phyogs su dka' spyod ci tsam byas pa de tsam du 'di'i snod du 'gyur zhes bstan par 'gyur te/ rje btsun nyid kyis pad+ma'i bla ma la phul skabs na/ ma dad pa rnams la sbyin par mi bya/ zhes gsungs pa dang / sgrib sel khor mo 'jig gi chos spru 'i drung du byon thad na/ byang chub sems dpa' 'dis dka' ba mang po spyad kyis rig sngags kyi rgyal mo byin cig /ces gsungs so//de dag gis ni/ kye ma'o bla na med pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di ni sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar zhus kyang thob dka' ba'o snyam du phyi ma'i skye bo rnams gus pa cher bskyed par mdzad do/ /jo bo rjes nga la yon tan ci yang med gsungs/ 'di 168

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dang 'di 'dug pa zhus dus de bla ma'i drin yin bsungs pa ltar 'di ngas shes pa min gyi/ bla ma'i drin las shes pas khyod kyang bla ma'i phyir dka' spyad kyis zhes bshad kyang lom tsam ste/ snga ma bzang snyam/ gong smos gyi phyin drug rlabs po che rnams dmibs med kyi brtse ba chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi steng du 'dril ba'am/phyin drug de rnams bsdus pa'i rang bzhin gyi brtse chen ni yi ge drug po sngags gcig tu tshogs pa'i rig sngabs kyi rgyal mo'i de nyid yin la/ de 'dra'i brtse chen de la ni sher phyin mas kyang phyas mdzad de/ sher phyin sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad kyi yum du 'gyar ba ni de mgon du thob pa'i mtha dang drin yin pa'i da dngaphyir ro/ /des na yi ge drug ma la rgyal ba'i yum gyis kyang phyag 'tshal bar gsungs/ 'phags pa'i ba spu gcig bi bsod nams kyi tshad bshad nas de 'dra sangs rgyas la'ang med gsungs pa'ang /de'i ba spu gcig 'grub byed kyi bsod nams la dgongs pa min nam snyam ste/ bsod nams de bas ches che ba rtse sbyor thob pa'i byang sems phal cher la'ang yod par bshad pas so/ /des na tshe mdo la bskyed pa'i bsod nams zhes sasungs pa yod la/ 'dir yang de'i 'gros ltar rje btsun gyi ba spu gcig la bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyis sangs rgyas mang po dus mtha' yas su mchod pa'i 69

cadad/ 4 nga rdo grub 'bas med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ nga nga kyi gtad rgya mdzad de slar bod yul du de'i sgo nas phrin las byed par lung bstan cing byin gyis brlabs/ gangs brag mtsho gsum sogs 'phags pa'i chos gter kyis gtams/ de kho na ltar phyis bter 'don dus kyang bla rdzogs thugs sasum cha tshang ma thon na bter chen min zhes 'byung ba bzhin thugs rje chen po'i gdams skor re med pa'i bter kha chen po mi snang / gter ston rnams kyi rtsa ba'i thugs dam yang phal cher 'di la mdzad pa bong 'og gnyis dang sangs gling sogs kyi rnam thar gyis mtshon nus/ ma ṇi'i bzlas rgyun spel ba dang skye bdun bum sgrub sogs ma ṇi'i phrin las tshad bzung med par bskyang tshul yang chos dbang rin po che dang //thang sto nga rgyal po/ 'gro 'dul las sping / rad gling / rdor brag rib 'dzin sogs kyi lo rgyus las shes/ sa sater la mang shos bla rdzogs thugs gsum yin pa'i rgyu mtshan des gter srung rnams kyang thags rje chen po zhi drab gi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dam ༄tshig nod pa sha stag yin par shes nus/ bter srung de dag ni bod kyi sa bdas chu bdag che shos rnams so/ /de das thams cad kyang bod spyi mthun la sngags kyi lha'i nang nas las smon gyi 'brel ba che la mang shos thugs rje chen po yin pa'i gnad la satugs dbos/7

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstananyi'i sasung 'bum/4 r+yā྾—4— par byed pa sogs mgo 'jog lubs kyi rten 'brel las so /rnam pa gcig tu na/ rgyal bstan bya ba lung rtogs yin gyi 'ar re 'ur re la mi zer/ bod 'dir rgyal bstan spyi khyab de'i lam srol 'dzugs mkhan dang 'byed byed sogs ma ṇi'i lha sngags yin pa'i rten 'brel des sgos kyi bstan pa rang rgyud la dar rgyas 'byung ba'i tha sa su'ang ma ṇi'i rnal 'byor kho na zab/ des na gsang 'dus kyi kos dkar mo'i phreng sngags thad gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la sobs pa'i chos kyi dngos grub bshad pa dang 'dra ba ma ṇi la chos kyi dngos grub skrub par yid gtod par bya'o/ /bka' sadams thig le bcu drug tu bstan pa rgyas pa'i cho gar bsngags pa'ang de ltar ro/ /ba spu'i khung bu kriṇ+ḍa'i bya ri dwags dang / rin chen rna cha'i dri za'i du mo'i dang / rdo rje sgo 'i mi'am ci'i thad kun na ma ṇi dran pa'i mod la bde ba'i yo byad thams cad rang 'byung bar gsungs pa la brten nas/ sgrib sel gyis/ theg pa chen po'i mdo dkon mchog gi rgyal po za ma tog gi ming dran pa tsam la yang de 'dra'i mthu yod na/ mdo de nyan klog 'dzin pa sogs la lta ci smos zhes ched du brjod/ za ma tog ces pa rnams ni ma ṇi nyid do/ /yang yi ge drub pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo'i ming lan gcib bzung na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la na bza' dang /176

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa ba mi 'bal te/ nyan thos dgra bcom yin mnyam la'ang mchos zung 'gran med du gsungs pa bzhin no/ /phal cher don yod dang / rnam kun don yod sogs kyang chos dbyings mngon sum rtogs par 'dra yang thabs shes kyi rtogs pa rtsal byang ma byang dang / mthu che chung yin la/ de bzhin du spyir sems can sgrol ba la rtogs pa'i rtsal byang mnyam yin yang ches cher snyigs shing rgyud tshig pa'i gdul dka'i 'gro ba lhag par skyob pa la rtogs pa'i rtsal byang tshabs che chung / bur shing 'o ma bu ram gyi/ /mngar ba nyid ni khyad par che/ /zhes pa lta bu yod pa'o/ /rje btsun gyis stong nyid snying rje'i lam 'di sangs rgyas grangs med mchod nas btsal/ rnyed nas smon lam grangs med 'bum bcu sogs dang / sbyin sogs spyod pa dpag med tshad med kyis brgyan te/ rtag 'grus rgyun mi 'chad dang / sgo thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs shing rnam par das la ches phul byung dang mi 'phrogs pa'i sgrub pa mdzad de/ shin tu mthar phyin cing yongs su rdzogs pa na de nyid yig drug tu brlabs pa red pas de thams cad kyi nus pa yig drug kho na la yod do/ /des na mnar med du byon tshe yang ma ṇi tshar re bsungs pa rkyang pas sa chen po'i rdul ltar mtha' yas pa'i dmyal ba tshang sprugs su sprugs nus pa red do//178

thubs zungan yi ga ba ba ji blo nga sna so gas/ nga ma ba / ba bzhin no/ /pad+ma'i rigs la dam pa'i chos kyi 'od zer dang / mdo sde bshad pa'i mthu rnyed phyir sogs yo gar bshad pa ni/ gti mug gi gnyen po sher phyin gyi ngo bo nyid pad+ma 'gro 'dul gyi rigs su dpal mchog 'grel chen du bshad pas/ sher phyin gyi mtshon byed glegs bam du byed pa dang / chos dbyings rtogs pa'i rgyu mthun pa'i gsung rab ces pa dang 'dra bas mi gos pa'i de nyid kyi steng nas shes par bya snyam/ 'di lhar yin nges te/ kun snying bi bhāḥbashad du/ chos kyi rigs zhes pa'i chos ni rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la gzigs pa'i sher phyin du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang nyan rang gis ni dag bya nyon sgrib la ltos te rang bzhin dag pa'i cha tsam mngon sum rtogs te/ de'i dbang gis dag pa phyogs gcig pa de la brten pa'am de'i yon tan du gyur pa'i 'phags pa'i chos kyang nyi tshe ba tsam brnyes la/ theg chen nas sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag byar bzhag pa'i rang bzhin dag pa mtha' dag mngon du byed de de'i dbang gis dag pa ma lus pa de'i yon tan dag pa de la brten pa'ang mtha' dag pa 'thob ste/'di ni rang bzhin dag pa de sgom byed lam gyi dbang gis chos kyi dbyings sam 'phags chos kyi 'byung khungs su 'gyar tshul rgya che ༄181

thubs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sobs/ pob/ 4phyag drug pa'i yum gyi sngags la yang / bh+yo nag mo bai ta li zhes rgyud las gsungs so/ /'o rkyal sgom bzlas/ bsrub bsgrilayus che bas mi chog /zo mar drod tshad gyi gong bu thon pa dgos/ rdo rje'i de nyid ni mi chod mi shigs mi phyed pa ste/ de dran nas li pi sha ta bzlas pas shin tu brtan par byed/ 'phags mchog gang du dmis/sa pa der sa bcu par lag na rdo rje stong phrab brgya rtab tu phyi bzhin 'brang bar gsung pa ltar gyi lag na rdo rje'i srung ma dang / rta mchog rig pa bye ba'i 'khor dang bcas pa sogs 'khor dag pa gzhal med rnams mi'i lus shig med na med du zad/ yod phan chad grib ma zhig nges par yod pa dang / ga bur zhig yod na dri bsung nges par yod pa lhar 'bral med du yod nges pa dmigs 'og tu chug dgos/ khong rigs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba red pa/'khor lo sgyur ba'i rgyal po dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi dang mi ldan pa zhig shes bya la mi srid pa des na rdo rje khro bo'i dmag dpung bye ba khrag khrig rang shugs kyis rjes su 'brang ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /pad+ma'i mi gos pa'i de nyid dang / chu 'dam nas skyes shing chu 'dam na gnas pa'i de nyid gnyis rim bzhin don dam sems bskyed dang kun rdzob sems bskyed/ shes pa rnam dab dang / shes bya rnam dag /srid mtha' 'gog byed dang / zhi mtha' 'gog byed/18 3

cadacadang/ ba rdogruba'ajigs med bstananyi'ibasungang bum/ nga nga mngon mtho mthar thug dang nges legs mthar thug /rang don dam pa phunatshogs dang gzhan don dam pa/ thugs dben pa'i bde mthong chos bde gnas sogs kyang bas kang zhing / skru 'du 'apa'i khrod na yang spyod pa/ phyag stong spyan stong gi mdor/ gal te chos bzhin du bzlas brjod byas te sems can rnams la snying brtse ba'i sems bskyed par gyur na bdag kyang de'i tshe dge ba'i lha dang / klu'i rgyal po thams cad dang / lag na rdo rje gsang ba rnams la rtag par de'i rjes su 'brang zhing yongs su srung ba gyis shis /de'i nye 'khor na gnas nas mig gi 'bras bu bzhin du yongs su srangs ༄thig /rang gi srog gi dbang po bzhin du yongs su skyobs shib ces basbo bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag blus gsang ba'i bdag po rdo rje 'chang / /bdud rtsi 'khyel ba sme brtsesas lcags kyu can/ stobs ldan shaṃ ka ra dang sde brgyad dag /btang nas rtab tu kazungs 'dzin srung bar byed/ /ces sogs mang du gsungs te/ ma ṇi zlos tshe lha klu mang pos srung tshul ka raṇ+ḍar bsungs pa dang 'dra'o/ /de ltar srung ma rang 'khor ba'i dbang gis 'brob dbon sogs su gcig pur nyal yang gdon bgegs kyis gtse mi nus pa dang /mya ngam sogs su lam gol bar 'khyam yang / lha klu'i sprul pas lam ston pa dang / nags tshal stong pa sogs su me'am chus 84

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4྾ ྾྾྾྾phongs na de dag sbyin par sasungs te/ dgra jag chom rkun 'ching ba dang / mthun pa'i yo byad gzhan 'du ba sos/sa mang por sbyor chog thusas ka'i ye sems rta mgrin du byas nas sngags 'khor bkod de/ rta skad kyis bde gshegs gsung gi dngos grub sdud pa la dmigs pa satad nas bzlas na sngags kyi nus pa skye ba'i khyad che 'dra/ mdor na chos ni mi 'tshe ba'o/ /zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyid rjes phye/ lha chen dmod pa grub pa sogs nas/ mabon lo thugs rje grub pa las sogs lha dang drang srong dmod pa'i mtshon cha can rnams kyi dmod pas mi khyim 'bum phrag du mas gang ba'i grong chen ring por mi thogs par 'brog dgon stong par byas skad de rbab thur la btang ba lha bu 'jigs rung sga dper byed/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs bskyed pa re res sam 'od zer re res stong gsum brjod med brjod med tshad med gzhal med kyi rdul snyed kyi 'gro ba mngon mtho nges lesas kyi bde ba bzang mang la 'jog pa red/ rbab gyen la 'then pa lha bu stethur du rbab stong sgril de bas/ gyen du pha bong gcig 'dren pa ches dka' bas ya mtshan dpe med/ mthu phyi ma 'di sa dang po'i yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis nas rim gyis nam son tshul sogs/ dang po rtsa ba tha ma 'bras mchog ldan/ /sogs dang / rnam snang mngon byang las/ snying rje'i rtsa ba can yin zhes/ /sgrub byed thugs rje goms 186

nga cad/ nga rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'igasung 'bum/ nga nga nga las de/ /zhes/ theg chen phyir mi ldos gi rtags kyang rang don yid byed bsdams pa'i steng nas bzhag yod/ mdzod 'grel dang rnam 'grel rang 'grel las sogs 'thad sgrub skor/ tshad chen 'grel par/ de 'dod pa'i phyir ro zhes sogs kyis gzhan don rang bi 'dod don yin lubs/ bdas bces 'dzin gyis phongs shing rang don phun tshogs mi 'byung ba bzlog na don gnyis 'byung lugs sanyis kyis snying rje skyed nus dang / skyed dgos gnyis bstan/ dang po ni/ brtse med bo/mas na der 'gyur ba ro sreg mkhan brtse bral dang / bram ze gtsang zhen sogs kyis bsgrub yod/ dgra gsod phrog la rang don du zhen pa la 'dod pa'i phyir ro zhes pa las sgrub byed gzhan med de'i rigs pas snying rje shin tu goms na zhes sogs kha bsgyur/gzhan phan dga' ba sogs slob spring dang / sems can rnams ni grol ba na sogs/ 'gro drug skyed tshul dus sto na ltar/ /rang bi yon tan sems can phan 'dogs dga'/ thub pa'i skyes rabs thams cad bdag bas gzhan gces mdzad tshul kho nar gsungs/mthong ba'am grong khyer rgyu ba na/ long bas mig thob sogs/mtshan bzung ba tsam yang brgyad brgya pa sogs ltar/ ston pa dang shā ri'i bu'i snam sbyar steng phug ron babs pa/ ston pa dang kun dga' bos seṅge la reg pa/ rnam kun don yod ni/ sangs rgyas 86

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ ngo ba/ 4cad shugs 'byung du 'ong ba ni 'khor lo kho na red pa de ltar snying rje chen po yod na spyod pa thams cad lhun grub tu 'byung / byang sems ni chos ngan pa la dmigs pa'i snying rje las bo 'phang mchog grub/ nyan rang de las zlog /skye ba dpag tu med par lha mi yi/ /'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzad nas/ /zhes par bsam btan gzugs med kyi mthar son pa'i snying rjes 'jig rten la dbang sgyur sogs/ snying rje chen po kho rang zhi mtha' 'gog byed/ snying rje'i rgyu yid 'ong dang sdug bsngal sems pa phyi ma la sdug bsngal brgya rtsa bcu sogs ji tsam bsam nas yid 'byung rgyas pa de tsam du snying rje 'phel ba/ srid mtha' 'gog byed/skyon mthong phyir ni srid par min/ /zhes srid pa'i nyes dmikas rig pa ste/ mi rtag sdug bsngal sogs kyi rnam can/ rgya ma'i blo sbyong gi 'gro don rab thad na/ 'dod 'du la yid ma log pa la snying rje rnal ma gtan med gsungs te/ 'dod bde can bdud dang / sems bde can tshangs pa lta bu man chad thams cad snying rje ba'i gnas su 'char ba la/ srid bde de thams cad sdug bsngal du mthong ba dgos/ des na snying rje'i rtsa ba'i rgyus srid mtha' khegs pas snying rje chen po goms pas srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis ka sel byas kyang rung bar bo/ sems can rang ngos nas 189

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4྾ ྾4྾re ba skong bar bsngags te/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin gyi yon tan nam byin gyi rlabs so/ /byang 'phasas kyi dmigs med snying rje ni gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i bsgad pa can dang / sangs rgyas kyi ni bslad pa de med pas khyad par gnam sa tsam mo/ skye bo che chung gi khyad par ni/ sems rgya che chung ngam/ bsam pa rgya che chung gis 'byed de/ dbu ma snying por/ wa ni glang chen dregs khyu yi/ /sogs ltar/ rtog ge 'bar bar/ me khyer dang nyi ma'i dpe bstan pa sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /des na/ chos kyi dbyings na skyes du gcig pu ba/ /zhes sogs 'byung ngo / /pad+ma'i kha dog dkar bas rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la gzigs pa'i sor rtog ye shes mtshon/ dmar bas srid par chags pa'i snying rje mtshon mod kyi phyi mas shin sbyang gi dga' bde 'dren pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dmar ba'ang ston lugs yod dam dpyad/ pad dkar can ni sku mdog dang ṭīḥyang dkar/ sku mdog dmar po can ni phyag mtshan dang srog yig kyang dmar te de thams cad de nyid gcig pas so/ /byang sems kyi snying rje la brtse ba tsam gyis mi chog sems can grangs mang ba/ byed pa ngan pa/ sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho tshad med pa sogs gang gis kyang mi zlog cing mi 'jigs pa dang / sgyid lug pa med par shin tu dpa' ba'i snying rje stobs ldan rlabs che 191

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum྾ ྾ ྾ba blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/ grong dpon pha ma banyis kyi dpe gsungs pa lta bu/dgos la/ de la sdug bsngal 'bral 'dod kyis bskyab dgos su mthong ba tsam gyis mi chog /bskyab nus su mthong ba stobs ldan dgos/ de la dbang non gyis sems can skyob par khur 'khyer ba'i snying rje skye ba'i sngon 'gro/ yang das thes tshol sngon btang ste sob/sa ltar dgos/ dbang rnon la 'bral 'dod kyi snying rje chen po skye ba la stong rtogs sngon 'gro mi dgos kyang / skyob 'dod kyi brtse chen mtshan nyid jogs pa la dgos zhes pa/ lung 'di'i/ 'gro don byed par dpa' gyur pa/ /zhes pa go rgyu che ste/ snying rje yod kyang sngar bag dang bcas pa mang bas de las khyad skyob 'dod 'don no/ /des na sems can thams cad gshob gcig gi bden 'dzin 'khrul 'khor kho na la brten nas ma rig pa'i 'khrul 'khor rgyas pa tsam du shes nas/ sdug bsngal ba'i gnad shes nas bshob de'i mtshang brtol baXtsam zhig sems can dgrol ba'i gnad du mthong na zhum pa sogs mi skye bas sems can thams cad dgrol ba'i snying rje la dmigs med kyi snying rje bsngags/ de'ang snying rje dang bdag med rtobs pa rgyud naXso sor yod tsam nyan rang la'ang yod pas/de gnyis sbyar nas phan tshun gcig gi/sa gcig zin par/ bogs 'don res kyis dmigs phug ste rgya cher sbyang dgos/ stong nyid rtobs pa'i shes rab kyi bdud rtsi gya nom pa de nyan rang gis nges 'byung 192

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'gum/྾྾ ྾ ྾4skyob dgos su mthong ba'ang khyad 'don te/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du lhag bsam dag pa'i sa zhes pa lta bu mthong nas so/ /bdag chags lhag pa'i skyon lnga de dag la/ /yod pa de dag de spong don du gsungs/ /zhes so/ /rtag pa dam pa'i lag rjes 'jog byed/ mya ngan 'das la mngon dga'i phyir zhes 'di skorami mthun phyogs dang gnyen po phyogs kyi gzhi shes kyi thad dang sgrigs dang legs po ra 'ong / zhi bde dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal kha thag ring bas nyan rang gi thugs la 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa 'char ba'ang dka'/ gong ma'i lugs la'ang / srid pa'i chos nyid stong nyid yin yang / stong nyid dang kun rdzob gnyis blo ngor rang bzhin ches bskal bas snying rje bral bas stong rtogs la chig dril byas na/ mthar stong dbyings su gnyid la ba/yur ba lta bu dang / 'dus byas 'khor ba la blo gtan mi 'jug pa 'dra mo yong / stong pa nam bsgom la snying rje'i rtsi drag pos zin nges dang / stong nyid rtogs rim bzhin de snying rje'i grobs su 'gro tshabs je che dang / snying rje yang stong pa'i grogs su je 'gror bslab pas/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus par/ shing sdong gcod pa'i dpe dang zhing la chu bkye ba'i dpe ltar/ sto nga nyid la zhugs tshabs che rung / snying rje'i shugs na re ba dang / snying rje'i dran pa nyams par yod pas/ stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa'i 194

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ 4 r+yā—nyid rtogs pa'i sher phyin gyi mnyam bzhab/ sems can thams cad dang thun mong du bsngos pa'am/ snying rjes sher phyin lus can ma lus pa'i thun mong gi spyad par bsngos tshul lam brlab tshul ni/ ma mtha' theg chen tshogs lam dus nas stong nyid la dmigs pa'i bsam byung nam sgom du de gzhad don kho na la dmibs nas sam ga'an don ched du bya bar bzhag nas sgom 'a / de gong nas bong du nar son nas sa thob bar du mthu je cher 'grur ba'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi nyer 'tshor byin gyis brlabs pa yin la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis mnyam bzhag de la 'khor ba 'dzin byed dam mngon mtho sgrub byed thabs bsod nams kyi tshobs thams cad kyang nus pa mthu can du tshang ste/ de phar phyin drug ldan dang / sgrib gnyis sbong ba'i nus ldan dang / longs sku'i 'khor du skye ba len pa'i rnam smin gyi rgyu sobs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /des na mnyam bzhag de ka 'khor ba las 'da' byed du ma zad/ 'khor bar gnas byed kyi rgyur yang 'gyur/ de bzhin du sher phyin nges bzung ba'i'am/ de snying por yod pa'i snying rje'ang 'khor bar gnas byed du ma zad/ 'khor ba'i nyes pa las 'da' byed du'ang 'gyur/byams snying rje 'jig rten gyi gtso bo'i bo 'phang sgrub byed yin lugs thad/ rgyu byams pa'i dmigs rnam rgya che chung ltar/ 'bras bu rgyal sred rgya che chung du 'gyur tshul/ stong gsum byams pa'i 196

thubs chen yig drug gi skoratsho sogs/ ngo da/ 4rab pa pa paradamigs 'og tu chug na tshangs chen dang mi mjed bdag por skye ba sosas be bum sngon po ltar/ rgyud bla'i/ ji bzhin yang dag /skye sogs rnams las zhes pa ni khyad gzhi dkar ba dang / khyad chos mi gos pa/ snying rje'i bdag nyid/ 'chi dang rga dang / zhes pa 'dam las skyes dang 'dam na gnas pa'i de nyid/ de ni snying rjes 'jig rten sdug /de nyid kyis ni yun ring gnas/ /zhes so//lus mi gos pa nas/ ngag /yid/ spyod pa mi gos tshul mang /skye 'chi bar do'i nyes pa dang / snyigs ma lngas mi gos tshul sobs/rang bzhin dag par rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam/ des lag rjes bzhag pa'i rnam grol lam/ thag bsring gi gnyen po khyad par lam/ de'ang sa bcu'i rim pas gong nas bo/nga du khyad zhugs pas khams gsum las shin tu 'das pa yin/ de ltar 'das pa dang khyad du 'phags pa don 'dra/ gong mas 'og ma zil gyis gnon pa dang / dbang bsgyur nus pa ni tshangs pas 'dod lha bzhin no/ /de lhar khams gsum las shin tu thaka bsring ba'i dben pa mthar thug brnyes pa na/ dbang med du khams gsum na spyod pa'i cha thams cad lhag ma med par gtan log tu song ba yin cing / de nyid kyang bskal pa mtha' yas par goms nas ngang du gyur pa'i dmigs med kyi snying rje chen pos 'khor bar bsngos pas/ rang 197

rdo ba ba zungam kyi ba nga ba ji smo ma da da ba ba / pa ba ba / ba tog sna tshogs rigs rnams kyis/ /kun tu dri yis bkang ba ste/ /sna tshogs yid 'ong 'bras bur ldan/ /rkang drug pa rnams glu sgra 'byin/ /mi'am ci rnams dbyangs snyan len/ /glang po myos pas rab tu gtams/ /grub pa rig 'dzin tshogs dang ni/ /dri za rnams kyis glu blangs pa/ /thub pa 'dod chags bral rnams kyis/ /rtag tu legs par bsten pa na/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs gzhan dang / /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyang ste/ /'phasas ma sgrol sogs lha mo rnams/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo stong rnams dang / khro bo'i rgyal po'i tshogs sazhan dang / /rta mgren la sosas kyis bskor ba'i/ /sems can kun la phan brtson pa/ /brtsom ldan 'das ni spyan ras sazigs/ /bzhugs te de nas dpal dang ldan/ /pad+ma'i snying po'i gdan bzhugs pa'i/ /dka' thub chen po dang lda na pa/ /byams dang snying rje ldan pa yis/ /lha yi 'khor ni chen po la/ /de yi chos ni ston par bzhed/ /ces sasangs/ yang de ༄las/ skyob pa 'od dpas med pa yi/ /smon lam dbang gis byung ba ste/ /bdag gi ar+yapa lo bka' yis 'jig rten ma/ /snying rje che dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro ba 'don par brtson pa mo/ /nyi ma shar ba dang 'dra ba/ /zla ba nya 'dra byad kyi 'od/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /'di rnams sgrol zhing snang bar byed/ /'jig rten 99

thugs chen yig drug gi skoraca da sobs/ da dpa/rang goms pa de ltar snying rje'i bye brag tu 'gyur/ snying rje'i srog tshul khrims kyis 'dzin te/ byang sdom gyi srog kyang so thar gyi sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin cing / de'i srog kyang gzhan la mi 'tshe ba'i brtul zhugs red pas tshul khrims ldan (na)ngang gis snying rje dang mthun pa'i rgyud bzang por 'gyur/ sdug bsngal brgya rtsa bcu sogs dmigs pa mang zhing rgya che ba/ sbyong tshul rgyu 'bras bdun ma dang mnyam brje sogs mang ngo / /snying rje'i rnal 'byor rgyun mi 'chad pa'i 'phen smon dang rgyu mthun gyis skye ba dpag med dang bskal pa tshad med par sbyang ba/ 'grus par ram bsgrims te'am sems thams cad kyis bslab pa bar ma chad par sbyang ba/ bzod pa'i sgo nas log sgrub sogs kyis mi 'phrog pa'i rtsal thon pa ste byang ba/ bsam gtan gyi sems rten lasnying rje sbyang ba/ shes rab kyi stobs kyis dmibs med kyi snying rjer byas pa/ snying rje dang sbyin sogs la gang bslab snying rje chen po brgyud pa'i ched du bsngo ba/ snying rje 'phel brtan sogs phyir sangs rgyas grangs med mchod pa sogs sgo tshad med nas snying rje'i shugs rgyas pa red/ci tsam du snying rje lhas pa de ltar gzhan phan gyi dga' ba lhag par 'gyur ba ni/ dmigs yul gyi sems can ci tsam phongs shing rgud pas nyen pa de ltar de la dmigs pa'i snying rje lhag par 'gyur la/ 20

mngocad/ ba rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'a'am/de ci tsam lhag pa'i tshod tsam du de dag bskyab pa las byung ba'i dga' ba lhag ste/ bu la tsher ma zug pa dang / bu rgyal po gdug pa'i khrims mun du chud pa gnyis ma la sems khral skye tshul mi 'dra/de'i dbang gis snga ma thon pa dang / phyi ma las thar ba'ang dga' ba che chung phyogs mi 'dra ba lta bu'o/ /'phags mchog dmyal bar mang du 'byon pa'ang der 'byon pa la dgyes nas yin gyi/ mi dgyes bzhin min la/ de'ang dmyal ba na chen po'i 'byor ba bla med yod pa'i dbang gis te/ chen po'i 'byor pa ni/ chen po ni 'khri shing las/ zla ba'i kun dasa' nyi ma'i rab gsal dang / /sogs dang / slob spring du/ rang don 'gal med chen po rnams kyi rang bzhin de 'dra ste/ /zhes dang / dbu ma snying po'i le'u dang por/ rigs ngan dang rgyal po chen po'i dpes bshad nga/ ltar yin cing / de'i 'byor ba ni sems can yongs sa smin pa'i bzhan ༄phan gyi dga' ba'o/ /de'i phyir 'khor sgyur lha'i skyed tshal du 'jug pa lta bur za ma tog las gsungs/ gzhan phan gyi dga' ba ci tsam yod pa gsal bar phongs pa la rang srog dang rgyal srid chen po byin tshe rten gyi dga' ba phul byung gi tshod tsam yul la med par mdo rgyan las dang / 'jus par/ ji ltar byin cig ces sgra sobs kyi 'gres sbyar na sla/ de 'dra'i gzhan phan gyi bde ba ni 20 2

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4 gzhan 'phrul 'dod bde dang tshangs pa'i bsam gtan bde ba dang nyan rang gi zhi ba'i bde ba gang gis kyang mi mtshon par/slob spring gi/ gzhan phan dga' ba rnams kyi sogs dang / spyod 'jug gi/ sems can rnams ni grol ba na/ /sogs ltar ro/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i mtshan don thad/ rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la gzigs pa la dbang thob pa'am dbang sgyur brnyes pa'i don ni/ snying rje shin tu shugs drag stobs ldan gyi rtsi'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa'i stong nyid rtos/sa pa'i zhi lhag zung 'brel gyi ting 'dzin phul byung gi mthus bsam gtan rnams bzlog nas 'dod khams su 'gro ba lnga'i gzugs sna tshogs su skye ba ston pa dang / rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la dmikas pa'i ting 'dzin goms pas 'gog pa thob pa zhes bskal ba la sogs par rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings las mi ldang ba'i mthu yun ring mo nas thob kyang / sa bdun par blo lhag stobs kyis zhi mtha' 'gog pa'i nus pa thob cing / sa dgu par zhi mtha'i 'jigs pa dang bral nas yun ring lon pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas zag med kyi dbyings su mi lhung bar 'khor bar gzugs sna tshogs 'dzin pa ste/mdor na rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings la gzigs pa'i ting nge 'dzin rtsal rdzosas kyang rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin gyi sa/zhan 203
