〉pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs medacha gan nyi'i bas 'bum/ nga nga nga nga dbang du phar mi 'chor bar/ ting nge 'dzin de rnal 'byor pa'i rang dbang du tshur 'dus nas gang 'dod byar yod pa ste/ 'di ko sa la'i rgyan la brten nas bshad do/ /pad gling gter byon bayu sgron ma'i sgab thabs dang pra sgrub na/ bdag bskyed thubs rje nga nga nga nga pa'i nga nga nga ran pa' rgyad par bshad da/ pra skrub la bdas bskyad da ltar bsngasas pa ni/ pra snga gas la chu bur mig bi sgo sol/ zhes med par sngakas 'bru drug dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mo ston zhes 'byung ba ltar spyan ras gzigs mig 'byed dam spyan 'byed kyi lhar bsngabs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin par mngon/ yo ga las mngon shes kyi lhar bsngags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi lhar sems dpa' bcu drug 'byung ba'i thad nas gsungs pa lta bu'i gnad kyis yin te/ de'i steng nas kyang rno mthong mngon shes rigs spyi la bsngags par rtogs nus nga1 'dra ste/ bsang ba thams cad kyi spyi'i cho ga dkyil chog rdor phreng dang sngags rim las kyang spyan ras gzigs la brten nas rmi lam brtabs pa gsungs so/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sgra'i zur phyi ma 'dir 'di nges na bris pa 'di'i rigs pa sbyar na/ srib ngo 'dir 'khod 'di ni stong rtogs sor rtog ye shes la sbyar ba ste/ des dpags nas snying rje la sbyar na/'khor ba pa rnams la snying rje'i 'dzum mis rtas tu chags pas 204

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—྾ 4྾ 4྾྾bshad pa lta bu/ gal te mi tra dang bka' 'bum bsnyun rgyu byed na/kri yog gi pad+ma'i bshad lusas mi 'dra ste/ bya spyod du pad+ma dkar po mdzad nas pad+ma snying rje dang / de'i kha dog dkar po rang bzhin dag pa mapho pa'i sor rtog ye shes la sbyar/ yo gar pad+ma dmar po mdzad nas pad+ma chos kyi ting 'dzin nam rang bzhin dag pa'i ting 'dzin dang / dmar ba snying rje la spyar/ de bzhin du pad dkar kho na'ang khyad gzhi'am rten gzhi'i steng nas bshad tshe mi tra ltar dang / khyad chos sam rten chos kyi ngos nas bshad na bka' 'bum ltar 'gyur/ ma ṇi bgrang nor du byed tshe'ang /yid skyob kyi cha nas rang rgyud lda na skyob tshe mi tra ltar/ gzhan rgyud skyob par sbya ra tshe bka' 'bum ltar/ 'di thams cad dpyad gzhir bkod/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa rnams kyi lus ni theg pa chen po'i dam pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin gyi lus yin phyir/ kom pa 'degs 'job /lag pa brkyang bskum/dbugs 'byung rngub/ sems sems byung / sems bskyed pa'i skad cig thams cad pha rol phyin drug dang ldan pa kho nar 'byung ste/spos kyi rigs 'bum phrag sbyar ba'i phyi ma'am lde gu la spos sna gzhan dang ma 'dres ma bsgos pa'i spos rdul cig len rgyu med pa lta bur mdo las gsungs/ yig drug phyin drug gi ngo bo nyid yin 200

nga nga/ ba rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/ nga nga bstan pa 'di la mi mjed du skyes tshad shākya'i rgyal pos sngon bsdu bzhi'i spyod pa'i cha shas kyis zin pa re yin dgos te/ de'i zhing yin pa'i phyir/ de las kyang bod du skyes tshad spyan ras gzigs la lhag par las 'brel che ba kho na yin par bstan pa 'dir bod du skyes pa'i rtags kyis dpogs nus/ des na 'di thams cad kyi rtsa bar ston pas bod 'di 'phasas pa 'di la gtad cing lung bstan pa de grub na des 'thus la/ de ni chos rgyal bka' 'bum dang / bka' chems ka khol ma sogs kyis 'grub cing / phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi/ byang phyogs su ni byang chub sems dpa' las na pad+ma 'grub bo/ /zhes pa'ang de ltar ro/ /bod 'di shākya'i rgyal po'i zhing thi cha shas su 'dod dgos la/ zhing gcig na ston pa gcis tu zad pas spyan ras gzigs kyi zhing du ji ltar rung zhe na/ gling bzhi yongs rdzogs 'khor sgyur gcig gi mnga' 'og yin yang / nang gses su khams kyi rgyal po brgyad khri sogs la so sor dbang ba'i yul 'khor ris su bcad pa re yod pa mi 'gal ba lta ba ste/ rje btsun 'di 'os/ min du sangs rgyas zin dang / bde ba ༄can na rgyal tshab sacig pu yin yang zhing 'dir mdzad pa bstan tshul la bsam dgos/ ma ṇi ni nor bu ste/ rtog pa med pa dang /dgos 'dod sbyin pa gnyis kyi gzhi mthun ltar/ spros pa'i rtog 208

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod 4zhes so/ /kun snying gi 'gro 'dul 'grel par/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dam par dag pa bdag yin no zhes bsgom la nang gi bdag nyid can gyi khrus byas te/ snying po byang chub la thug bi/ bar du dngos por 'dzin pa'i mngon par zhen pa mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ /'di dang a ba ta ra'i/ dpa' bo'i rang bzhin gyi nga rgyal bya sogs bsgrig tshe pad+ma dkar po'i kha dog gi de nyid kyis bgekas dang nyams grib sogs sel tshul shes/ rdo rje chos ni glur blang bas//zhes bya ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo'i sems dang sems las byung ba dang pad+ma'i rigs ni rdo rje chos so/ /de glur blang ba ni chos thams can ni rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes so sor rtog pa ste/ de'ang gsal ba'i dbye bas rnam pa sna tshogs so sor rtog pa yin te/ de bas na glur blangs pa zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /zhes de nyid snang ba las so /lo rgyus thad/ bod 'dir phan bde'i snang ba rgya cher 'char ba'i gleng gzhi gtso che shos ni/ phyogs 'di'i 'gro ba rnams 'phags pa la las kyi 'brel ba lhag par che zhing / 'phags pa nyid kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang dang / sto na pas kyang yul 'di rje btsun 'di'i gdul zhing du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus so/ /smon lam ni/ gangs ri'i ljongs de snying rje'i bsil 'od dang rjes 2/1

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4྾ ྾྾mdzad ces byas na thugs dam lha'i nang nas de kho na smos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang bshad bde ba 'dra/ der ma zad bshad bya sher phyin gyi mdo sde spyan drangs/ 'chad byed dbu ma rtsa ba mdzad nas de'i mtshan la'ang sher mdo las shes rab ces ngatasas te/ 'di gnyis shing rta'i srol 'byed kyi dang por 'jog byed dang / theg chen gyi bstan pa la bka' drin che bar byed pa'i sgo che shos so/ /gzhan yang ye shes snying po/ tsan+d+ra go mi/ tsad+ma ti pa/ sgra mkhan pa ṇi/ bram ze mo rab gsal ngang tshul/ bram ze mchog sred/ bram ze ba su ne tra/ dge slong ma dpal mo/ tshong dpon gyi bu su kha de ba khyo shug khaṅga pa/ ka ma la go mi/ dge bsnyen zhi ba'i go cha/badz+ra de ba/ dpal ldan mar me mdzad ye shes/ grub chen dpe med 'tsho/ mi tra dzo ki/ rnam rgyal grags pa'i lha/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ sangs rgyas zhi ba sogs 'phags pa'i rib sngags grub pa'i gtam rgyud mang / lho phyogs dpal gyi rir klu sgrub kyi sku gdung gi rdzu 'phrul gyis rdo la byon pa'i 'phags pa gtso 'khor lnga pa/o ṭi bi shar rdo rje dril bu pas rdzu 'phrul gyis spyan drangs pa'i rdo sbu/shar phyogs kha sar pa ṇi'i lha khang sogs/ mi dbang rgo sā la ni kha sar pa ṇi'i btsug lag khang du phyin nas gsol ba btab pas rgyal srid thob ba'o/ /gter ston chen po phal cher gyi thugs dam gyi 21 3

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs / nga nga nga cadang/ sa bu'i gter yin par shes/ zla med pa zhes pa 'di la myang rgyu zhim po yod/ bka' gdams brgyud pa na yang / thugs rje chen po'i grub thob/ yol chos dbang / job/ sgom yon tan rgyal po/ chag khri mchog sogs jo bo'i dngos slob dang / slad nas rgyal sras rin po che thogs med bzang po dpal sogs smyung gnas brgyud pa nyi phug pa man chad thams cad dang thig le bcu drus gi brgyud pa'i bla ma sogs bzang mang byon/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan gyis kyang ma ṇi dung phyur gnyis gsungs/ lha 'di'i rigs kyi zhi drag gi lha gzhan rnams kyang mkhyen brtse nus gsum las shas cher brtse ba'i ribs kyi lha yin stabs gzhan las byin rlabs myur ba sha stag ste/ sgrol ma dkar mo/ ljang mo/ rta mgrin/dzam dkar/ mgon po myur mdzad sogs so zhes kong sprul rin po ches gsung / rigs gsum byed dus/ brtse ba'i rigs la nus pa'i rigs kyi dngos grub tshang ba chos dmigs kyi snying rje la sems can la dmigs pa tshang yang gsum du phye ba'i sems can la dmigs pa min pa lta bu/ bla med du'ang las rigs pad+ma'i rigs su 'du gsungs/ bod 'dir phrin las che ba'i 'phags pa'i sadams pa ni/ dpal mo lugs kyi smyung gnas/ jo bo'i yi ge drug pa/ srong btsan bka' 'bum rnams yin snang / phyi ma 2 6

pod/ 4 no grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4྾ —྾—'di grub thob dngos grub nas rob bde gshebs chen po shes rab 'od dang / mnga' bdag nyang gnyis la bka' babs shing 1 grub mtha' thams cad la dar/ chos dbang yang snying 'dus pa'ang phrin las tshad med/ gzhan yang dam pa dmar po ba ri lho/ gnyan tshem bu pa mtshan dar ma 'od zer te/ 'di la 'phags pa nyid kyis yi ge drug pa'i bskyed rdzogs kyi dmar khrid gnang ba zab par grags shing dam pa du mas thugs dam mdzad/ sogs nas brgyud pa mang / de 'dra rnams rab byung dang sngags pa rnams la dar che ba red/mi naka tsho la'ang ris med du khyab pa ni/ 'bru drus chig rkyang de'o/ /lhan skyes rol pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs su/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi snying po rtog pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di mtshan ma med pa'i sbyor bas blta zhing bzlas pa bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes sogs rgya ba/zhung rnams las yig drug kho na 'byung yang / gter phyosas su yig bdun mang la/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang byang gter las/ phyi ni srog sbas zhi ba'i tshulaḥ yi ge drub pa rdo rje'i sgraḥ zhes pa nas/ gsang ba srog gi mtha' rten canaḥsnyigs ma'i dus su srog mthar rtenaḥ zhes gsungs te/ spyir yig drug rang yang thugs sros skul ba'i sngags las ma 'das mod/'on kyang gnyis ka skul byed yika drug dang / bskul bya srog yig /dngos su 216

par 'du ba pa rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gad bum/ ba yang na thugs rje'i spyod pa ni/ rin chen phreng bar/ rang gi don la mi lta bar/ /sogs ltar gzhan phan gyi spyod pa red la/ de ma 'khrul pa ni rang don yid byed sogs kyi dri ma med pa chung ngu na/sogs byis pa rnams ci byed rang bde 'dod pa phugs bcug las mi 'da' zhing / rang 'dod la bar gseng mi 'chor ba ltar/ de go bzlog pa'i steng nas bsngags te/ 'khor gyi 'jibs pa'ang bsal ba'i phyir/ /zhes sdong po bkod pa'i lung dang sbyar bar mdzad/ 'di'ang bshes spring gi/ 'gro ba nyam thag mang po rjes bzung ste/ /zhes pa'i rgyas bshad lta bur 'gyur/ de ltar bdag sa/zhan mnyam brje'i sgo nas bsngags pa 'dis/ de ltar rgyud ni koms gyur pas/ /sogs ltar lhar bcas 'jis rten nyan rang man chad dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gzhan phan gyi bde ba'i 'byor pa rgya che la gya nom pa mi 'phrog pa'i sgo nas bsngags par yang 'gro ste/ lha dbang dang 'khor sgyur la 'dod yon kyi dpal 'byor dang /tshangs pa la bsam gtan gyi dga' bas bsngags pa sob/sa ni/'di dang gshib na nyi ma'i drung na me khyer dang / 'dzam bser dang ra gan bzhin no/ /mdo rgyan du/ rgyan dang ston mo sa mchos rtse dga' ba/ sogs dang sacig red/ bod 'bangs spre'u dang bras sren las chad zer te/ der sgrol ma'i sprul pa'i brag srin mo 218

da ba / ba da grub nga nga ma da bstan nyib gsung 'bum / nga paramang du byung / rnal 'byor pa khri mchog chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa las bskyabs pa dang / kha rag sgom chung bis srog chags grangs med pa ri me shor bas 'tshig tu nye ba gzisas nas sgrol ma la bos shing me nang du mchong bas chus btab ltar zhi ba dang / sa skya bdab chen bzang po dpal la sadung rgyud kyi mchog balha ba dang /rong pa sga lo'i sras dang nye gnas khri mon nas bton pa dang /gnyan lo rgya gar du dug sprul las bskyabs pa dang / 'bri gung spyan snga'i nye sanas hor mi chen gyi chad pa las bskyabs pa dang / steng ba lo tsā/ chag dgra bcom/ zhwa dmar rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge sogs tshad nad las dang / bla ma rin ye ba chu'i 'jigs pa las dang / rta pa bdun chus khyer ba rgyal sras chos rdzongs pas sgro la ma la gsol 'debs mdzad pas bde bar bskyabs pa sogs sngon dang da ltar byung ba grangs med/ spyan snga ba'i slob ma dge bshes sgre pas sne'u zur ba la bdag gis mi g.yo ba'i yig bcu bzlas pas mi g.yo ba'i zhal mthong ste/ de'i tshe sngon la sgrol ma mthong ba zhig byung ba ci yin zhus pas/ yi dam gyi lha sang sga zhal mthong yang sngon la las kyi lha mo yin pas sgrol ma mthong ba chos nyid yin gsung / zhang ston dgra 'jigs kyis kyang sman bla dang 'phags pa bcu sa/cig zhal mazal tshe thog mar sgrol ma zhal 220

thugasachen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4lag sor ba zhes skye ba gsum dran zhing bsgoms stobs kyis rib pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa/ dge bshes ston pa/ rnal 'byor pa/dgon pa ba/ jo bo legs/ zhang btsun yer ba pa sobs jo bo'i dngos slob bdun dang / nying slob gnyis la thug pa de la gnang zhing lung bstan mdzad/ khong gis lag sor dkon du lo gsum bsgrubs pas 'phags pa dngos dang mjal nas khyod kyis tshe 'di nyid du grub pa thob ste/ slob ma yang sum cu tsam kyis nga mthong bar 'gyur zhes lung bstan/ lag sor bas ba yu ba shes rab tshul khrims la gdams/ des lo lnga bsgrubs pas zhal mthong ste sbyor lam chen po brnyes/ de la 'phags pa lce sgom dang / mnga' ris pa shes rab rgyal mtshan gnyis kyis zhus te/ 'di gnyis kyang tshogs lam chen po pa yin gsungs/ lce sgom gyis brag lha blo phag /da da tu bsgrubs pas lo ngo brgyad na zhal mabang mnga' ris pas ru mtshams kyi brag phug tu bsgrubs pas lo bzhi na zhal mthong /'di la rgyun du mi ma yin rnams kyis 'tsho ba drangs gsung / de gnyis ka la grub thob chen po skyer sgang bas zhus te/ lo phyed dang bzhir sgrub pa mdzad pas zhal bstan nas/ snyigs ma'i dus su zhal mthonge ba yoba' zhig gi brgyud pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te/ slob ma yang lnga bcu tsam kyis zhal mthong / sgrub 223

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ ྾pa lo gsum byed pa sogs kyi sgo nas chos 'di la 'brel ba bzhag pa'i slob ma ni mtha' yas/ des sangs rgyas gnyan ston la gnang /khong gis lo gsum bsgrubs pas yi ge drug pa dang / kha sarla ṇi dang / bcu gcig zhal phyag stong spyan stong rnams zhal gzigs shing / slob ma'ang bcu gcig gis zhal mthong bar 'gyur ba'i lung bstan mdzad/ phyis de kho na bzhin byung gsung ngo / /bla ma des sangs rgyas ston pa la gnang nas dag pa'i zhing du 'gro nges kyi slob ma brgya rtsa brgyad 'byung bar lung bstan pa bzhin 'gro ba mang po'i don mdzad/ de la mkhas grub shangs ston chen pos zhus te/ thugs dam lha'i gtso bor mdzad/ sku la srin 'bu med cing /dri ma rang sangs te shel ltar dwangs par gyur pas gtsang ma shangs ston du grags/ ljags chab dang dri chu 'thung byug bgyis pa tsam gyis nad gdon las grol ba dang / mthong ba dang thos pa tsam gyis dge sems khyad par can skye ba sogs rnam thar ngo mtshar ba mnga'/ yang sangs rgyas ston pa la bla ma a seng dang mkhas btsun gzhon nu grub kyis zhus nas nyams bzhes mdzad/ de dag nas brag po che ba rdo rje dpal/ chos sgo ba chos dpal shes rab/rgod phrug ras par grags pa chos rje grags pa 'byung gnas sogs la brgyud de so sos thugs nyams su bzhes shing 'gro don mdzad/224

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4don bdun ma'i bla brgyud nang gi mkhan chen bde ba dpal dang /dka' bzhi pa grags gzhon/ mkhan chen bsod nams grags pa sogs kyis kyang chos 'di'i phrin las bskyangs te/ mtshon byed tsam bkod pa'o/ /phyis su grub chen thang stong rgyal pos skyer sgang ba'i gdams pa thams cad tshang bar gsan nas mi lo bcu bzhi'i bar mi dang mi phrad pa'i smra bcad kho nas ma ṇi dung phyur gnyis bzlas/ kha cher dge slong pad+ma ka ra sogs sku tshe'i phreng ba mang por thags rje chen po'i sgrub pa por gyar ba dran/ mgon po phyag dang da drug sogs chos skyong chen po rnams kyi spyi bor dam tshig gi rdo rje bzhag cing / lha 'dre dregs pa can mang po dam la bzhag /rgyal bstan la gnod pa'i bon gyi 'bum pa sogs nus med du mdzad/bden tshig brjod pa tsam gyis stag byams pa la gnas pa dang /dred dmag sis khal bskyal ba sogs nus pa dpag tu med/'phags pa'i lung bzhin lcags zam byang chub rgyun lam bgrang dka' ba btsugs/ klo yul dkar por bsgyur/ dbus gtsang gi sa mdud skrub khang gis mnan cing / sa gnad me btsa' mang po btab nas mtha' dmag 'byung ba'i go skabs bcom/ nad nug 'khrugs rtsod kyi sdug bsngal rgyun bcad/ lha sa'i jo shaka la brtan bzhugs mdzad cing rten bzhengs grangs med pas 'jig rten du 225

pa bab / ba nga da ba ba ji ba ba ba ba bste na nying ba da nga ba da ba /dge legs spel/ yi ge drug pa'i phrin las kyis bod khams bkang /dad pas gsol ba btab pa rnams mi dang mi min 'byung ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyab tshul sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi lo rgyus la 'gran pa yod/ sazhan yang don zhags pa sangs rgyas rin chen gyi zhal nas/ nga'i bla ma 'phags pa don zhags pa chen po shes rab brtson 'grus kyi bka' las/ jo bo yi ge drug pa 'di snying po'i don yin pas 'di la dril cig gsungs pas 'u cag gis kyang bsnyen pa'i mthil 'di la byas gsungs/nga / /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃḥ mkha' ltar rgya che'i sku dang mchog lho gsungs/ /zab barming ye shes phung po ro mnyam pa/ /dran dang brjod pas bsod nams len pa'i sngags/ /oṃ gyi de nyid brnyes la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ ni a u ma gsum 'dus pa yin la 'du rgyu'i yi ge gsum po des shin tu rnam par dag pa'i sku bsung thugs rdo rje rnams mtshon la/ de dag 'dus pa'i oṃ yig gis ni rdo rje gsum dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug gi go 'phangs ston te/sngags don de ltar shes nas oṃ zhes brjod pas bsod nams rlabs po che 'byung bar byed pas na nor bu 'dzin pa'i sngags zhes rdo rje rtse mo las bshad do/ /srid zhi'i phan tshogs yongs kyi za ma ༄tog /rab 'byams rgyal kun oṃ gyi rig sngags kyis/ /thar 'dod 226

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4blo gros rtag tu dge byed cing / /'gro kun oṃ gyi gnas su 'khod par shog /mtha' bral de nyid gzigs pa'i ye shes kyis/ /'gro sems tha mal rtog pa'i 'jigs pa las/ /skyob pa'i bya ba rtag tu 'jug mtshon phyir/ /zla shel ma ṇi 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma ṇi ni nor bu'i skad dod de/ 'dir bgrang ba'i nor bu zhes grags pa bgrang phreng la byed do/ /bgrang phreng gi de nyid ni sngags yin la/sngags kyi skad dod/ man+t+ra zhes pa yid skyob pa la 'jug pas yid sdug bsngal dang / de'i rgyu las nyon dang / kun gyi rtsa ba bdaka tu rtog pa bag chags dang bcas pa las skyob par byed pa'i shes rab/bden pa gnyis kyi band la mkhas pas rtag pa dang chad pa'i mtha' gnyis las brgal ba ste/ grub chen mi tri'i gsung la brten pa'o/ /shes rab kyi phar phyin de nyid gdul bya gzhan gyi rgyud 'khor ba las skyob pa'i bya ba la ltos nas yang dang yang du 'dren pas bgrang phreng gi mtshon don du 'jog par rgyal dbang pad+mas bshad snang ngo / /'gro 'di rgyal rnams sher phyin ma ṇi yis/ /mi shes dug rdon 'phrogs pa'i snod gyur te/ /dri bcas blo gros tha mal rdo yi khams/ /kun mkhyen ye shes ma ṇir 'gyur bar shog /srid pa'i chu las bltams kyang de yi skyon/ /mi chags srid sasum spyi bor legs gyes pa'i/ /thugs rjes 'jig rten kun dgar 227

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ mdzad pa'i dper/ /yid 'dzin pad+me bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad+me zhes pa pad+ma 'dzin par mdzad pa ste/ ji ltar me tog pad+ma ni chu las skyes/ 'on kyang chu'i skyon gyis ma gos/ ma gos par ma zad mdzes sbug dang dri bsung gis chu'i rgyan byed pa ltar/ rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje chen po yang sems can srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba la dmigs nas skyes pas/ srid pa yongs su mi gtong ba'i rnam pa can yin kyang / thabs la mkhas pa'i shes rab kyis bzung ba yin pas 'jig rten gyi nyes pas mi bos shing /slar la zang zing dang mi 'jigs pa dang chos kyi 'byor ba la sogs sogs sgras/ tshul bzod brtson bsam sdud/ pas 'khor ba'i rgyan byed cing mkhas pa rnams kyi yid 'phrogs pa ste/ dpal mos mdzad pa'i bstod pa dang / grub chen mi tri'i gzhung la brten nas bshad do/ /rgyal dang byang sems rnams kyi rjes brtse yi/ /pad+me'i bcud la 'gro 'di rtag 'thung zhing / /skye dgu'i blo gros dpung ba'i lta zur ngos/ /brtse chen pad+me'i 'khri shing gis mdzes shog /phul byung shes rab snying rje'i snying po can/ /hūṃ zhes gdul bya'i snying la skad cig gis/ /gsal mdzad 'jig rten dbang phyug la 'dud kyi/ /bdag gi blo gros rnam kun dge bar mdzod/ /hūṃ zhes pa ni gsal bar byed pa ste/ sngar bshad pa'i srid mtha' 228

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4'gog byed ma ṇi'i don dang / zhi mtha' 'gog byed pad+me'i don te/lam de gnyis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la gsal bar byed par bskul ba'o//jig pa chen po'i lam gyi cha thams cad thabs dang shes rab kyi phyogs gnyis su 'du la/ de gnyis kyi sgo thams cad ma ṇi'i sngags don du dril ba 'di la zhib tu bsam nas yib drug chos kyi yang snying du gsungs pa la nges pa brtan par bya'o/ /'gro kun 'jig rten dbang phyug nyin re bzhin/ /hūṃ zhes bskul bas sgrub la 'jug byed cing / /de mthus yid can kun gyi blo gros la/ /mchog byed hūṃ gi sngags don myur 'grub shog /'gro drus/ rgya mtshor bying bas nyam thag rnams/ /rlabs chen pha rol phyin druka spyod pa'i grus/ /sgrol mdzad snying rje'i lha khyod byang chub bar/ /bdag gi blo gros brgyan par mdzad sgad bzhugs/ /oṃ/ ma/ ṇi/pad/ me/ hūṃ/ zhes re re nas phral ba'i drug po des dmyal ba la sogs pa'i 'gro ba drus sbyong bar byed cing / phyin drug gi yon tan rgyas par byed par mi tra dzo ki dang / dpal di paṃ kā ra sogs kyis bshad de/ bshes spring las/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang spyod pa yis/ /'gro ba nyam thag mang po rjes bzung ste/ /zhes pa ltar/ phyin drug gi sgo nas 'gro ba drug gi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa zhi bar byed pa'i don to/ /'dir don 229

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/ba gnyis dang / gzhan don rnam pa thams cad pa skrub pa sogs la ltos pa'i phyin drug gi grangs nges rnams kyang dran par bya ste/ yi ge so so'i don 'chad tshul gzhan yang yod do/ /de'ang sngabs kyi mtshon don de dang de mdzub mos zla ba bzhin mtshon pa kho na yin nam zhe na ma yin gyi/ sngags kyi cha de dang de mtshon don ye shes kyi cha de dang de las sprul pa dang / de'i dbang gis sgrub pa po'i rgyud la yon tan de dang de sad par byed pa la so so so sor bsngags pa'i sgo nas lha sngags ngo bo dbyer med kyi nges shes drang dgos so/ /smin dang ma smin blo gros sgo nga'i bya/ /sangs rgyas byin rlabs drod kyis bskyed bsring bas/ /bsod nams lus zungs smin pa'i ye shes rtsal/ /rnam grol nam mkha'i rgyan du spyod par shog /yig drug lan re bton pas kyang tshe rabs du ma nas bsags pa'i las sgrib mang po byang zhing / baṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sgrub pa po'i lus la zhugs nas byin gyis rlob pa dang / de'i lus la gnas pa'i srin bu tshun chad bla med byang chub kyi skal ba can du byed pa la sogs pa'i phan yon mtha' yas pa rgyal po bka' 'dum du gsung rab mang po drang ba las shes shing / khyad par du rang re gangs can pa rnams la lha dang sngags 'di nyid grub pa lhag par myur ba'i rtags su/ tha na 230

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4byis pa lo sasum lon pa dang / mu to dbyug thosas yan chad kyi mgrin par rig sngags 'di nyid li shi la dri zhim ltar ngang gis thob cing / lha sngags gzhan ni sgom bzlas la brtson mkhan nyung zhing / cung zad yod pa rnams su'ang tshe 'di'i lag cha 'ba' zhig tu 'khyer mkhan kho na mang la/ 'di ni khyim pa pho mo yan chad kyi khrod na bye ba dang dung phyur sogs su zlo ba sa'i rtsi shing ltar mang zhing de yang 'jig rten phyi ma phan chad kyi ched du byed pa kho na mang ba dang / de lta na'ang tshe 'dir tshe ring ba dang / nad nyung ba sogs kyi phun tshogs 'thob pa la yang ma ṇi zlo mkhan rnams 'ba' zhig khyad par du 'phags pa sokas mngon sum du mthong bas/ bdag legs su 'dod na 'di la 'bad par bya zhing sngags don shes pa dang mi shes pa'i bzlas brjod la stobs che chung ches mi 'dra ba yod pas mdor bsdus shig bkod do/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ snying la mdza' ba mi phyed drang po'i blo/ /'dir bde phyi mar legs pa'i 'dun gros can/ /khyod dang tshe rabs phreng bar theg mchog gi/ /chos kyi 'dun sar lhan cig longs spyod shog /dge rgan sbu drin can gyi bzhed pa dang mthun par bstan pa'i nyi mas bris pa'i re 'dod la 'jig rten dbang po'i spyan ras kyis 'tsho bar gyur cig /231

pa / ba nga ba ba 'a ji gas ba ma bad na 'a ba ba ba nga 'a ba ba / nga / /thugs rje chen po'i brda don ni/ bshad 'grel chen mor/ zhal gcig ni sems can la thugs rje mi 'gyur ba1 zhes snying rje ngo gnyis pa dang / ngo bo rtag pa spangs pa/ sgrub thabs gcig skor du ni/ zhal gcig ni lhan skyes ye shes rang dang banyis su med pa'i brda/ zhes so/ /'dzum mdangs ldan pa ni sems can la byams par mdzad pa/ spyan mi zum pa ni sems can la thugs rjes gzigs pa/ phyag bzhi ni/ tshad med rnam pa bzhi ldan pas/ /'gro don phyogs med mdzad pa'i rtags/ /zhes so/ /yang /gnyis med chos sku'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /longs skru shes rab pad+ma g.yon na 'dzin/ /sprul skru thabs kyi bgrang phreng g.yas na 'dzin/ /zhes dang / zhal bcu gcig pa'i thad du/ rtsa ba chos sku'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar/ /yan lag longs sku'i phyag gi dang po na/ /skyon gyis ma gos pad+ma dkar po 'dzin/ /nying lag sprul sku'i phyag gi dang po na/ /'khor ba'i sems can 'dren pa'i bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /zhes te/ phyi ma gnyis ni/ nu tig gi phreng ba snying rje rgyun chad med pas sems can 'khor ba nas byang chub tu 'dren pa'o/ /pad+ma ni/ 'khor bar sems can gyi don mdzad kyang 'khor ba'i nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi skyon gyis ma gos pa'o/ /zhes so/ /phyag bzhi sku gsum dang sbyar bar ma zad/ phyag mtshan 232

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4de ltar sbyar ba'ang snang ste/ thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel las/dang po'i phyag gnyis stong nyid phyag rgya mdzadaḥ g.yas 'og shel phreng grags stong sngags sgra sgrogasaḥ g.yon 'og pad dkar sgyu 'phrul sprul pa 'gyedaḥ ces rdo rje gsum gyi bshad pa mdzad de/snga ma dang bsre rgyu min pa 'dra/ tshul khrims bzang po'i lugs las/zhal chos sku thig le gcig tu 'khyil/ /spyan thabs shes snying rjes zim bur gzigs/ /phyag tshad med bzhi ldan 'jam zhing mnyen/ / zhes so/ /sku mdog dkar po ni/ chos sku dri ma med pa'i brda/ /zhes dang / dkar 'tsher zhes pa/ chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par das/ pa la 'khor ba'i rtog 'dzin gyis ma gos pa/zhes so/ /zhabs mnyam skyil ni/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i don la thugs mnyam pa nyid las mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa/ zhes dang / zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /mnyam bzhag don la ma g.yos rtags/ /zhes te/ zhabs gnyis chos dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i brda/ zhes dang / 'gro ba'i don la thabs shes zung 'jug gis mnyam par bzhugs pa/zhes kyang ngo / /rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa ni/'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad la spyod kyang zhen med du sems can gyi don dang tshul bstun pa'i brda/ zhes dang / 'dod yon 23 3

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—྾ ྾ma spangs par chos nyid rol pa'i rgyan du shar ba/ zhes te/dgos 'dod phun tshogs 'byung ba'i rtags su'ang bshad do/ /nam mkha'i rgyal po'i sgrub thabs su/ ri dwags kyi pags pa ni snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba/ dar gyi sham thabs ni chos kyi ngo tsha dang ldan pa/ zhes so/ /bar chad kun sel du/ sdug bsngal gdung sel dar gyi stod g.yogs dang ཿ nyon mongs dri mas ma gos sham thabs gsolaḥ dgos 'dod re skong rin chen rgyan gyis sprasaḥ snying rje'i ri dwags pags pa phrag na 'changaḥ zhes so/ /nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ thugs rje sems can la nyi zla ltar snyoms pa dang / 'khor ba'i skyon gyis mi gos pa'i brda'o/ /yum gsang ye ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma bral bas dkar sasal/ 'gro ba la rjes su chags pas dmar mdangs 'tsher ba/ phyag mtshan la/ thugs rgyud bde stong gi ros myos shing sang bas thod chang / ye shes des srid zhi bde stong sher phyin gyi rang sgras sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad g.yo/ sangs rgyas thams cad skul/ 'gro ba'i gnas thams cad skyod/sems can rnams gti mug gi gnyid las slong / thams cad skul zhing dbang du sdud pas ḍā ru ste/ ye shes dang / phrin las kyi khyad dam/ yang na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas bde chen gyi ye shes 'bebs pas ḍā ru/ ye shes kyi btung ba'i rgyun de zad mi 234

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4shes par 'chang bas na thod chang ste/ ban snod na gnas pa dang /myos par byed pa gnyis char bde ba chen po dang mthun no/ /dzab dbyangs nyer gcig ni mkha' 'gro sasang skor du bstan par zad kyi/ 'gro 'dul yid bzhin nor bu'i gzhung dkyus su bstan pa ni/bzla tshul drug ste/ phyi mdo sde ltar bzhan don du bzlas pa/ nang gsang sngags ltar bsnyen sgrub tu bzlas pa/ gsang ba mkha' 'gro mas byin rlabs brda'i tshul du bzlas pa/ bla ma dang lha la gsol ba gdab pa ma la bus 'bod kyi tshul du bzlas pa/ sgrib sbyong chos spyod kyi tshul du bzlas pa/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa mnyam bzhag bsam gtan gyi tshul du bzlas pa'o/ /de rnams la dzab dgongs drug /sngags don 'chad tshul drug /dbyangs kyi 'dren stangs drug sogs yod de bshad 'grel chen mo las shes par bya'o/ / 236

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/༄/ /yi dam zhi ba'i zin bris kun tu bzang po'i gzhal med khang la 'jug pa'i sgo/yi dam zhi ba'i zin bris kun tu bzang po'i gzhal med khang la 'jub/ pa'i sgo zhes bya ba/ rje bla ma grub thob chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyir brgyud pa gsum gyis 'phags shing / gu rus snyibs dus kyi mthar byin rlabs kyi rdo so 'byung bar dgongs pa'i dbang gis chos la gter chos rno/ de las kyang deng sang rang 'di'i dus babs kyi zab chos mchog ni rje'i zab gter rnams te/ba/ter bka' de nyid la ltos pa'i 'bras bu'i dus ma yol ba'i bzang sgang yin/ ngas a pha/ a phas sangs rgyas dngos la thob ces smra chog pas brgyud pa nye/ rang nyid la thugs rje gzhan phan kun khyab phrin la saXrab brtan rnam par rgyal ba'i sde/ mchog brnyes pa'i grub chen rnams kyis skal ldan rtsa ba'i chos bdag tu dgongs pa btad yod pas chos tshan 'di lhag par byin rlabs che/ lar sangs rgyas kyi gdul bya rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni brtse ba thugs rje chen po yin la/ de rgyu dang dmigs rnam dang rgyud kyi phye bas mtha' yas pa thams cad gcig tu bsdus nas bzhin lag gi rnam par 236

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4yabashar ba ni 'phags pa 'di yin pas sgrub thag nye/ 'dzam gling 'di nyid kyi ri'i rgyal po gru 'dzin na da dung yang bzhugs shing /zur tho lhar bod kyi khyad par gyi lha skal yin pas kyang byin rlabs che/ de'ang rigs re re'ang rigs thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcika kyang ye shes lnga ka'i ngo bor bshad pa ltar skabs 'dir 'phags pa rigs drug tu phye ste/ rigs lnga'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thugs rje chen po nyid kyi rnam par rigs bsdus nas sgrub pa dang / de bzhin gshegs ma rnams dang /sems dpa'/ sems ma/ khro bo khro mo/ gzhan yang mgron thabs kyi lha'i rnam 'gyur dpag tu med pa rnams kyang thugs rje chen po'i rigs dang rnam 'phrul nyag gcig tu byas pa'i sgrub lugs 'di ni/lha'i rigs thams cad dang / rigs kyi lha thams cad 'grub thag shin tu nye bas 'grub pa'i thabs mkhas chen po ste/ des na rigs nyi tshe ba'i 'gro 'dul gyi skrub tshul rnams las kyang khyad par du 'phags so/ /de la skye 'chi bar do sku gsum du sbyong tshul sogs ni sgyu 'phrul ltar bya la/ phyag 'tshal skabs/ rtsa phyag thal mo sbyar ba ni rgyal po'i dbang po thams cad ces bya ba'i phyag rgya yin par za ma tog las gsungs/ bka' 'dum las/ phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar/ /stong dang snying rje dbyer med pas/ /sems 237

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/ ྾can don la banas pa'i rtags/ /rje mnyam nyid ngang la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces gsungs/ 'di la srong btsan gyis nam mkha'i rgyal po'i bstod par/ pad+ma'i 'dab 'dra dang po yi/ /phyag gnyis thugs kar thal sbyar nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje rnams/ /bskul bar mdzad pa phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa sngabs bla med skabs/ dgongs pa lung ston las/ phan tshun sbyor ba rdo rje sems/ /shes rab thabs kyi go 'phang mchog /thal mo sbyar ba tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad nges par 'gugs/ /ces sogs ltar bya rung ngam snyam/ dpal mos mdzad pa'i bstod par/ thusas rje dang ni shes rab gnyis/ /mnyam par sbyor ba'i thags mnga' zhing / phyag gnyis thugs kar mnyam sbyor ba/ /༄ nidapal ldan mnyam sbyor la phyag 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /bgrang phreng sngags kyi nor bu ste/ man+t+ra'i sgra las yid sdug bsngal rgyu bcas las skyob pa'i sher phyin te/ dpal mos/ sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po gtso/ /gsang sngags rgyal po'i bgrang phreng mchos /mu tig ltar dkar g.yas na 'dzin/ /rib/ lngags 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo /zhes pa las mi gsal yang mi tras ma ṇi la bshad pa'i rigs pa sbyar ba'o/ /gter phyogs las/ lus can 'khor ba dang ngan song las rgyun mi 'chad du 'dren pa'i brdar shel phreng 'dren par 238

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4ma bshad pa'ang / sher phyin chos rgyal bka' 'bum las/ phyag g.yas mu tis phreng ba bsnam/ /thugs rje rgyun chad med pa yis/ /'khor ba'i gnasanas 'dren pa'irtags/ /rje thugs rje can la phyag 'tshalabastod/ /ces pa dang mi 'grigs pas rtsings sam snyam ste dpyad/ gyi rnal 'byor de nyid gdul bya 'dren pa'i phrin las la rgyun mi 'chad du 'jug pa la bya dgos sam brtag /pad+ma dkar po'i rnam bshad zur du yod/ pad+ma dmar po'i de nyid rnal 'byor rgyud na shin tu rgyas par bzhugs kyang 'dir skabs su ma babs/ pad dkar byi de nyid bsdus pa ni/ dpal mos/ 'khor ba'i 'dam gyis ma gos pas/ /dag pa'i shel ltar 'od gsal ba/ / pad+ma dkar po bayon na 'dzin/ /phyag na pad+ma phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes te/ grub chen mi tra ltar na snying rje chen po dang sbyor ba 'dra/de ltar na bgrang phrengaXchos sku sgrub byed kyi gtso bo ye shes kyi tshogs dang / pad dkar gzugs sku'i rgyu'i sadzu bo bsod nams kyi tshogs dang sbyor bar 'thad de/ shes rab dang thabs kyi phyogs so sor 'gyur ro/ /phyag stong spyan stong gi mdor/ sems can thams cad kyis gces shing yid du 'ong bar 'dod na thal mo sbyar ba'i phyag dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mgo la phyag gis nyug cing lung ston par 'dod na sngags kyi nor bu thogs pa'i phyag dang /yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phyir ni pad dkar thogs pa'i phyag 239

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa la mchod cing blta zhes byed las kyi khyad par yang bstan no/ /'di'i yum gsang ye ni/ thugs chen pad rgyal du/ yi se drug ma kasang ba ye shes/ bka' 'bum bshad 'grel chen mor/ phyi ltar na yum yi ge drug ma/ nang lhar na gsang ba ye shes/ zhes so/ /zhes pa ltar lha mo yi ge drug mar shes dgos so/ /bzlas pa'i thad/ khyad par 'gro 'dul thugs rje che'iḥ byin rlabs dngos grub/ ces pa ni/ 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi byin rlabs/ces dang / 'gro 'dul thugs rje'i dngos grub/ ces dngos grub ngos bzung ba gnyis ka la sbyar btub/ gzhung 'di'i gong 'og kun tu spyan ras gzigs brtse ba'i lhar bzung ste sgrub par gsungs pa 'di bzhin/ mdo rgyud mang po las mthong ste/ za ma tog las 'phags pa 'di'i rnam thar thams cad sems can sdub bsngal ba rnams la rjes brtser mdzad tshul kho na'i sgo nas bstan pa dang / sdong po bkod par/ bde gshegs sras po ngas ni rnam thar gcig bsgom ste/ /ye shes snying po rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje sdug /'gro ba thams cad bskyab cing yongs su bsdu phyir byung / /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa dang / chos yang dag par sdud pa'i gong 'og gnyis su rje btsun 'dis ston pa'i spyan sngar rang gi rtogs pa brjod pa na snying rje chen po nyid kyi steng nas brjod pa 240

thugs chen yig drug sga skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4dang / spyod 'jug tu/ bdag gces 'dzin goms pa'i dbang gis rang la mi snyan pa chung ngu yang mi bzod pa ltar/ brtse ba goms pa'i shugs rgyas pa na ga'an gyi mi bde ba phra mo'ang mi bzod pa'i dper/ rje btsun 'di'i rnam thar drangs te/ de bas ji ltar sogs nas/ mtshan yang byin gyi rlabs/ ces pa'i bar ro/ /snying rje pad dkar las spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i mtshan 'di yang snying rje chen po'i yon tan gyi sgo nas sngon gyi sangs rgyas kyis btags par gsungs pa dang / lag na rdo rje dbang bskur gyi gleng gzhir sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyis rje btsun la de bzhin bshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje chen po'i stobs kyi rdo rje pad+ma'i mchog gi snying po byin nas gzhi dang snying po me tog gi rgyan bkod pa'i zhing 'di lus kyi sprin rnams kyis bkang nas snang bar byed du btang bar gsungs pa dang / de nyid bsdus par bdag cag gi ston pa rnam snang nyid snying rje'i nyams kyis 'dul ba'i sems can gdul phyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku bstan par 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi thad du gsungs pa dang / spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i sgra bshad kyang sor rtob ye shes kyi spyan gyis rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la rtag tu gzigs pa dang / thugs rje chen po'i spyan gyis 'jig rten thams cad la gzigs pa lhur len pa'i phyogs nas bshad tshul gnyis de nyid snang chen dang / ko sa la'i 241

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa rgyan/ dpal mchog 'grel chen/ rnam snang mngon byang gi 'grel pa rnams su gsungs pa'i phyi ma dang / legs grub tu yang /sangs rgyas kun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun bsasas pa/ /spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba/ /rtag par brtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs mtha' yas so/ /ri dwags krishā'i pags pas nu g.yon bkab par bshad pa'ang de ltar yin te/ dbu ma snying por/ snying rje'i pags pa gnag 'chang zhing / /zhes par 'dra'o/ /'dir lam kyi gtso bo snying rje chen por byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang / mdo sngags khyad 'byed skabs/ gzhan don bzo khog dang /rdzogs byang sgrub pa'i lam thams cad de'i cha lag tu byed pa la theg chen sanyis 'dra bar bshad pa bzhin/ tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab gzungs spobs mngon shes sogs yon tan thams cad snying rje chen po'i bzhed don sgrub byed kyi 'khor kho nar zad pas/ rin chen bdun gyi bdag po 'khor sgyur yin pa ltar/ yon tan de thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i bdag po snying rje chen po yin no/ /de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi sa'i yon tan thams cad kyi gtso bo'am bdag po'ang skye la thugs rje chen po yin te/ 'bras dus kyi rnam bzhag mang po sngon gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgo nas byed par bsungs 242

thugs chen yig drug gi skoratsho sogs/ pod/ 4ra pa bzhin no/ /de'ang slob lam du snying rje chen po de theg gsum gyi rtogs rigs mtha' dag dang 'brel bar sbyang bas mthar son pa na/ brtse chen gyi blo mngon gyur pa de nyid las gyi rnam pa ma lus pa'i ngo bor skye ba la begs su gyur pa'i gnas ngan len gyi cha thams cad rgyun mtha'i rdor ting gis bcom nas/ de'i rnam grol lam la slar yang snying rje chen po mngon gyur du 'byung ste/ de ni stong nyid la mnyam par bzhag pa sogs lung rtogs kyi yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa'i mtshan nyid can du skye'o/ /dngos grub kyi snying po de ltar ngos zin pa de nyid rgya gang che nas sgrub dgos kyi/gzhan du dper na bla ma mkhas grub chen po dang mjal yang skar ma'i dpyad lta bu'i don dman pa zhig las ci yang ma dris na gdams pa'i mchog rnams zur tsam yang mi thob pa dang 'dra'o/ /spyir yang sgo thams cad nas snying rje la mang du gnas par bya ba ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags pa'i khyad par gyi dam tshig yin par phyag stong spyan stong gi mdo dang / rgyal po bka' 'bum/ kun bzang thugs gter sogs las nan tan du gsungs te/ de la brtson na 'phags pa dang brtul zhugs gcig la gnas par 'gyur bas 'phags pa dgyes pa'i de'ang spyir snying rje sgom pa tsam gyis mi chog gi/ de 'phags pa dgyes pa'i ched du dmigs nas sgom pa zhib dgos te/ 'di'i 2/3

thugs ched yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4thugs ka'i sems dpa'i rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid yin pa'o/ /de phyung ma thag tu sogs kyis ni trīḥ zhes bya ba'i snying po 'dis pad+ma'i rigs thams cad sprul tshul dang / sprul nas rang sga rigs dang mthun pa'i mdzad pa mdzad tshul rnams ston te/ kun snying ltar byas so/ /dpal mchog las kyang / de nas de bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa ngo bo nyid dag pa'i chos nyid thob pas yang chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi ye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul 'di gsungasaXte/ 'dod chags thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid kyis 'jig rten na zhe sdang thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro//dri ma thams cad rnam par dag pa nyid kyis 'jib rten na sdig pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad rnam par dag pas 'jig rten na sems can thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /shes pa thams cad rnam par dag pas 'jig rten na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa nas/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug don gyi gnas 'di nyid yang rgya cher ston cing bzhin rab tu 'dzum danul te/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha 'byed pas 'dod chags la sogs pa'i dri mas mi gos pa la blta 246

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— tsu bzhing / 'gro ba thams cad kyi phyir pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i snying po 'di gsungs so/ /trīḥ de nas 'di sa/sungs pa tsam gyis pad+ma chen po de las de bzhin gshegs pa la sobs pa'i gzusas thams cad bcom ldan 'das sprun ras gzigs/ dang 'dra ba'i pad+mas mtshan pa'i gzugs can nges par byung nas bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi rim pa dang po'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs par gyur to/ /zhes gsungs te/don gyi gnas 'di nyid ces pa ni/ 'dod chags rnam par dag pa sogs gong gi gzhung tshan bzhis bstan pa rnams te/ yang rgya cher ston cing zhes pa ni dīḥzhes bya ba'i yi ge sprul pa'i sgo nas slar yang ston par mdzad pa'o/ /'gro ba thams cad ni pad+ma'i rigs rnams te/ de yongs su rdzogs par skyed pa'i phyir snying po 'bru gcig 'di gsungs pa'o/ /pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs pa zhes pa ni snying po'i yi ge bhāḥzhes pa 'di'i ming ngo zhes dpal mchog 'grel chen las so/ /pad+ma'i gzugs sna tshogs ces bya ba'i snying po zhes pa 'di la sher dum gyi 'grel par/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi sazugs su snang bas na gzugs sna tshosas dang / de ltar snang yang 'khor ba'i nyes pa rnams kyis mi gos pas na pad+ma/ de 'dra'i snying po dngos ni gzugs kun snying gi/ thams cad nges par 216

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4the tshom thams cad gcod byed pa'i/ /chos chen char ni rab tu 'bebs/ /zhes 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi sa la brten nas bshad do/ /ye shes de so sor rtog pa yin na rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes su mi 'thad do zhe na/ rtog pa ni mi gsal ba ste/ 'dam gyis sbags pas nag nog tu 'gyur ba dang 'dra'o/ /ye shes 'di ni sor rtog yin yang shes bya thams cad mngon sum du blta ba la bkra zhing shin tu gsal ba'i yon tan gyis mdzes pas sam/'khrul pa'i bag chags kyi gnyid ma lus pa sad pas shin tu rgyas shing kha phye bas na pad+ma lta bur bshad ces 'chad dam/ pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang chu zhag dang nya lcibs sogs 'dam gyi nyes pa rnams kyis ma sbags pa ltar/ ye shes de ming tshig yi ge'i rnam pa can gyi rtog pa yongs su gyar pa las skyes kyang / phyin ci log gi /ri byed /richa thams cad log pa —ra gnyis snang 'khrul pa rtog pa gtan min zhes pa ste/ sangs rgyas la zhen rig gi rtog pa med kyang tha snyad byed pa'i blo rigs yod dgos te/ so rig bzhis shes pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gnyis snang gi 'khrul pa'i rab rib mtha' dag dang bral ba'i so sor rtog pa'i spyan shin tu gsal ba yin zhes hūṃ gis bstan to/ /'di ltar na sor rtog ye shes gcig po de gdul bya'i bsam pa rdzogs par mdzad pa'i cha nas nor bu dang / de 249

ngo da/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsunga'abum/nyid bdul bya'i bsam pa tha dad pa dang / de la ji ltar 'tshams pa'i chos kyi longs spyod sna tshogs pa thams cad ma 'dzings bar 'byed pa'i sor rtog yin yang / rtog pa'i skyon gyis ma kos par mi 'gal ba'i cha nas pad+ma ste gnyis kar 'jog par gsal lo/ /da dung go bder bshad na/ sor rtog ye shes ni rnam par rtog pa med pa'i phyir dang / 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i mthu phul du byung ba'i phyir ma ṇi ste nor bu'i rgyal po'o/ /de rnam rtog med par mi 'thad de/ sor rtog yin pa'i phyir ro zhe na/ de rtog pa las skyes kyang / rtog pa'i dri mas ma bslad par skyes te/ pad+ma 'dam las skyes kyang 'dam gyi nyes pas ma gos par skye ba bzhin no/ /der ma zad sor rtog de nyid kyi mthus gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i g.yeng ba'i gnas ngan len gyi cha ma lus pa 'joms shing 'gog pas na hūṃ zhes so/ /bde chen shes rab snying rje mchob /ces pa'i sgrub thabs su dpal mi tra dzo kis ni/ oṃ ma ṇi hūṃ/ shes rab chen po dri ma med/ /rnam par shes kun mtshan nyid de/ /ma skyes mi banas 'gag pa med/ /gdod nas rnam grol mngon sum pa/ /oṃ āḥjiḥpad+me hūṃ/ snying rje chen po lhun kyis grub/ /dmigs pa kun gyi mtshan nyid de/ /mi phyed mi 'gyur 'bral ba med/ /skyo med re ba rnam spangs pa'o/ /zhes bshad de/ ma ṇi ni shes rab kyi phar phyin 260

thugs chen yigadrug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4ma te rnam rtog med cing / mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /pad+ma ni snying rje chen po ste/ 'dam rdzab lta bu'i 'khor ba la brten nas sam dmigs nas skye ba dang / sems can thams cad dga' bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de'ang byang sems kyi mnyam bzhag tu ni snying rjes zin pa'i shes rab mngon gyur du 'jug ste/ spang bya dngos su sbong ba sogs la 'di kho na dgos shing / snying rje'i mthu dang byed las gzhan yang de la yod do/ /rjes thob tu ni shes rab kyis zin pa'i snying rje ste dmigs med kyi snying rje chen po mngon du 'gyur te/ gzhan don gyi bya ba dngos su skrub pa sogs la 'di kho na dgos shing / shes rab kyi mthu dang byed las bzhan yang de la yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa na ni de gnyis ka blo gcig la mngon gyur du ldan pas srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis la mi gnas pa'i byang chub ces brjod pa yin te/ 'di dag ni lam dang 'bras bu'i dus kun tu ma ṇi dang pad+me gnyis mi 'bral bar phan tshun grogs su 'jug pa'i tshul lo/ /theg chen gyi bsam sbyor gnyis las bsam pa snying rje chen po pad+me dang / sbyor ba'am spyod pa'i gtso bo dang rab mchog sher phyin ma ṇir bzhag pas/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba dang sa bcu par bshad pa'i smon lam 'bum phrag grangs med bcu sogs pad+mer sdud cing / sbyin sogs phar phyin snga ma lnga 251

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ ma ṇir bsdu ba 'dra/ phyi ma cung zad bshad na/ dper na ma rig pa ni ma 'dres pa'i ma rig pa tsam du ma zad kyi/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i sgo sna tshogs dang bsdongs nas phyi phyir stobs rgyas par 'gyur bas/ chags sogs de dag ni ma rig pa'i dpung grogs so/ /de bzhin du sher phyin yang rang rkyang tsam sgom pa min gyi/ sbyin sogs rgya che ba'i spyod phyogs thams cad des ma zin pa med par byas te sbyang bas/ sgo sna tshogs shig nas sher phyin stobs rgyas par 'gyur te/ des na rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ces ri mo mkhan du mas 'khor sgyur gyi gzugs gcig 'bri ba'i dpes mdo dang rgyud bla mar bshad pa'i rigs pas mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i sher phyin gyi rtogs pa rnyed pa ni tshogs mtha' yas pa la ltos pas/ tshogs de dag ni de'i don du gsungs so/ /rkang pa gnyis pa gnyis kyi don ni/ ma ṇir 'jog rgyu'i shes rab de shes pa rnam par dag pa rang don phun tshogs zab pa ye shes chos sku'i ngo bo nyid dang / pad+mer 'gro rgyu'i snying rje de dmigs pa'am shes bya rnam par dag pa gzhan don phun tshogs rgya che ba gzugs sku'i mtshan nyid dam 'jog byed yin pa ste/ de ltar na sngar phyag mtshan thad du brjod pa ltar byas kyang 'grigs pa yod/ pad+ma zhes sdi rgyu la/ pad+me zhes sbyar ba ni bod pa'i don te/ nor du pad+ma zhes 262

thugs chen yigadrug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4spyan ras gzigs la nye ba'i sgo nas bod pa'i don yin pas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud rang la nye lhang ba lha bur yod par bsgom la bzla zhesargyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mtshos bshad/ de'ang theg chen gnyis kyi thun mong ltar yin la/ da dung bya rgyud pa'i zab rgya che'i lam gnyis sgrub tshul nas/ lngasas bla na med pa'i shes pa 'od gsal dang / shes bya ye shes kyi sku sgrub lugs kyi bar so sor sbyar nas bshad na rlabs che'o/ /yang sgrub thabs de nyid las/ rnal 'byor rgyal po shes rab thabs/ /rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor bla na med/ /dpal ldan pha rol phyin drug dngos/ /cho ga'i dam pa 'di gsungs so/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge drug /lugs 'byung ba dang lugs bzlog las/ /rgyud drug 'gog dang lam drug sbyong / /'bras bu drug la rab sbyor nyid/ /de bzhin rgyud drug bskyed pa dang / /lam drug la ni sbyor ba dang / /'bras bu drug ni mngon du bya/ /gzi brjid drug pa zhes bshad do/ /zhes yi ge drug po pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi ngo bo nyid dang / 'gro ba drug sbyong byed sogs su gsungs te/ 'di ni srong btsan bka' 'bum dang /bka' gdams glegs bam sogs su'ang bshad do/ /srong btsan bka' 'dum na gzhan yang / rdo rje dang rin po che la sogs pa rigs lnga rigs thams cad bsdus pa dang bcas pa'i drug gi ngo 253

thubs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4ba ma ba 'on kyang skul byed yig drug dang / bskul bya srob yig gnyis ka dngos su sbrel nas bzlas na thugs rje gnad nas skul ba la lhag par rno bas/ sngags 'grub par dka' ba'i dus su 'di gtso bor gzung zhes pa yin nam dpyad/ dzab dbyangs ni/ mos gus gdung dbyangs kyi dzab rnga mo du stor ba lta bu sogs nyir gcig bka' 'bum du bshad/ sgrub sngags thad/ lha mo yi ge drug ma bla med lugs kyi bsnyen sngags yig bdun dang /sgyub sngags dhu ma gha ye la mdzad pa ste/ yi ge drug ma bla med lugs kyang mang po yod chog kyang gtso bo gcig gsang ye ste/ grol thig tu/ gsang ye 'di gos dkar mor yang bshad/ de ltar byas da sgrol ma bla med lugs kyi sngags yig bcur byas pa lta burasnang / bsnyen sngags gtso bo yab yum gyi thun mong dang / sgrub sngags so sor mdzad pa'o/ /bsnyen dus katso bo yabaXyum gyi sngags gcig dril dang / sgrub dus so sor bye ste phrel ba red pas yab yum gyi sku dril sgrub tu ma zad gsung yang dril sgrub tu 'gro pa'i zab khyad snang / yum gyi spub sngags la oṃ logs su med pa ni sgrub sngags kyi thog ma'i oṃ de yab yum sngags gnyis ka'i thun mong gi mgo 'dren du mngon te/ klong snying bde rgyal las tshogs su sgrol ma'i yig bcuXtshang b.raXmadzad rgyur snang yang oṃ gcig gis mtsho rgyal dang sgrol ma gnyis char gyi mgo 'dren go chod mdzad pa lta bu/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum gyi gsang ye'i sngags kyis dpyod tshul yang yod/ chos dbyings kyis mtha' klas pa'i snang grag rig gsum thams cad 'phags pa'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lor bltas nas sgom pa ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi khyad par gyi rnam par sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la 266

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/sngags kyi cho ga'i sgo nas slob tshul ngo mtshar ba yin cing / sgyu 'phrul dang sbyar na/ dag pa'i snang zhen rtsal rgyas ched bsam yas lhun grub kyi rgya spros sogs sgom pa dang gnad 'dra'o/ /yum bsang ye lha mo yi ge drug ma yin na de'i sngabs kyang yig drug nyid du rigs kyi/ dhu ma gha ye'i sngags zur du ston mi rikas so zhe na/gsang ye ni 'phags ma yi ge drug ma nyid sngags bla med kyi sgos lhar bstan pa yin cing / de bzhin du dhu ma gha ye'i sngags kyang yig drug nyid bla med kyi lhan cig skyes ma'i sgos sngags su sprul pa yin zer ram brtags/ las sbyor skabs/ yi dwags su skye ba'i rgyu la ser sna gtso che yang des khyab pa ni gtan min pas 'gro ba der smin rgyu'i las nyon 'bras gsum thams cad 'dir pra yig tu dril nas nor bu'i rigs kyi 'od zer gyis sbyong ba yin la/ des rdo rje'i rigs kyis sbyang bya la khong khro rgyu 'bras kyis ma khyab pa sobs kyang 'gre/ de la sa dṛ sogs sa bon drug po ni rlung sems dang bcas pa'i thig le'i snyigs ma rigs drug ste/ dṛ yig tu 'jog rgyu'i rlung sems kyi thig le'i steng na thog med nas brgyud pa'i mi'i gnas lus longs spyod spyod tshul sogs mdor na mi'i 'gro ba'i phyogs kyi tha mal snang zhen gyi nus pa'i cha rnams brten nas gnas pas/ mir skye ba'i las nyon gyi cha thams cad de'i steng du sog 266

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4cing / las nyon de dag gis bskyed pa'i phyi snod kyi rgud pa dang / nang du rmongs dang brjed ngas/ dig lkugs/ dbang po nyams pa/dbul phongs/ nad mang / grags ngan/ 'khrugs rtsod sogs 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad yi ge de las mched pa'i snang ba yin no/ /des gzhan lnga yang shes/ de'ang snyigs ma'i rlung sems dang 'grogs pa'i thig le rigs drug po de/ yi ge drug tu mos nas sbyong ba yin la yi ge 'di drug 'gro ba drug la sbyor ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ nges tshig gi bshad pa la brten par mngon la/ 'gro ba gang gi yi ge yin pa de 'gro ba de'i gnas skabs skyed pa'i thig le'i mtshan mar yang 'thad do/ /mi'i gnas skabs skyed pa'i thig le mi'i nges tshig dang ldan pa'i yi ge'i rnam par byed pa sogs so/ /'di dag klong gsal sogs las rkang mthil la sogs pa'i gnas drug tu so sor brten par bshad kyang / thams cad kyi rtsa ba'i gnas mthar thug pa ni snying ka yin par sgyu 'phral skor las rgyas /deshāka15 :de ra par bshad do/ / 4ra 'a dag bkrus na 'khor ba'i snod bcud kyi rgud pa mtha' dag bkrus par 'gyur zhing / de dag gi bag chags ni shes sgrib yin pas de sbyang na srid zhi'i rgad pa thams cad sbyang bar yang 'gro ste/ rten 'brel sgrig tshul tsam bshad par zad kyi shes sgrib bskyed bzlas tsam gyis ga la 'dag /'byung 'gyur gyi dmyal ba'i sdug bsngags sogs sbyong dmigs la 267

'bab / ba /rdo ba ba pa rje ba ba nubab ma dgab da mdzeb dkying ba da zug/ ma 'bad pa ltar/ ma 'ongs pa na gsog 'gyur dang byed 'gyur gyi las sgrib rnams/ 'byung 'gyur gyi nad sman bcud kyis lan gyis bkag pa bzhin du rgyun gcod pa'i phrin las kyang gal che mod/bsags zin sbyong ba rkyang las ma go ba mang / de ltar na las sbyor 'di ni chos kyi dbying kyis gar khyab kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag rang gi gdul zhing du byin gyis rlob pa'i man ngag khyad par can yin pas thad kar wa shaṃ ku ru zhes ma bzlas kyang khams gsum gyi dbang phyug sgrub pa'i las sbyor chen po ste/ tshan che la bkra shis pa/dbang sdud stong gi nang na ri rab bzhinadu 'phags pa yin no/ /yo gar rje btsan 'dis dmib/sa med kyi brtse ba'i sgo nas khams ༄gsum gyi dbang po brnyes par gsungs pa de gzhung 'dir phyag len la btab 'dug go/ /ma ṇi'i sngags don stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab dang snying rje zung 'brel gyi sgo nas bshad pa dang /yig drug phyin drug dang sngags kyi lha'i rigs drug la sbyar ba ltar sngags de lam 'bras kyi chos de dag gi rang bzhin du nga rgyal brtan po bzhag ste sngags de'i 'od zer rigs so so'i tshul khrims bzang po'i yig drug skrub thabs ltar/ kha dog dang byed las can gyis gzhan don de ltar byed pa'i rnal 'byor la sbyang na rang nyid byang chub kyi bar du stong nyid snying rje'i thabs shes zung 'jug kam/268

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4phyin drug gi chos kyi 'od zer gyi snang ba stug pos zhing rab 'byams kyi 'gro ba'i rgud pa mtha' dag 'phrogs nus kyi dpa' bo chen por sgrub pa dang 'di ni thub bstan sgo thams cad nas rgyas par byed pa'idabang phyug gi mthu sgrub byed du 'gro lugs so/ /rang nyid la brten nas 'khor lo dang rdo rje dang rin po che sogs rigs drug gi rnam par thar pa'i sgo thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'gro 'dul gyi phrin las dus kun tu rtag pa dang phyogs kun tu khyab pa dang /'bad med lhun grub tu rgyas par 'gyur ba'i thabs dam par yang 'gro bas mkhas pa sgrub byed dang / mngon shes kyi mthu can dang /tshul khrims dag pa dang / dpal 'byor mi zad pa sogs pad+ma'i rigs sam dam pa'i chos kyi rigs kyi phrin las kyis 'gro ba thams cad rnamapar dag paralha ba'i bsam gtanal gnas pa ni dam pa'i chosa'adzin pa'i rnam par thar ba sgrub tshul rmad du byung ba'o/ /sgrub thabs kyi man ngag ci yang zur du btsal mi dgos so/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'jig rten ma lus pa snying rje chen po'i ye shes sgyu ma'i rig sngags kyis shin tu rnam dag gi gzugs su sprul par byed pa'i bsam gtan yin pa'i phyir sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la lhag par rtsal sbyang bar yang 'gyur la/ der ma zad rang nyid gang du 'tshang rgya ba'i zhing sbyong ba sogs rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi gnad bsdus pa'i man ngag kyang yin te/ nyi ma 269

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mkha' khyab/ chu bo dbyings khyab/ g.yos khang zas sbyor la sogs pa 'gro 'dul gyi las tshogs gzhan mang po'i gnad kyang 'di la ma tshang ba med do/ /rgyal ba'i yum sogs las byang sems kyi 'khor bsnyu ba/ lha'i 'khor gyi dregs pa 'dul ba/ ngan 'gro sbyong ba sogs thub pas mdzad pa phal cher 'od zer gyis sgrub par gsungs pa dang / 'od zer kun tu bkye ba bstan pa dang /dkon mchog ta la las 'od zer gyi rab dbye dang rgyu dang bya ba'i khyad par rgya cher bstan pa dang / sngags kyi dag pa bzhi lam byed kyi thad na/ 'od zer gyis reg pa tsam gyis sems can grangs med pa rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang la 'god pa la sogs pa'i mdzad pa dang / zhes pa sogs kyis 'od zer spro bsdu'i dmigs rim la nges pa drang bar bya'o/ /'jig rten du nad dang / gdon dang /lhas ngan dang / dadul phongs dang / 'thab rtsodadang / 'byungabazhi'i 'jigs pa sogs 'jigs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi nas/ bde skyid bkra shis kyi dpal 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i las sbyor la'ang 'di las zab pa med de/ rgyal po 'od chen po'i rnam thar bzhin no/ /las sbyor 'di tshang ma sngags sham med par yig drug rang rkyang bzlas nas sgrub lugs kyang / grub dbang tshul khrims bzang po'i lugs dang / thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel sogs na yod do/ /rtags mthong 'gyuraḥ zhes pa'i rtags ni 260

thugs chen yig drug si skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4phun tshogs tsam sgrub kyang yig ge drug ka tshang ba tshan che'i/brtson 'grus kyi yi ge rkyang pas ni min no/ /mdo las yig drug 'di lha mo yi ge drug ma'i srung bar bshad cing / 'di'i de nyid phar phyin drug gi re rer yang drug drug tshang bar bsdus nas sgrub pa la go cha'i sgrub pa zhes mi mthun phyos/sa kyis mi brdzi bas rgyal sras rnams kyi go cha yin par gsungs te/ de ltar bzlas na 'jigs pa mtha' dag srung ba'i sngags kyi dam par yang 'gyur/sngabs 'dis longs spyod dang shes rab dang srung ba sogs bang sgrub kyang don de dang de'i ched du 'dun stobs dang bsam gtan gyis lde kha sgyur ba ni nges par dgos nor bu chu shel tshon gang la nye ba de'i kha dog tu snang ba bzhin no/ /so/ /las tshogs rab 'byams gzhan yang sgrub lugs ni/ nyang gi 'gro 'dul sobs las shin tu mang ba bshad kyang 'dir bla ma zhi ba ltar las bzhir dril na/ rgyal po bka' 'bum du yig drug rkyang pa de dmigs med dbang gis las so sor byed par gsungs pa ltar ram/ nyang gi 'gro 'dul las so so'i sham sngags sbrel bar gsungs pa ltar na bla ma zhi ba ltar sbyor/ gang ltar yang ting nge 'dzin gal che bas/ de la rgyal po bka' 'bum sogs su lha'i sku mdog kyang las kyi kha dog tu sgyur bar bshad kyang / de ma 263

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/bsgyur bar 'od zer las mdog can gyis phrin las so sor mdzad par bltas pas kyang 'grub par pad+ma zhi khror bshad pa bzhin bya/gal te las bzhi'i cho ga de las rgyas pa la dga' na/ pad+ma zhi khro'i sa ts+tsha dang chu la brten pa sogs sbyar na legs par mthong ngo / /srung 'khora'abri na rgyal po bka' 'bum ltar dang / tshe sgrub byed na bla ma zhi ba nas blang /gter gsar gyi gzhung la lar/ mi zab pa'i bskyed rim gyi 'og tu lus dkyil lam zab pa'i bskyed rim sgom par bshad kyang /'dir ma gsungs te/ lar 'di'i lha bskyed ltar rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo thams cad phung khams dag pa'i bde chen ye shes kyi dag ldog so so'i steng nas sgom pa 'di la rtsal 'byong bar byas kyang phung khams 'od gsal du deng pa'i rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du lus dkyil sgom pa'i go chod pa zhig yod 'dra ste/ dus 'khor bzhin no/ /der ma zad 'di'i rtsa gzhung bla ma zhi bar/ phung po khams dang skye mched kunaḥ gdan gsum sgyu 'phral zhi khro yiḥ༄zhes sogs ltar phung khams thams cad la sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i lha rnams gzugs sogs nang gi chos de dang der shar ba'i snang zhen 'jog pa'ang gal che'o/ /snang zhen 'jog pa'i gzhi la/ rags pa phung sogs dang / phra ba rtsa khams kyi khyad yod pa ma gtogs pa yum ka la'ang tshul 'di 'dra'o/ /bya ba spyi'i rgyud dpung bzang 264

rdo ba ba da na yi ba ba ba da snang de ba ba / da ba / ba dang legs grub gsang ba spyi rgyud/ bye brag gi rgyud don zhags cho ga zhib mo dang phyag stong spyan stong gi gzungs mdo sogs/ spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang / yo ga de nyid bsdus pa dang dpal mchog /bla med gsang 'dus dang bde mchog mngon brjod bla ma dus 'khor sogs kun tu gsungs pas 'di ni rgyud sde bzhi ka'i lha yin/ 'di de kho na nyid la blo rgyas par byed pa'i blo 'phel gyi lhar bsngags te/ de nyid snang ba dang dpal mchog 'grel par/sems can gti mug shas che ba rnams sbyong byed du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid 'gro 'dul pada'i rigs sprul par mgasungs pa dang / rang bzhin dag pa'i chos la sor rtog ye thes kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa'i cha nas spyan ras gzigs su brjod tshul dang / sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo dang don zhags sogs mang por sgyu ma lta du'i ting nge 'dzin gyi steng nas sgos kyi che ba bstan pa sogs/ gsung rabs kyi mdzod thams cad kyi bdag por sgrub pa'i lhar bsngags pa'ang / rnam snang mngon byang dang yo ga dang bla med rgyud kun tu 'di sor rtog ye shes kyi lha mthar thug tu bshad cing / ye shes de sngon chos bstan pa'i rgyu las byung zhing /chos kyi longs spyod rgyas pa'i byed las can yin tshul mdo rgyan las dang / de nyid bsdus par/ 'di nyid dang por rgyal ba thams 266

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/cad kyi dam pa'i chos kyi 'od zer las sprul tshul dang sangs rgyas rnams kyis pad+ma byin nas badz+ra dharma zhes ming gis dbang bskur tshul/ sangs rgyas gsang ba dang shākya mi tras/ mdo sde bshad pa'i mthu rnyed pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs du ma/ gsang 'dus sogs las 'di nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i ljags lha'i rnam par shar bar gsungs te/ ljags ni gsung rab chos phung thams cad kyi bdag po yin tshul bsngags 'os bsngags bstod kyi bcu gcis pa ltar/'di'i rigs kyi dam tshig tu'ang / dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /zhes 'byung / gzungs kyi sgo tshad med pa sgrub par yang bsngags te/ mdo rgyan las sor rtog ye shes la dag gzungs rnams kyi/ gter dang 'dra ba/ zhes dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi gzungs kho na gzungs chen por 'jog pa dang chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis chos 'dzin pa sogs rje btsan 'di ting nge 'dzin gyi ༄lhar bsngags tshul 'chad 'gyur dang sgrigs la soms/ sgra rig dang de'i 'khor snyan ngag sogs la mkhas pa dang / rtsod pa smra ba'i khyu mchog sogs skrub pa yang bsngags te/ theg bsdus dbang 'byor lnga'i thad/ 'du shes gyur bas smra ba la dbang 'byor bar gsungs shing 'di 'du shes dag pa'i rigs kyi 'khor sgyur du bshad pa/ 'dus pa'i ngag byin rlabs skabs so rig bzhi gsung 266

thugs chen yig drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4rdo rjer sbyar ba/ dbyangs can ma'i byung ba/ yo gar rdo rje glu ma'i thad/ 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdo rje'i ljags kyi lhar bstan pa sogs kyis so/ /bstan pa dang 'gro ba la rgya cher phan 'dogs pa'i mthu ni mngon shes la ltos shing / de sbyin par yang bsngags te/ ko sa la'i rgyan las rdo rje chos dang rnon po gnyis kyi go rim skabs/ 'di ting nge 'dzin gyi lhar khyad par du bstan pa dang /a ba ta rar mngon shes kyi dngos grub 'jig rten dbang po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis sgrub par bshad pa/ mdo rgyan las ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo bsam mi khyab rnams sor rtog ye shes la sbyar ba/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis bsngags tshul gong bzhin dang / za ma tog las kun tu bzang po dang ting 'dzin gyi rtsal 'gran tshul sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i rigs pas so/ /sa gsum gyi 'gro ba dbang du byed par yang bsngags te/ rdo rje snying po rgyan du/ 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid ni/ /sogs dang / bshes spring du/ 'jig rten kun gyi rnal 'byor dbang mdzad nas/ /zhes pa rtsa 'grel dang / yo ga'i mkhas pa gsum gyis/ pad+ma'i de nyid la gzigs pas khams gsum gyi dbang po brnyes tshul rgyas par bshad pas so/ /'di nyid rang las ni/ 'brel tshad don ldan gyi phrin las sgrub par bsngags te/ sdong po bkod par/ sems bskyed gdul bya 267

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'buma'adren pas chu lha'i zhags pa lta bur gsungs pa dang lhag par sdong po bkod par/ ri rab kyi dpe dang / rtsi thams cad bsdus pa'i dpes gsungs pa gnyis 'byor/ kun tu bzang po'i smon lam thams cad kyi sdom sems bskyed du bshad pa sogs mtha' yas shing / 'di sems bskyed kyi lhar bka' kadams glegs bam sogs las bshad pa dang / nor bzang rnam thar las 'brel tshad smin par mdzad tshul gsungs pa/kri yog sde gsum kun tu pad+ma'i de nyid snying rjer bshad pa/ yo sar 'di'i mtshan 'gro ba 'dul ba zhes bshad pa/ rnam snang snying rje'i nyams kyis 'dul ba'i sems can la 'gro 'dul du bstan pa sogs mtha' yas/ bar do'i 'phrang dang ma'i mngal/ snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i yul dus sogs su yang de dag gi nyes pas mi gos shing / der ma zad de dag dge chos kyi grogs su 'gyur bar rlob pa'i lhar khyad par du bsngags te/ dpal mchog dang por 'di'i rnal 'byor 'chang ba la/ nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi nang na 'dug kyang pad+ma lta bur sogs gsungs/ 'di ni ji ltar pad+ma dmar po 'di/ sogs pad+ma'i de nyid las shes dgos te/ yo ga na shin tu rgyas shing / rnam snang mngon byang 'grel par yang yod/dpal mo'i bstod pa dang / srong btsan bka' 'bum sogs kun tu pad dkar mi gos pa'i de nyid dang sbyar yod/ 'jigs pa 268

thugs chen yika drug gi skor tsho sogs/ pod/ 4thams cad mi 'byung la/ gzhan 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i mthu ster bar yang bsngags te/ dam chos pad dkar dang / nor bzang rnam thar/ za ma tog /bcu gcig zhal gyi mdo gzungs rnams na gsal zhing rgyas/ spyod 'jug las kyang / 'khor gyi 'jigs pa'ang bsal ba'i phyir/ /sogs dang / 'di byams brtse'i lha yin cing rgyal po byams pa'i stobs kyis mnga' ris bsrung ba dang / ston pas bdud dpung byams pas btul ba/sgrol ma'i sngon byung sogs kyis shes so/ /'phags pa 'di'i spyan chab las sgrol ma dang khro gnyer gyi rgyud las khro gnyer can/ mche ba las dbyangs can ma sogs byung tshul 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang gos dkar mo dang / rma bya chen mo/ yid kyi shing rta ma/ longs spyod ldan ma sogs/ za ma tog sogs las gsungs pa dang /dpal mchog 'grel par/ brgya byin/ khyab 'jug /drag po/tshangs pa/ sa'i lha/ rgya mtsho'i lha/ nyi ma/ rlung gi lha'i gzugs can gyi rje btsan sogs gsangs te/ 'dis 'jika rten dbang da da phyug ces pa'i sgra bshad kyang shes/ spyan ras gzigs zhes pa'i mtshan 'di nyid 'chang ba'i sku la yang / bahru gcig zhal/ mkha' spyod/ seng ge sgra/ mgrin sngon/ 'phrog byed gsum la zhon pa/ hā la hā la sogs mtha' yas te/ sgyu ma'i rnam par thar pa bsam 269

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ gyis mi khyab pa'i mtha' la dad par bya'o/ /rdo rje snying po rgyan las/'jig rten dbang phyug thub chen po/ /bcom ldan rnal 'byor can grub na/ /dpa' bo thams cad lho 'gyur zhing / /rang sga dngos grub mchog rnams dang / /rnal 'byor thams cad 'dzin nyid dang //rnam par rgyas pa'i nor ster 'gyur/ /rig pa 'dzin dang 'khor lo can/ /sa dang pha rol phyin sogs dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyang stsol 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dam chos pad dkar las/ de bzhin bshegs pa gaṅga'i klung drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed kyi mtshan nas brjod cing phyag byas pa dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan lan gcig brjod cing phyag gcig byas pa bsod nams mnyam par gsungs te/de'i rgyu mtshan yang / rtog ge 'bar bar/ phar gyar pa'i phyir nga snyed da dpa da ra 14 nga dang / zhas gas ltar ra/ /za ma tag dang rdong bkad par nad kyi 'jigs pa sel ba'i lhar bsngags shing / rdo rje gur las yig drug nad thams cad zhi ba'i sngags su gsungs pa dang / ma ṇi bka' 'bum las nad 'don drug dang brtul zhugs drug dbyub/ bcos sogs nad gdon sel ba'i phrin las kho na rtsal du bton yod pas nad gso ba la ches rno/ khyad par du gso rig las mig 'byed par zab par gsungs shing / nyang gter mig 270
nga (

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4khyab pa med pas/'di nyid las/mdor na snod kyi 'jig rten kunaḥsogs gsungs la/ mal gro'i lus ngag dam la thogs kyang yid ma thogs pa ltar gdul dka' shos kyang klu rgyud yin te/ glen pa klu zhes zhe gnag pa'i dper grags so/ /de'i phyir 'di ni log 'dren 'dul ba'i lha sngags kyi mchog tu grub cing gtso bo'i gdul bya la bsam nas de ltar bshad kyi/ rgyal bsen dam sri gzhan gyi'ang gnyen po stobs kyi lha phul du byung ba ste/ gnod byed sde brgyad thal bar brlagaḥ ces dang / rdzas phur gyi sater 'byung du/ chos 'di byin rlabs shin tu myur bas dam sri'i bar chad bzlog /tshe 'phrang bsal zhes chos 'byung thad/ dam sri ras gos can btul ba'i lo rgyus kyis mtshon nus shing / lhag par slob dpon rgyud kyi lha srung zer ba'i dpe ltar kun macan bla ma nyid kyi sku pa'i gekas 'phrang bsal ba'i rten 'brel gyis rang cag chos brgyud 'dzin pa rnams la shin tu shis pa'i zab chos khyad par can no/ /de'ang dam sri 'byung po 'dul ba la sgos su bsngags pa ni rdo rje khro lod yin la/'di'ang rdo rje khro lod kyi bye brag yin par/ 'jigs byed rdo rje gro krodha lo kot+tar zur chag pa ste khro bo 'jig rten mchog zer ba yin gsungs/ bo lodaḥces so//'dir gur drag sku/rta skad gsung / mkha' lding thugs kyi lhar byed pa gzhung du gsal te/ sku gsung thags bsam gyis mi ༄276

sgyu ba / ba — rje shā ba pa nga ba ba ma ba bad zung ma nga ba ba pa nga da ma /khyab pa'i dbu gsum dang ldan pa zhes pa dang phyogs 'dra zhing / gur drag rtsa ba'i lha/rta mgrin rigs bdag /bya khyung rgyal mtshan gyi tshul du byas kyang rung ba 'dra/ yang rta mgrin dang rdo rje mkha' lding ni bsgrub bya'i lha dang / gu ru ni sgrub byed rig 'dzin gyi tshal du ༄'phrul pa ste/ sgrub byed nyid bsgrub bya'i ngo bo son pa dang / bsgrub bya nyid sgrub pa po'i rnam par bzhengs pa yin pas/ don la bsgrub bya sgrub byed tha mi dad pa ste/ basprub bya'i sku nyi zer rnon po dang /sgrub pa po'i tshul bstan me shel gyi nor bu lta bu/ de gnyis mnyam par sbyar nas sgrub pa'i drag sgrub 'di nyi zer me shel la bcug nas me sgrub pa lta bu ste/ bgegs kyi spra skam sbyong ba la ches no ba yin no/ /'di rtsa rgyud thod dum la brten no/ /bshad lugs kyi rnam grangs tsam yin gyi/ gu ru nyid bsgrub bya'i gtso bo yin pa ni bshad ci dgos/dum bu dang po lo rgyus kyi skor tsho'i//sprub thabs kyi thog mtha'i las gzhung da lta kun gyi kha rgyug 'di/chos 'di'i bka' babs kyi skyes bus mdzad pa khyad 'phags yin mod kyi gter gzhung gi tshig zin dngos ni rig 'dus kyi dkyus bzhin byed panyid yin te/ zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba'i tshogs mchod dus/ bzhengs shig rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lhaḥ sogs la 'don pa sgyur mi dgos pa rgyu mtshan dang bcas te kun mkhyen nyid kyis 276

cad (1ba nga dbacad dbabaka 'babaste〉pa11/ dbabad/ 〉〉gsungs pa ltar/ rig 'dzin zhes pa gar byung du rta khyung zhes sgyur ba sogs dgos par ma go/ bsnyen pa mtshams bcad dam du byaḥzhes pa ni/lus bcad rgya/ngag smra bcad/ sems gzhan du ma yengs pa rnams te gal che/ gdon 'grol las/ rdo rje srung ba'i gur gyis dkrigasaḥ zhes dang / las gzhung gi mtshams gcod ltar srung gur gyi dmigs pa dang don dam pa'i srung ba rgyun du gces/ spyir 'di las sgrub kyi lha'i bye brag tu snang yang /sgrub thabs 'di la 'chi srid chos skur sbyong byed de ting dang / bar do longs skur sbyong byed kun snang / skye ba sprul skrur sbyong byed phyag rgya phra rags kyi ting nge 'dzin te mchog sgrub kyi gnad che ba rnams tshang bas rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba'ang byar yod/ lha sku'i rnam pa ni/ thags rjes sems ༄can la chags pas skru mdog dmar po/ thig le nyag gcig gi rang bzhin rtsa ba'i zhal gcig /gong smos ltar ram/ dbang drag gi las gnyis mdzad pas rta khyung gi zhal gnyis phyung ba/ dus gsum gzigs pas spyan gsum/ skye shi rtsad gcod mche ba gcigs pa/snang srid zil gyis gnon pas gsang gos dang phod chen/ pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pas rus rgyan/ rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis dpa' bas stag sham/ sems byung lnga bcu srog zal du gyur pas mgo phreng mnabs pa/'dir gsang phod kyi steng na stag sham rus rgyan sogs 277

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ kho na nyid la blo bzhag cing / de nyid dag pa'i snod bcud du shar ba'i nga rgyal skyong ba ni bskyed rim gyi lam gnad zab pa zhig ste/las sgrub la'ang 'di yod na khyad che'o/ /dum bu gnyis pa lha bskyed la sogs pa'i skor chos//thugs ka'i sngags phreng zhal nang bstan du dbang chog rdo rje pha lam las te/ zhal ni dang po gang nas klog pa'i phyogs la bstan pa de yin gyi leb ngos min no/ /bsnyen yig tu sngags 'khor gyi gzugs sgra la dmigs pa gtso bor gsungs te/ de dag la sems ci tsam goms pa de tsam du gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs rlung sems la zhugs nas bzlas brjod kyi nus pa skye bas thog mar de la bslab dgos te/ sngags 'khor dang lha la snang zhen sbyong ba jing du chu bskyil ba lta du/'od zer spro bsdus las sgrub pa rdzing chu yur bar 'dren pa lta bu/ snga ma la rtsal ma thon par phyi ma gtso bor byas kyang rdzing na med pa yur bar 'dren pa lta bur 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /lha sngags ngo bo dbyer med du lha ba'ang shin tu gnad che/ de nas 'od zer spro bsdus sangs rgyas kyi spyi mdzad la rtsal sbyang ba dang / sgos mdzad klu 'dul gyi dgongs pa la bslab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sngakas 'khor las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang / khyad par zangs mdog dpal rir gu ru rin po che 28 0

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4rig 'dzin ḍāk+ki'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i thugs rgyud bskul/sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas bdag don ye shes 'bebs pa dang / yang 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas de rnams kyi gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i zug rngu mtha' dag bsal/ snod bcud thams cad rig 'dzin drag po'i dkyil 'khor du sbyang bar bsam nas gzhan don phrin las kyi rten 'brel bsgrigs pa ste/bsnyen pa'i gnad byang las/'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byasaḥ zhes rtsa tho yod pas chad du mi rung / klu gdon sogs kyi sdug bsngal dang gnod sems zhi ba'i dmigs pa 'bur dod byed na'ang phyi ma 'di'i khongs su bcug pas 'grub/gnyis pa ni/ sngags kyi 'od zer me stag lta bu dang / sku'i cha thams cad nas khyung gi tshogs 'phros pa'i 'od kyis banod byed thams cad rdzas la me mched ltar tshig par bsam par gter gzhung gi mchan dur gsungs te/ 'di'i don sngags las 'bar ba'i 'od zer dang khyung gi tsha tsha 'phros pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang / nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad lhag med du sbyangs te/ba spu'i sgo nas phyir spros/ log 'dren rnams kyi lus gong bzhin bsreg par bsam zhes zin bris rnying par 'byung ba/ me dmizas 281

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigasamed bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/kyis dang por lus gdon/de nas gnas gdon/mthar stong gsum gyi bar gyi bgegs sbyang ba'i me dmigs skor gsum gter kha gzhan du yang 'byung bas legs cha yod kyang / mchan bu'i sku'i cha thams cad las zhes pa las gzhung gi /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang ཿ khyung gi tsha tshas gtams shing 'phroḥ zhes pa ltar bya rgyur mngon pas/dogs pa phre'u yod/'dir steng zhal/go cha/phyag mtshan bcas bya khyung gis mdzad cing / lhag par sgos mdzad ga'i bo des bsgrubs pas khyung gi dmigs pa la rtsal 'don par snang ste/'jig rten na sman sngags kyis sbyong sgyur sogs la mi ltos par klu'i dug la rjen zas nus pa'i mchog nam mkha' lding yin pas de dang sgo bsnyun pa ste/ rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa'i gtor zlog tu/ bya khyung 'bar bas klu gnyan rgum bur 'thuḥ zhes so/ /khyung gi kha dog la g.yon pa'i phyag mtshan thad/ me khyung dmar po zhes bsnyen yig tu sasungs la/ gnod 'grol las/ bya khyung nag po'i khra thabs gtongaḥ zhes 'byung bas/ rgya rong rin po ches/ sreg byed khro chu zhun pa'i lus can/ zhes gsungs pa ltar mthing dmar lcags sreg gi mdog lta bur byas na 'grigs par mngon/ slar yang dadu gtsug rta zhal gyis 'tsher skad drag po byung bas srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i gnas thams cad shig shig yom yom byed cing / phyogs skyong bcu 282

rta che 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4 sde ris dang bcas pa'i lus sems cher g.yos/ snying rtsa bsgul/dpa' zil chag /dran pa myos/ bya spu rlung khyer ltar rang dbang brtan pa dang bral te/dbang gi 'od dmar lcags kyus zhabs 'og tu bkug nas 'gul mi nus par bsam la gzir/ de'ang gnod byed dngos bya khyung gi bsad sreg byed cing /de dag gi gab khung lta bu'i bsdong zla dang rgyab rten phyogs gtogs rnams rta mgrin gyis dbang du sdud pa'i dbang drag sprags ma yin nam snyam/ 'di ltar na rnam snang mngon byang 'grel par/ khro gnyer can gyi rgyab tu mthu chen thob 'god pa ni dpang bya ba'i phyir ro zhes pa'i rigs pa ltar/༄klu 'dul gyi las byed dngos bya khyung dang / de'i dpung grosas rta mgrin/ gur drag de banyis kyi rtsa ba'i lhar byed dam dpyad/ gnod 'grol dus/ bzlas pa'i tshe khyung dmigs mi byed par rta skad kyis 'jig rten g.yo zhing sgul ba dang / 'od zer gyis klu gdon zhabs 'og tu drangs te zil gyis gnon pa tsam byed pa dbu'i yig chung gi don du mngon pas dkyus dang mi 'dra yang / de ni/ zhi bas brngan dang drag pos gziraḥ zhes sogs ltar klu gso ba dang /'khon gcug sbyong ba'i las rim dang 'brel bas dang po nas bsad sreg mi byed pa yin par gsal te/ spyir btang dmigs bsal lha bu'i khyad do/ /rgyal bsen lta du sgos su 'dul na/ khyung gi 283

rta khyunga'abar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4gzhom med kyi btsan rdzong 'dzin tshul zab pa'ang yin no/ /bzlas sngags kyi a rtsig ni shin tu khros pa/ ni rtsig ni rab tu khros pa zhes dgongs 'dus rnam bshad las gsungs/ rta gur khyung kasum dril ba'i sngags dngos ni/ oṃ ṭī hūṃ khro phaṭa ces pa la ngos bzung dbos te/gdon 'grol du yang yang 'byung /lhag ma gu ru drag po'i sngabs so//de rnams la srog sdom gzer bzhi brtsi tshul yang shes par bya ste sla'o//dum bu gsum pa dzab dgongs kyi skor tsho'i//dus nam yang gu ru rin po che mkhyen snyam pa'i mos gus dung nge ba dang / rig 'dzin he ru ka'i zhing sku'i snang zhen mi 'bral ba srog ltar gces/skabs ci rigs par 'di nyid kyi thugs dam skul ba'i gsol 'debs grangs gsog byed na dbang gi gnad yig ltar tshig bdun gsol 'debs la bya zhing / bsam pa myur 'grub kyang shin tu 'tshams/ thun mtshams su yang me dmigs rgyun mi gcod par yang yang gso ba la slob zhes mkhas grub gter ston mnga' ris/ chen po dag gsungs te/ phyir gtsub shing gi me sgrub pa la ngal bso med pa'i 'bad rtsol dgos pa bzhin du nang bsam gtan gyi me la'ang 'dra bas gnad che bar go/ nad gdon mar lta du 'ga' zhig bzlas brjod kyi me mtha chung dang yun thang gis kyang dang /de da /stobazhu bar nus so/ /lcags lta bu 'ga' ga bzhu ba la bas ldan 286

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga dang yun bsring ba dgos pas ngang thung mi bya/ gdon dang por bslang rtags/ bar du chum rtags/ tha ma thul rtags so sor 'ong bar bshad pa'i rnam dbye'ang phyed dkos/ re dosas mang na bgegs 'jug cing / gdon byings che na rtags mtshan phyin ci log gis mgo skor 'ong ba yang bshad pas rtags bzang ngan ci byung yang re dogs dang dga' brod 'jigs zhum gang yang ma shor bar nam mkha' mdung bskor ltar bya/ nyam nga rnam rtog cher za dus/gong du drangs pa'i gdon kyang rang sems 'khrul pa'i rtsalaḥ sogs ltar/gang shar rig pa'i rang rtsal dang /rang snang ye shes kyi 'khor lor rtsal sbyang bya zhing / thog rdzis kyi brtul zhugs kyang rgyags/ de tsam du ma zad/ dngos 'dzin gyi me ro skad cig kyang mi slong bar spyod yul thams cad sgyu mar shes pa'i rnal 'byor gyis zil gyis gnon pa ni 'og min bgrod par lam khyer shes pa bcu gsungs pa'i gnad don yin/ rig 'dzin bsnyen yig tu mtshams kyi kun spyod pha rol phyin drug dang sbyar nas gsungs pa dang / gab byang las kun bzang spyod pa lngas bsnyen sprub kyi gnas dang yo byad sngags g.yog dam tshig sogs bstan cing /'og min bgrod par lha sngags dang sgrub thabs ster ba'i bla ma la mos gdung rgyun mi gartsod pa dang / sdod min la gsang ba mi ston pa sogs dam tshig drug 286

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4྾4 ྾gsungs pas mtshon bsnyen dus kyi spang blang ston pa'i skor rnams la bshar sbyang gtong /kha skong bi sbyin sreg byed na ye shes me lce sbyor/lha sngags las rung gi drod tshad rnyed pa la rtag 'grus gnyis po 'dzom dgos pas bsnyen mtshams bsdams pa nges par dgos shing /phyis su'ang lha'i thugs rgyud 'khul ba dang / byin rlabs kyi rgyun gso zhing gong du 'phel ba sogs kyi ched du 'chag med kyi dam bca' bzung / der ma zad gdon thul rtags dang / lha nye ba'i mtshan ma ci rigs mthong nas rang la bar chad kyis mi tshusas snyam pa yod de/ sayul du mtshon chas mi chod pa la go cha yod pas mi chog//lus la lhon dgos pa ltar bzlas sgom mi g.yel ba gal che/ bsnyen pa rdzogs nas gsang rdzogs kyi rgyud las gsungs pa ltar 'od zer sbo bsdus lde kha sgyur tshul dang / sngags la spel tshig gang 'dod sbyar ba tsam gyis las sna tshogs shig 'grub la/ lhab bsam dag pas de lta bu'i tshul gyis bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher spyod pa'ang o rgyan rin po che'i mdzad phrin gyi 'phro bskyang bar 'gyur sa legs mod kyi/skal ldan mchog ni tshe thung 'dir las sgrub kyi nang du mgo mi 'khor bskyed rim brtan pas spring yig byed na phyogasabacu'i rgadon tshogs la spring ba lha ma yin gyi gtsug tor spyar na 'thad do/ /bar mthong ba'i chos la rig 'dzin gyi sa bgrod pa'am/ de ma byung yang phyi ma zangs mdog 287

par/ ba rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/ dpal rir thogs med du 'gro ba'i gsal lam dam par bzung nas dngos grub mchog gi 'byor pa rgyas par byed do/ /dum bu bzhi pa rjes spyod sogs kyi skor tsho'i/ /lar klong chen snga phyi'i chos 'di dag dgongs gter gyi rgyal po yin te/ snga ma gzhan du shes/ phyi ma chos kyi babs lugs kyi sgrom nas 'od gsal snying thig gi lam gnad la mi 'phyug pa'i gzer bu thebs nges pa rtogs brjod chu zla na bzhugs te blta shes na ya mtshan po yod/ gter kha so sor bka' babs kyi sgos khyad re yodapa las/ kun macan phyi ma 'di rdzogs chen snying thig dang rig 'dzin bla ma'i sgrub skor gyi bka' babs su lung bstan bka' rgyas bstan par rang nyid kyi— gsungs te/'di'i thags rje chen po dang /༄bka' brgyad/seng gdong sogs la bla ma'i gsang sgrub/rig 'dzin thugs sgrub/rig 'dzin yum ka'i gsang sgrub sogs zer ba de yin no/ /yang rje 'dis dgongs rnam rtsom dus dbu gtsug nas rta skad 'tsher ba/gu ru rin po ches pad+ma dbang chen zhes mtshan btags pa/mthe bong thugs srog t+ya yis mtshanaḥ zhes pa mkha' 'gros ngo sprad pa/ rta mgrin gyi rnal 'byor la brtsonapa'i ska bas su rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i chos nyid kyi bden don gzigs par gsungs pa sogs kyi rgyu mtshan las rta mgrin grub pa'i dpa' bor shes so/ /288

rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho/ pod/ 4྾ ྾ klong snying 'dir gur drag mthing dmar gnyis gsungs pa'i drag mthing bla ma bka' brgyad du byas nas dang / drag dmar rta khyung gnyis dang sprags nas gsungs la/ bya sla 'khyer bde byin rlabs cheḥzhes pa lta bu ni phyi ma ste/ pad+ma gsung la rtsal 'don na lhag par yang de zab bo/ /de ltar na rig 'dzin chen po 'di'i dbongs gter gyi bla ma rig 'dzin rta mgrin dang sbrags pa'i sgrub gzhung zhig nyams su len rgyu byung na no nus gzhan dang mi 'dra zhing / rta mgrin khams gsum rol pa sogs kyang rig 'dzin thugs sgrub kyi skor yin yang /de la gu ru zhi drag gang gi'ang ming 'dobs mi byed kyi/ khyad par de rnams rdzobs pa la rta khyung 'bar ba 'di rang phul du byung bar mthong ngo / /des na las gzhung dang gnad yig gnyis kar/ shin tu yang zab thugs kyi gteraḥ zhes gu ru nyid kyis zab par bsngags pas/ pha mes kyi rdo lag brgyud tsam ma yin par brgyud pa dang chos kyi rgyus la byang bar byas na dad pas khams sos par 'gyur ro//rje btsun bod 'bangs 'gro la dus kun brtse/ /da dung bod 'dir gdul bya'i lhag ma mchis/ /'di ltar spyan 'dren sbyor ba bshams nus na/ /pad+ma'i 'dzum zhal myur du mjal bar nges/ /rta khyung 'bar ba'i bsnyel tho rin chen sgron me zhes bya ba/ bya rgan 289
