rdo rje phag mo'i zin tho don 'grub ma/ pod/ 4gtan ma grags pa ste/ sher phyin mchog la ma hā su kha dz+nyā na zhes gsungs pa'i gnad ni de'o/ /'di dag gis bdud rtsi ril bu'i cho ga la'ang mkha' spyod kyi rdzas skrub dang / blo 'phel gyi rdzas sgrub tu 'gro lugs yod pa shes so//'dir ye shes dbab tshul ni/ thog med nas grub pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi byang sems kyi bdud rtsi dgug pa'i thabs kyis rang gi rtsa khams byin gyis rlob pa'i sgo nas byed de/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ ma rgyud du bde ba gtso bor byed la bde ba'i gnad khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor yin pas thig le byang sems kyi rdzogs rim gtso bor byed pa yin zhes bshad pa'i rigs pas so/ /de nyid slar yang rgyas par phye ba ni/ phyi rol rdzas kyi bdud rtsi'i ril bu dngos su bsgrub nas/ bdud rtsi myang ba'i cho gas chan la phabs dang / 'o ma la sgyur gta' 'jug pa'i tshal gyis rtsa rlung thig le byin gyis ngarlabs te bde chen sper ༄ba bdud rtsi ril bu'i cho ga'o//'di ni las sbyor snga phyir gsungs pa gnyis kyi 'brel sgrigs yin la/ blo'i nun sel du yang ltos/ mchog gi mdzes ma'i sku 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud rtsi 'dir bdud rtsi nizla ba ste/ de gcig pu la khams lnga'i bcud 'dus pas rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du gnas tshul brtags gnyis su yod/ skul ba dang / chos 'byung gi gnas su dgug pa dang / de nyid las sras dang ra sa ya na la 469

rdo rje phag mo'i zin tho don 'grub ma/ pod/ 4na/ chos bdud rtsi yin te/ rgyu minga'abras bu la btags nas chos sman zhes kyang rjod do/par byed pa'i thabs te/ bzlas brjod dang / ting nge 'dzin sogs so/ /'di dag dgongs par song ma song dpyod/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i cho ga 'di ni mkha' 'gro dbang sdud kyi man ngag tu yang ches zab ste/ ji ltar ro'i lce sngags kyis ma bsgrub par ci tsam bcangs kyang lha yul gyi dpal la rol ba'i mthu med la/ de sngags kyis bsgrubs nas grub pa'i ral grir song ba na ni mthu de dmigs pa bzhin du/tha mal pa'i rtsa khams rlung gsum ni ji ltar dar yang rdoXrje pho nya mo khyad par can rnams dbang du bya ba'i mthu med la/ nam rtsa khams de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i shin tu rnam dag gi bdud rtsi'i byin rlabs babs shing bde ba'i sazi brjid thob pa de'i tshe ni grub pa'i zhing gi pho nya mo dngos grub rin po che'i gter yon tan gyi phung po rnams pad+ma'i mtsho la ngang pa'i phang phung ltar thugs chags shing dbang du 'dus nas byin gyis rlobs shing rim gyis stoms 'jug gi bde ba'i dga' ston la sbyor ba yin no//sangs rgyas kyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i tshul dpag tu med pa zhig yod na/ lang tsho ma'i skye gnas kyi dga' ba'i sgo nas rjes su 'dzin pa kho na ched cher byed pa ci zhe na/ sngar yang bshad mod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / grangs med pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa 471

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/rnams yum gyi chos 'byung gi gnas su dngos grub brnyes pas na 'di ni byang chab snying po'i grong khyer ro/ /'di ltar rnal 'byor bla ༄med du dbang dang mngon shes dang gzugs dang ting nge 'dzin dang byang chub kyi yan lag dang so so yang dag par rig pa nas stobs dang mi 'jigs pa'i bar chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs las byung ba'i yon tan thams cad lhan skyes kyi ye shes gcig pu de las 'thob dgos shing / lam gzhan gyis mi rnyed pa'i mtshan dpe mthar thug sogs kyang bde chen de nyid las 'thob pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa'i gsang mdzod phul du phyin pa ni chu skyes kyi khang bzang ngo / /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i bcu bzhi par/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams dang mjal ba/ /bsod nams dbang gis brgya lam 'thob /de rnams dang byasadaga' chen po/ /myungs pas 'chi ba slu ba yin/ /de phyir rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/ /mchod pa rnal 'byor pa yis bya/ /rdo rje 'changachen go 'phang ni/ /de rnams mnyes pas 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes phyag rgyas 'chi ba slu ba sogs gsungs so/ /mdo sde dang 'dul mngon dang rgyud sde dang rig sngags la sogs pa lung gi chos thams cad kyang mthar gtugs na mi shigs nā da'i rol mo bde stong de'i ngo bor sgrib bral du dag pa las byung ba kho na yin pas sde snod dang rgyud sde'i 'byung gnas phu thug pa'ang chu skyes kyi gan sto la de nyid do/ /des na rdo rje btsun mos chos 'byung gi 47 2

rdo rje phag mo'i zin tho don 'grub ma/ pod/ 4gzhal med khang du rtse dga'i bde ba byin pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dngos grub kyi mdzod gtad pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi rgyal srid gtad pa dngos rang yin no//thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor thad/ 'di'i zin tho zhal dpod du/shom gyi tshe/ mchod pa g.yon skor byed par gsungs pa ni sayon pa gtso bor byed pa ma rgyud kyi lugs yin pa la dgongs pa 'dra bas/g.yon pa'i kun spyod gzhan yang mtshon te/ de la ni bde mchog rtsa rgyud du/ bud med la g.yon pa zhes yang yang 'byung ba ltar rigs ldan ma la brten nas lam bgrod pa'i rten 'brel che zhing / gnad rgyas par rgyud 'grel ltar ro/ /des na in+d+ra bhu tis zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs su/ khams gsum brtan dang g.yo ba yi/ /'gro ba thams cad g.yon nas 'byung //rnal 'byor rtag tu g.yon pas spyod//rkang pa g.yon pa sngon du dor/ /mchod pa lag pa g.yon gyis te/ /g.yon gyis bstabs shing bza' bar bya/ /rigs lnga la ni kun spyod pa/ /rigs gcig tu ni brtag par bya/ /bza' dang bza' min de bzhin btung / /gtsang sme ngo tsha rnam par spangs/ /kun rtog kun las nges grol bas/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spang / /rnal 'byor dra ba'i sdom pa yis/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /ces sogs gsungs pa gal che/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa la 'bad par 473

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pa pa gzhung las gsungs pa'i rgyas bshad tshes bcu'i rtog pa ltar/ me mchod byed na/ yar ngo'i tshes bcur tshogs mchod/ mar ngo'i tshes bcur me mchod bya bar tshes bcu'i rtog pa las gsungs/ dngos grub kyi ye shes 'byung bar nges/ thun gyi thog ma rnams su byin gyis brlabs pa'i ma dā na bdud rtsi ril bu dang sbyar bas kha dag par bya ste/ nyams chag skong zhing grib rigs sel ba dang / bgegs srung ba dang / ngag nus ldan du byin gyis rlob pa mkha' 'gro ma'i dam tshig gi rdzas mchog yin pas rnal 'byor ma rnams dgyes shing 'du ba/ sogs phan yon shin tu che'o/ /sgrol ma'i zab tig gi rdo rje phag mo'i bdud rtsi ril bu'i cho gar/ 'od dang sgra dang dri bzang dang : 'phel dang g.yo na grub pa'i rtags: mthong bas lus sems sdug bsngal zhi: 'chang na srung ba kun gyi mchog:myong bas nad gdon sdig sgrib 'dag: yun du bsten na 'chi med cing : bde chen rab 'bar mkha' spyod 'grub: ces so/ /'di yang rje nyid kyi phyag bris ji lha ba bzhin bcos bslad med par spar du bskrun pa dge legs 'phel////474
ma /—/yusda ka'i dmigs skor/

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/—༄ / /tshe ring ma rig 'dzin yab ka yum ka gang dang sbrel yang 'brel tshod 'dra bar gter bum lhan thabs su mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mo spun lnga yis sogs dang grub rje'i char chog na'ang ye thes lha 'di dang ma dag pa las kyi lha tshe ring mar mdzad pa sogs kyis shes/ bde snying gter bum du las mtha' me mchod la gtod gsungs pa no 'don yin gyi med mi rung gis ma khyab pa maṇ+ḍal zhi chog gi las sgrub bzhin/ phyi ma 'dis ye sems mdun mkhar bsgom pa'i las sgrub kyang thon/ rtsa sngags mtha' bskyed de gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i 'bod sngasas su bya lugs bsun zlog ltar/der phyi nang gi gnas yul gdod nas 'dres tshul la nges pa brtan par byas nas tshogs 'khor bskor bas gnas gsum gyi ḍāk+ki tshim pa nyid kyis nang gi rtsa khams tshim nas rgas rgud na 'chi las skyob pa'i zab gnad yod gsungs te 'di'i tshogs mchod na spyi bo dza lan+da ra sobs gsungs pa'ang phyi rol ltar snang ba'i 'dzam gling gi yul chen thams cad nang rtsa rlung thig le sa/sum las gzhan du ma gyur pa bltas nas mchod pas phyi rol gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes pa dang nang rtsa khams byin gyis rlob pa chig chod du 'ong ba'i gnad yin par go dgos/ gong smos 'bod sngags de bsdu dus ha ri ni sa ra tsa tri ya thams cad dz+nyā na wa ra hir 'du zhing lus 476

yum ka'i dmigs skor/ pod/ 4dkyil phra rags gnyis las phra ba rtsa khams kyi lus dkyil yongs rdzogs khros nag gi lha sngags 'di ka bsnyen pas 'grub lugs gal che ste mkha' 'gro ma stong phrag don gnyis kyi brtan g.yo thams cad phag mo'i cha shas dang phag mo kho na de thams cad kyi bdag mor bde mchog las so/ /smos zin tshogs 'khor gyis na rgud sogs gso tshul de dzab dgongs kyi bdud rtsi bcud 'bebs la'ang sbyor te bsnyen yig las tshogs 'khor stong las dga' zhes so/ /phyi mtsho rgyal nang sgrol ma gsang ba khros nag byas pa 'di las gzhan yang yod kyang rad gling gter khar so sor dang / lnga pa'i lugs sprub dus kun 'dus nor bu lugs dang dbang dus gnas sgyur/ 'dir sbras/ sgrub/ de'ang bsnyen dus phag mo dang sbrags/ las tshosas dus sgrol ma dang / dbang dus gsum ka sbrags te/ de'i rgyu mtshan bde snying las bsnyen pa dbyings kyi yum la bya sogs dang / dbang mchog tu cho ga gcig gis byin rlabs dang sogs/ 'og min gyi kun tu bzang mo dang mkha' spyod kyi rdo rje phag mo pad+ma rigs kyi zhing mchog bod yul 'dir nyang gi khros nag dang dmar chen dang mkha' 'gro snying jig mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus sogs ltar rta phas pad+ma'i rigs kyi bka' babs kyi rnam par dngos su byon nas gsang ba bla med kyi chos kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad par dngos 477

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'dum/dang brgyud nas mdzad pa mtsho rgyal gyi mtshan dang skur sgrub lugs yin par chos sku'i klong na kun bzang mo sogs kyis bstan cing /bu mo nga ni gnas yul nyer bzhi'i bdag /ces gnas yul(24gyi snod bcud thams cad de nyid kyi cha shas su byas nas sgrub lugs yin par bsnyen pa'i yang yig dang tshogs mchod du 'byung bas parbo yo gi ni zhes pa'i rang ldog nas kyang mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi spyi dril sngags su 'gyar tshul shes dgos/ sku'i bkod pa ༄'di sngon byung gi da lta med do zhes mi bsam ste rnga yab gling na dngos su bzhugs tshul dang rnga yab dpal ri sprul pa'i zhing nas 'ong zhes dang lnga ba'i rgya can na'ang de 'dra yang yang 'byung ba sogs dran dgos/ rgyal thabs spyi blugs tshangs pa'i dbang sogs ni rigs bdag las dbang bzhi blang rjes mthar thug rig pa'i rtsal dbang du grags pa 'od gsal bsam mi khyab kyi dbyings su bla ma mkha' 'gro'i dgongs klong sre ba dgongs brgyud kyi rtogs pa 'pho ba'i zab gnad de mos slob tsam la'ang byin rlabs 'jug cing de'i rgyun brtan byed kyi khyad che/ de ltar na gzhung gi go rim yang 'grel par/ dz+nyā na wa ra hi hūṃ/ rgyal thabs spyi blugs sogs kha sgyur gzhan du shes par dang de nas gdod lus dkyil sngags 'byung ba shin tu 478

yum ka'i dmigs skor/ pod/ 4legs/ grub pa brgyad dngos su 'grub par gsungs kyang / sgrub lugs zur pa ma gsungs pa ni mkha' 'gro las rung ches klong du gyur pa na de dag gis rdzas kyi dngos grub mngon sum du ster ba'i gzhan stobs kyis yon tan brgyad 'thob pa'ang yod mod de gtso bo ni de dag dang snyoms 'jug byas pa nyid kyis mkha' spyod dang 'chi med sogs sbyin pa ste sgyu 'phrul las mkha' 'gro gsal 'bar tshe la sogs zhes pa lta bur snang / tshe dang lang tsho ngag nus stobs dang bde ba gzungs dran shes rab sogs sgo gsum gyi yon tan thams cad dwangs ma zungs su smin pa las byung ba dang /phyi rol gyi bcud kyis nang gi dwangs ma'i yon tan gyi nus pa gso ba dang /bcud kyi mthar thug shin tu rnam dag gi bde ba'i bdud rtsi kho na yin pa dang /de dbang byed kyi lcags kya mthar thag lha mo rnams kho ma ba da zur tshungad zunganar ngas pa dang / yang bla ma ha ru ka dpyad kya rang bzhan dang /rnal 'byor ma thig le yin pa'i gnad sogs dang byin 'bebs dang dngos grub len chog kun tu bde 'od kyi bdud rtsi 'bebs pa kho na bsngags pa sogs kyis rang don bdud rtsi skrub pa dang ye shes 'bebs dmigs la bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun sogs las zab pa med do/ /'di nyid mkha' spyod sgrub byed du 'gro lugs zhig zin bris don grub mar yod pa ltos/ a zhes dbyings rig 479

ngo da/ 4 rdo grub 'jibs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ 4 bsres thog /snang ba thams cad ces phyi snod/ srid pa thams cad ces nang bcud de das pa rab 'byams spyir gsal btab/ de'i rnam pa ji lta bu snyam na rgyu rkyen las 'das man chad kyis bye brag tu bde chen mtsho rgyal kyi zhing skrur spu ris 'byed pa/ de'ang rgyu rkyen zhes pa rgyu sbyu yig sogs sa bon dang / rkyen bi sha bi shudhe sogs bskyed sngags kyis bskyed pa las 'das pa ste dran pas rdzogs pa la rwa ṭika tu bshad/ gong gi chos sku'i klong na kun bzang mo sogs bshad pa des mkha' 'gro ma'i nang na rdo rje phag mo byin rlabs che myur du bde mchog las gsungs pa ltar las phag mo'i sgrub lugs gzhan las kyang bod 'dir bod mo rang du mdzad pa mtsho rgyal nyid sgrub thag nye bar rtogs nus/ phyi gnas chen nyer bzhi dang nang rtsa thig nyer bzhi gdod nas gnyis med du bzhusas lugs la nges pa brtan pas rtsa khams bla ma he ru ka'i bde bcud kyis tshim pa'i nga rgyal brtan na de ka rang gis phyi rol gyi yul chen na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo ḍā ki rnams tshim zhing mnyes nas byin gyis rlobs thing dngos grub ster zhes pa gong sbos kyi don thang bcad pa'o/ /rdo rje phag mo nye na gnas yul kyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyis byin rlob pa'i rgyu mtshan la/ sprul pa sprul gzhi la 'du bas dang / gtso mo gar bzhubs su sprul 'khor ngang gis 'du ba'i gnad gnyis/ yang 480

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/nga yid rton med ces smos ma thag pa'ang / rtsa ba gsum 'dren dus phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro chos skyong zhes bla ma yi dam gyis byin rlabs dngos grub stsol/ mkha' 'gros bar chad sel bar bshad pa dang / khros nag tu rtsa gsum 'dren dus legs par byin rlob mkha' 'gro ma zhes 'byung ba dang yang cung zad 'grisas 'grigs ltar ni snang ngo / /mchog grub kyi lha mang ba dang / las sgrub kyi lha mang ba'i khyad par yang dran dgos/ ngag la mthu skyed pa la'ang 'di zab ste/ sgos chos 'bar ba gsum du ngab la nus pa 'bar/zhes so/ /'di'i lus dkyil lha ni zhi khro ngan song sbyong ba'i lha sngags bcud bsdus yin te/ kun mkhyen nyid kyi phyag thor yum ka 'di ngan song sbyong ba dang sbrag tshul rgyu mtshan bcas gsungs pa dang /'dir lus dkyil a nu'i mdo lung zhes gsung la/ snying po don gsal du/ dag pa'i snod bcud kyang 'pho med sogs nas ribs brgya dang rig 'dzin gyi bskyed rdzogs zhes pa sgrigs dang go/ de ltar byas nas 'di'i lus dkyil dang kun tu bzang mo'i sgos mdzad kyi dngos grub kyang rtog sgrib nyams chag sbyong / dam tshig gso zhing skong / ngan song dang snyigs ma'i dus kyi sdug bsngal sa/ting sprugs pa sogs dang / nyams rtos/sa khyad par can skye zhing brtan pa'o/ /de bzhin du phag mo'i dngos grub yul (24gyi rnal 48 2

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/4 ྾'di'i sku gsum ga'i dngos grub yin te/ de 'dra'i dngos grub de kun tu bzang mo dang phag mos tshan cher 'bebs/ mtsho rgyal gyis chu'i 'khrul 'khor gyis chu 'dren pa ltar dngos grub de tshegs med du myur por 'dren pas so//de thams cad spyi skad ltar ma byas par sprul gzhi la chos sku/ des sprul pa dang / des sprul pa longs sprul du byas nas chos sku'i klong na sogs las byang gi tshig la bstun pa'o/ /yang na sku gsum nyid dngos grub bo/ /yang na mchog la dbongs pa g.yo 'gul med ces pa chos sbu'i dang / ji snyed ma.o pa'i sogs chos kyi dngos grub skor longs sku'i dang / grub pa brgyad sogs sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul sgor sprul sku'i dngos grub ces 'chad dam ste/'di a mtshar dpyad tho tsam las nges 'drong mi 'dug pas snga ma cung drag gam snyam/ gong smos ltar 'di dang rig 'dzin yab ka sa nu yo gar sde tshan gcig red la/ de'i phyir 'di'i lam gyi 'gros kyang rig 'dzin gab byang lhar dgos sam snyam pas rdzogs rim gyi mgo snyan rgyud shoka dril yid nor ltar/ de rjes gzod rdzos/sa chen la 'jug par mngon/ 'di dang zhi khro a nu yin zhes pa'ang lha sngags byings la bsam dgos kyi rnam pa kun nas nges pa min te/ bzhi pa bskyed rim a tir sgom zhes dang / de las rnam par 'das pa man ngag sde'i/ sogs ltar/ bde rgyal 'di rdo rje phag mo yin na mtshan 48/

yum ka'i dmigs skor/ pod/ 4dang rnam 'gyur tha dad du 'dod pa dang 'gal/ mtsho rgyal yin na bod mo'i chas byed rigs pa la/ mi mo'i rnam can spangs nas lha'i rnam par snang ba ci zhe na/ o rgyan rgyal po'i sras pad+ma ka ra gur drag gi skur bzhengs pa ji lta ba bzhin red/ dgongs 'dus pad+ma badz+ra yum marnya ra ba dmar mo yang der 'dra/ de'ang mi'i rnam can las lha'i rnam can de sprul pa min gyi/ mi'i rnam can de nyid der bsgyur ba red pas yang sprul sum sprul sogs dang ye mi 'dra ste/sprul bsgyur gnyis khyad che bas so/ /de'ang mthun snang la bod du bzhugs dus tha mal bod mo'i chas su yod la/ zangs mdog dpal rir phebs nas dag pa'i lha'i rnam par bzhugs te de yang dus 'khor las/ dam pa rnams la zhi bar yongs snang / zhes sogs ltar/bde chen myur lam gyi dga' ston la rol pa'i rig 'dzin ḍak+ki'i gtso mor 'di bzhin bzhugs shing / srin yul gyi gdul bya 'dul dka' sogs la mthing 'od 'bar ma drag mo'i rnam pa sogs/ sbon po 'dul ba'i cho 'phrul ci yang ston/ /zhes pa ltar ston no/ /tha na rang re lta bus kyang tshe 'dir mkha' spyod grub na/ mkha' spyod du slebs nas kyang da lta'i rasas lus gdos bcas 'di 'drar yod pa min gyi/ rig 'dzin gyi lus gzhon nu phra yang sogs kyi yon tan ldan par 'gyar nges pa dang tshul mthan par go/ phyis su skal ldan ra da 485

yu ma ka'idamigs skor/ pod/ 4rwa ṭika tu rta bror thugs ka'i phag mo'i kha ṭī las rta mgrin gyi dmag dpung spros te bro rdung bar dmigs par bshad pas phag mo kha ṭī mchan bcug dang / kha ṭī de rta mchog gi ngo bor sgom pa 'thon la/ phag mo la nang gses mang yang ye sems 'di pad+ma gsung gi rigs yum du'ang des shes/ rgyal thabs spyi blugs zhes sogs rig pa dbyings mal du brtan nas rang snang rang rtsal gyi chos thams cad la 'dod dgur dbang bsgyur zhing tshur rkyen snang gang gis kyang mi brdzi ba ni gdod ma'i rgyal thabs brnyes pa red/de'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa ni rgyal srid la dbang bskur ba/gshis la snang srid thams cad ye nas 'od gsal kho na'i gzhan dbang du song yod pas/ rgyal bu rkang 'khyam rgyal sar bzhag pa lta dur brjod pa'ang rkang 'khyams dus nas rgyal sa las g.yo ma myong ste/rtsal thog tu ci tsam 'khyams shing 'khrul yang rig pa rang gi ngang las 'da' mi srid pa rmi lam gnyid las phyir ma gyur pa bzhin te/'di la bskur thob med pa'i chos nyid gsungs/ tshig rkang gsum 'di 'di'i sdogs rim rtsa tshig red/ bla ma'i ye shes 'pho ba'i dgongs pa 'di ni rnam shes lus las ma bton yang dpal ri'i zhing galha'i thugs dbyings ye rig pa gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i klong du rang sems sre 'pho'i gnad zab red la/ de gsum ni 487

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i sasunga'abum/—྾ ྾྾ ྾ ྾dpal ri'i zhing / pho brang / sku ste gsum po'i 'char gzhi mthar thug red pas de ltar rtogs nas de gsum la dbang thob par byas na de las sprul pa'i phyi'i zhing sku pho zang rnams la'ang thogs med du 'jug cing dbang sgyur nus/ dpal ri'i zhing du bgrod pa'i sa spyod kyi dngos grub 'di ni lha 'di'i khyad par gyi dngos grub ste/ chos gling khros ma dang rnam thar du/ mkha' spyod dbu ma'i lam la btsan thabs su 'khrid pa'i/ /nga yi ye shes mtsho rgyal sogs/ bla rnam gyi/nam zhig tshe yi sogs kyang 'pho yul mkha' spyod sa spyod kyi khyad dang rnal 'byor ma dang bla ma'i lha sngags la rtsal 'don phyogs tsam las na ro mkha' spyod kyi bsam mi khyab thun min dang band ches mthun/ rang gar thugs yid bsres nas rig ngo bskyang ba dang /bde rgyal du nga rgyal bzhag thog nas snga ma ltar bskyang ba khyad che ba'ang bla rnam kyi 'di dang bsgrib na shes/ da dung rdor thol gyi/snying dbus zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang cher dang / zhing smon las/gzhi dbyings pad+ma 'od du grol bar shogaḥsogs kyang rgyab skyor yod/bsnyen dus mtsho rgyal nyid kyang phag mo'i ngo bo blta ba la rtsal phyung zhing / pad+mo yo gi'i sngags kyang phag mo rags phra gnyis kyi sngon nas grub pa sprul gzhi'i phag mo dang / slad nas de nyid kyis ljongs 'dir skye ba bzung ba sgrub pa'i phag mo gnyis dril ba'i sngags dril sngags su bya/ las sbyor skabs mtsho 88

yum ka'i dmigs skor/ pod/ 4 ba rgyal nyid kyang / ltos dang bu mo sngo ljang mtshar sdug nga / /sogs ltar sgrol ma'i rnam 'gyur du gtso bor lta zhing / sngags kyang sgrol ma phyi nang gi dril sngags su bya ste/ de'ang sgrol ma gang gi bzlas sgom skabs su babs pa de dang bsnyun na rno snyam/ sa rlog zhal can gyi lha sngags kyi ngo bor shes pas gtad sprugs/ seng sadong phrog byed zhal can du shes pas byang 'grol/ /189

mngocadang/ nga nga rdo grub 'jigang med bstan nga su nga 'bum/ nga nga / /tshe dbang rig 'dzin skabs/ 'byung ba bem po'i lus ye shes kyi mes sbyangs zhes ma bshad/ snyigs ma'i lus sbyangs zhes gsungs te/ dwangs ma zad nas snyigs ma stobs 'phel ba na na rga sogs su 'gyur ba bzhin snyibs ma 'grib cing dwangs ma stobs 'phel ba na 'chi med dang / 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa'i yon tan du 'gyur bar tshe sgrub skor du gsungs pas de ltar snyibs ma'i cha zad nas dwangs ma stobs su gyur pa'i rdo rje'i lus thob pa ste de'ang lam mchob yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe dbang 'di/ deltar ched du ma bsgrubs par bde stong sbyor ba'i bde ba 'bar stobs kyis snyigs ma sbyangs shing / de stobs kyis dwangs ma nus pa 'phel zhing cher 'bar// de sto bas kyis rga shi med par song nas/ 'jig rten thams cad kyis mi thab pa'i lus sa mi migs pa'i lus thob nga nga pa'o/ /zag zad tshe dbang zhes par/ lus khams skye gnas kyi zag pa zad par gsungs pa la ches 'grigs/ 'di yan sgyu 'phrul skabs so//'chi med mkha' 'gro'i tshe lam ji lta ba bzhin du nyams su long nus pa'i brtson 'grus can gyis 'chi med 'grub tshul ni/ rdzosas rim skabs rdo rje lus kyi gnad che sar dmigs te/ srid zhi'i dwangs bcud sdud pa'i dmibs rim byas stobs kyis gnas nger 9 2

tshe yum rdzogs rim/ pod/ 4 ba ba bde chen 'char te/ de shar ba na rtog pa rags pa'i spro bsdu dang bral bas 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma bsdu dmigs dngos byed pa med mod/ 'on kyang dwangs bcud bsdu dmigs kyi de ma thag rkyen las/dwangs bcud de dag thams cad nang bde chen gyi thig ler 'dril ba'i bde chen de nga'o snyam pa'i snang zhen gyi shugs ma nyams pa ni yod la/ de ni don gyis bde chen des rang nyid srid zhi'i dwangs bcud mtha' dka 'dus pa'i ngo bor nga rgyal bzhag par song yod cing /de skabs bde ba'i dbang gis rlung las su rung yod pas/nga rgyal bzhag pa lhar nus pa thon sla'o/ /lar yang rdzogs rim pa'i bde ba de skye skabs zub pa dang rengs pa dang lci ba'i snyigs ma'i rlung gi cha rnying pa du ma zhig 'bags nas dhu tir 'jam pa dang mnyen pa dang yang ba dang dwangs pa'i rlung gsar ba du ma skye ba zhig yod cing / skabs 'dir ni bde chen de brtan g.yo'i tshe bcud thams cad 'dus pa'i nga rgyal gyi shugs ches che ba la khyad par du gnas pa'i rgyu bsgrubs yod pas/ de'i dbang gis bde ba de skye ba na snyigs ma'i rlung 'gags stobs dang / dwangs ma'i rlung ngam yon tan skyed pa'i rlung gsar ba skye stobs gzhan las ches che ba zhig yod cing / rlung dang 'dra bar khams bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi'ang rgad pa byang tshabs dang / yon tan gyi nus pa skye 493

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/tshabs gzhan las che'o/ /bde ba de las ldang ba na'ang bde ba'i mdangs lha skur 'char bar byas pa'i sgo nas sngar gyi tshe yum gyi snang zhen la bogs bton nas/ yang dwangs bcud bsdu dmigs byas te/ de ltar mnyam rjes 'khor lo bskor ba ltar basbab pas rim gyis lus kyi snyigs ma'i cha rnams dag cing / dwangs ma'i cha dang de'i yon tan rnams je dar ji rgyas su song ste/ mthar dwangs ma 'ba' zhig pa'i lus bde ba'i gzi brjid mi shigs pas 'bar ba 'grub ste/ lus kyi rtsa ba sems yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i tshe na ni brtan g.yo gzhan rnams bcud dang bral bar ma byas kyang / de rnams kyi bcud thams cad btung nas 'ju ba dang byed las mnyam pa zhig yong ste/ mdor na de 'dra'i lam che'i rdzogs rim pa'i bde ba'i ye shes de nyid la nus pa de 'dra 'ong ba ste/ de'i phyir tshe bcud bsdu dmigs ji snyed byed pa de thams cad mthar bde chen ye shes kyi bcud len khyad par bsgrub pa 'di la kazhol lo//mkha' 'gro'i gdams pa 'di 'phags ma'i snying tig sogs tshe sgrub khyad 'phags mang por tshe bcud bsdu dmigs ston pa na bcud de rnams basbus pas rdo rje'i tshe thob par gyur rkyang ba ma gsung par/ tshe dang bde chen ye shes rgyas par gyar ces ba/sungs ra bde byedapa'ang / che'i dngos grub dang / de'i 'byung gnas ba chen — 49 4

tshe yum rdzogs rim/ pod/ 4bcud len grub par gyur zhes pa'o/ /bde bas rten bcas kyi dbang po rgyas pa tsam gsang 'dus mtha' dpyod sogs su'ang gsungs mod/ bde ba de srid zhi'i tshe bcud kyi ngo bor snang zhen sbyang tshul sger du ma gsungs pas/ bde ba bcud len du 'gro tshul ches cher mi mtshungs so/ /zhu bde khyad par can gyis lus kyi dwangs ma gso/ dwangs ma nus pa 'phel ba'am dwangs ma'i yon tan 'phel rim bzhin snyigs ma skyon skyed pa'i nus pa bcas 'grib tu 'gro ba ni/ nad kyis nyen dus lus kyi rgad pa ji ltar lhag pa de lhar yon tan gyi cha rnams zhan du 'gro ba/de go bzlog na shes so//de 'dra de la snyigs ma dwangs mas phug pa zhes bya yi/bem po'i cha zadaXzer ba yin pas dus 'khor ba'i ting 'dzin gyi yan lag dang mi bsre'o/ /rim pa dang po'i dus su'ang zhu bde yod cing / lhan skyes kyang yod mod/ bskyed rim pa'i zhu bde dngos lam byed mi nus kyi ring la/bde ba'i bdud rtsi de'i dod du kun rtog gi rang bzhin gyi ting nge 'dzin tshe bcud spro bsdu'i snang zhen can tsam las med mod de/de'i tshe rdzogs rim pa'i rlung dang thig le las rung lta bu med kyang /dmigs pa yid byed kyi khyad par des rlung this byin gyis rlobs pa tsam ni mi 'gal bar ma zad nges par nus te rlung sems 'jug pa gcig pa'i gnad kyis rlung la sems kyis dmigs nas bgrang 496

pod/ 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/྾ 4྾ ྾bas rlung rngam rgod can zhi bar mthong ba dang 'dra'o/ /rlung sems 'jug pa gcig las rlung gi kha lo sems kyis byed pa ltar rnam shes kyi rten thig le dkar dmar sogs kyang / sems chabs pas gzir ba na de dag skul 'ong ba'i ribs pas tshul 'dra'o/ /des na re ba'i zas dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyas pa dang / gsang 'dus mdor byas las lus brtas pa'i cho ga gsungs pa sogs ltar srid zhi'i tshe bcud kyis lus rags pa dang / phra mo rtsa thig rlung gsum thams cad tshim par bsgom pas sems tshim nus pa na de'i rten gyi thig le dang rlung yang rim gyis tshim par 'gyur zhing / yon tan skyed pa'i mthu gso bar byed pas lus kyi mar me ting nge 'dzin gyi zhun mar gyis bso ba yin la/ de'i grogs su lhas dgongs par 'gyur ba'i thabs kyi bzlas pa sogs byed do/ /legs so// //496

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 4 thon cing / dpe gtam sgrung rgyud 'chad la mnga' brnyes pa/ dkar nag rtsis kyi 'phrul la thogs pa med cing / gso byed sman gyi lugs la dbang 'byor ba/ ri mo dang yi ge'i bzo rtsal la mdzes byang sga cha khyad du thon pa sogs mang du byung 'dug par brten de dag gis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rig kanas kyi shul bzhag tu gyur ba par ma dang bris ma'i glegs bam du byas pa'ang da lta'i bar mi nyung ba zhig bzhugs yod pa la/ spyir grub mtha'i dbang du byas na yul 'dir snga 'gyur rnying ma ba dang / ri bo dge ldan pa/ mnyam —med bka' brgyud pa/ rgyal ba jo nang ba sogs bod brgyud nang bstan gyi grub mtha' che rigs phal cher zhig mnyam gnas su bzhugs shing / sa bab kyi dbang du byas tshe'ang mdo khams lho byang 'brel mtshams su chags yod pa sogs kyi dbang gis yul 'di'i rig gnas spyi dang dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas tshun chad la mdo khams rig gnas ma lag gnyis ka 'dres pa las byung ba'i khyad chos thun mong ma yin pa zhig yod par brten/ myur skyob dang zhib 'jug dpyad gzhi'i rin thang 'gangs che ba zhig yod par gdon mi za/de'i phyir spyir bod kyi rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsam gyi ༄bya bzhag la rang ngos kyi nus shugs 'bul ba dang / sgos thun min 3

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/— ba bab rang khyad thon pa'i sa gnas ris gnas shul bzhag myur skyob dang dar spel byed pa'i kun slong bis bskul te/ nged las khungs nas 'tshol bsdu sgrig gsum gyi bya ba yun ring spel mthar dpe rnying mi nyung ba zhib lag son byung ba las bdams pa brgyud/ 〈mgo log sa khul mkhas dbang rim byon gyi sasung rtsom gces bsgrib/sa dpe tshogs〉)zhes pa zhig bsgrigs nas rim par dpe deb skor zhig par du skrun par rgya che'i klog pa po dab gi gdeng 'jog legs po dang 'brel yod sde khag gi gzengs bstod thob/ rting sbul de dag gi rmang sazhi'i steng〈krung go'i grangs nyung mi rig bana' rtsom spyi byang gnad bsdus〉lag star byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te nga tshos rim pa sngar las spags te/ slar yang〈mako log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉kyi par skrun jus gzhi gsar ba zhig bzos nas khul srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid la yar zhu byas pas rgyab skyor dang khas len legs par thob par brten da lta jus gzhi dngos su lag star byed pa'i skal ba legs po thob/de la 'dir〈dpe tshobs〉〉'di nyid 'tshol sdud dang dag sgrig rtsom sgrig par skrun bcas kyi skor sasal bshad du 'os pa 'ga' zhig zhu ba 'di lta ste/1 nga tshos bya ba 'di spel ba la mgo log khul u dang / khul 1

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 4dmangs chen/ khul srid gzhung / khul srid gros bcas 'go khrid tshan skor che bzhi dang 'brel yod sde khag gi 'gan 'khur ba las grub pa'i ched don 'go khrid tshan chung btsus/sa thog 'brel yod don bya gang ci'i thad bka' skor snyan seng zhus pa'i dgongs don ltar bsgrubs pa yin la/ ched dmigs bya ba'i jus gzhi yig thob nas khul mi dmangs spid gzhung la zhus te chog mchan thob cing brgyud spel gnang ba dang bstun pa sha stag yin/ dus mtshungs su ma phyi'i yig rnying yod tshad so so'i 'brel yod gnyer bdag dang chos bdag dgon bdag sogs brgyud de tshul ldan lugs mthun sgos 'tshol sdud byas shing / khong tshor gros zhu byas te par skrun byed par thugs mthun yid 'thad byung ba yin la/ rgyun srol lam gsang ba sngags dang 'byel ba sogs kyi dbang gis bka' dog/ dgos min dag kyang khong tsho'i dgongs 'dod bka' 'khrol dang bstun pa ma gtogs nged cag gi lag tu gang son lhar gzu lum sger gcod byas pa gcig kyang med/2 mthan rkyen 'byor ba'i sa/nas bab 'og sasung 'bum ༄bcig la'ang bris ma dang par ma'i ma phyi ci rnyed cig nye bar bsdus te phan tshun bsdur gshib sgos bang rgyas shos kyi rmang bzhi'i steng gzhan las kha bskangs shing / dmangs khrod du kha 'thor du 6

bsgrigs rjes kyi gtam/ pod 4'jus par ma phyi sor 'jog byas shing / 'ga' zhig la yin shas che bar 'dod pa'i yi ge de zur gyi zla khyem du bkod yod/5 klog bde bar gzhigs te gsung chos bye brag pa phal mo cher mdzad byang sogs las dras te kha byang bkod cing / sa bcad blangs la/ ldeb byang yang bye brag tu bkod yod/6 ba zur 'dogs min lta bu sogs yi ge skor zhig gi bkol stangs da lta'i dag yig 'ga' zhig dang gcig tu mthun min yod kyang mkhas pa tshad ldan gyi phyag rgyun la thar chags su yod phyin khungs lung re yod srid la phyis su dag yig zhib dpyod pa dab gi dpyad gzhir nye bar mkho yang srid snyam nas ji bzhin sor 'jog byas/ gzhan yang ma yig tu skabs 'gar mkhas pa gzhan gyi gsung thung ngu tsam re yongs su drangs 'dug pa zhib par dpyad tshe rgong 'og gi gsung gang rung re de'i zur rgyan nam gsal 'don ci rigs su song ba sogs 'brel shin tu che bas dgos dbang la gzhigs nas 'dir yang ma yig ltar bkod pa lasas/bye brag rdo grub chen rin po che 'jigs med bstan pa'i nyi ma'i gsung 'bum la gsal bshad du zhu dgos pa zhis ni khong la da reb kyi deb bdun po 'dir 'khod pa las gzhan da dung sasung chos mang tsam yod par nges la de ltar du'ang thos mod dus dbang 7

bsgrigs rjes kyi btam/ pod 4pa ni khul u'i hru'u ci gzhon pa khul gna' rtsom dpe tshogs 'tshol sdud dag sgrig par skrun 'go khrid tshan chung gi tshan gtso sku zhabs pad ma rnam rgyal lags yin pas rang re 'brel yod mi rabs snga phyi kun nas khong gi bka' drin yid la 'chang zhing rjes su dran par 'os zhes 'di gar ched du gsal 'debs zhus pa lags/ de bzhin rdzong gtso sprug lo lags nas kyang sa gnas mi ribs rib gnas phyokas dgongs klong yangs la spyod pa mdzangs pa'i bka' drin bstsal ba mdzad pa dase/ ba'i phyas rjes su che/gzhan yang zi khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang bod yig rtsom sgrig khang nas nga tshor phyogs gang ci'i thad bla na med pa'i mthun rkyen bskrun cing mi risas rig gnas la gcig tu brtse ba'i lhab bsam dkar pos phyogs du ma nas dmigs bsal chen po'i mdzad pa bskyangs pas dngos gnas bka' drin che zhu/ lnga ris mkhas pa'i dbang po bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang bde legs rab rgyas dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po 'ju baposhis bzang po nas kyang〈dpe tshoṭa〉'di la thugs khur sku tshegs kyi mdzad pa bzhes shing / gsung chos sam mdzad pa po so so la 'brel yod kyi dgon sde bla sprul rnam pas rang ngos kyi mthun rkyen sbyar ba'ang rang re klog pa po dang bcas pas yid la bsrel bar 'os pa nyid do/ /9

pod 4 rdo grub 'jigs med bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/mjug mthar ched du zhu bya ni/ nga tshor gna' rtsom rtsom sgrig par skrun gyi nyams myong zhan cing / dag sgrig par zhu byed pa'i chu tshad dma' la/ dus tshod kyis gtug cing las brel che ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis dpe tshogs la nor 'gal gyi cha yod nges yin pas/ rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnam par thugs dkrugs dwangs zhu dang 'brel phyi phyir sman pa'i yo bcos dgongs 'char la'ang bsri ba med par 'tshal/ /zhes mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i gzhung las khang nas/2003lo'i zla10tshes8la/0

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khur ba/pad+ma tshul khrims/mdun shog 'char 'god pa/karma tshe ring /rdo grub 'jigs rmed bstan nyi'i gsung 'bum/pod bzhi pa/mgo log khul gna' rtsom bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung ga(1nga las khang gis bsdu sgrig byas/si khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis par du bskrun nas bkram/ lho nub lcags bzhu sa gshis par 'debs bzo grwas dpar/2003lo'i zla10par par gzhi dang po bsgrigs/ 2003lo'i zla10par par thengs dang po dpar/par grangs/ 0001— 300dpe rtags/ 1④3ma7—6409—2739—970 44deb bdun po la rin sgor/ 150 00

〈mgo log dpe rnying dpe tshogs〉'tshol sdud dag sgrig dpe skrun bya ba'i 'go khrid tshan chung gi ming tho/tshan gartso/ pad ma rnam rgyal/tshan gartso gzhon pa/byis tshe ring / rdo rje bkra shis/bstan chos/ 'jigs med/ rdo rje/gces ma/ klu skyabs/ nor sde/khongs mi(ming rim bod yig ka mad ltar bsgrigs pa)klu skyabs/ dge legs/ mgon lha/cin nor bu/ gces ma/ 'ju skal bzang /'jigs med/ bstan chos/ thub bzang /dung gces/ rdo rje/ rdo rje bkra shis/nor sde/ nor bu/ pad ma rnam rgyal/byis tshe ring / tshul khrims/ tshe ring skyabs/
